brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang*// nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin// de bzhin gshegs pa sgra snyan bzhin// nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no// de rnams rgyas par bshad na/ ji ltar bai ḍūr dag pa yi// rang bzhin sa steng 'dir 'gyur te// dag phyir lha yi dbang po der// lha yi bu mo'i tshogs dang bcas// rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang*// lha gnas de las gzhan dag dang*// de yi gzhal yas sna tshogs dang*// lha rdzas rnam mang de mthong ngo*// de nas skyes pa bud med tshogs// sa yi steng na gnas pa rnams// snang ba de ni mthong gyur te// nged kyang ring por mi thogs par// lha dbang 'di 'drar gyur cig ces// de 'dra'i smon lam 'debs byed cing*// de thob don du dge ba ni// yang dag blangs te gnas par 'gyur// de dag dge ba'i las de ni// 'di snang tsam zhes de lta bur// shes pa med kyang sa steng nas// 'phos te lha ru skye bar gyur// snang ba de ni shin tu yang*// rtog pa med cing g.yo ba med// de lta mod kyi sa steng na// don chen gyis ni nye bar gnas// de bzhin dad sogs dri med can// dad sogs yon tan bsgoms pa yis// rang sems las snang rdzogs sangs rgyas// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa dang*// 'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*// bzhugs pa dang ni gzim pa dang*// spyod lam sna tshogs mdzad pa can// zhi ba'i chos ni gsungs pa dang*// mi gsungs mnyam par bzhag gyur pa// cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs dag /mdzad pa gzi mdangs chen po can// sems can rnams kyis mthong bar 'gyur// de mthong nas kyang 'dod ldan pa// sangs rgyas nyid phyir rab 'byor te// de rgyu yang dag blangs nas ni// 'dod pa'i go 'phang thob par byed// snang ba de ni shin tu yang*// rtog med g.yo ba med pa nyid// de ltar na yang 'jig rten na// don chen pos ni nye bar gnas// 'di ni rang sems snang ba zhes// so so skye bos mi shes mod// ces gsungs so// yang*/

ji ltar bai ḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la// lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar// de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la// thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char// gsung*/ yang lha'am rnga'i dpe ni/ ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyi// sngon gyi dkar po'i mthu yis ni// 'bad dang gnas dang yid gzugs dang*// rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du// mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang*// zhi ba'i sgra yis bag med pa'i// lha rnams thams cad yang dang yang*// chos kyi rngas ni skul byed ltar// de bzhin khyab bdag 'bad sogs dang*// bral yang 'gro ba ma lus par// sangs rgyas gsung gi khyab mdzad de// skal ldan rnams la chos ston to// sangs rgyas kyi gsung kun la bstan kyang sems can ma rtogs pa rnams kyi rna bar mi 'gro bar bstan pa ni/ ji ltar rna ba dang bral bas// phra mo'i sgra ni mi myong bzhin// thams cad lha yi rna bar yang*// rna lam du ni mi 'gro bzhin// de bzhin chos phra mchog tu ni// zhib mo'i ye shes spyod yul yang*// nyon mongs med yid 'ga' zhig gi// rna ba'i lam du 'gyur ba yin// gsung*/ sprin gyi dpes bstan pa ni/ ji ltar dbyar gyi dus na sprin// lo thog phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu// chu yi phung po 'bad med par// sa la rgyun du 'bebs pa ltar// de bzhin thugs rje'i sprin las ni// rgyal ba'i dam chos chu yi char// 'gro ba'i dge ba'i lo thog rgyu// rnam par rtog pa med par 'bebs// ji ltar 'jig rten dge ba'i lam 'jug na// rlung skyes chu char sprin gyis 'bebs pa ltar// de bzhin brtse rlung 'gro dge mngon 'phel phyir// sangs rgyas sprin las dam chos char pa 'bebs// srid la mkhyen dang brtse chen gyur pa dang*// mi 'gyur ma gos nam mkha'i dkyil gnas pa// ting 'dzin gzungs chu dri med snying po can/ thub dbang sprin ni dge ba'i lo thog rgyu// 'bab sa'i snod kyi bye brag sna tshogs pa nyid las/

ji ltar bsil dang zhim dang 'jam pa dang*// yang ba'i chu ni sprin de las thon pa// sa la ba tshwa la sogs gnas 'brel bas// shin tu mang po'i ror ni 'gyur ba bzhin// de bzhin 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad cu'i char// rab yangs brtse sprin snying po las thon pa// 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi gnas kyi dbye ba las// rnam par mang po'i ro dang ldan par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// yang*/ de bzhin bde gshegs chos kyi sku las mi bskyod 'jig rten khams kun tu// skal ldan gyis mthong de mthong de yang rtag tu dri ma kun sel byed// sngon gyi rang nyid smon lam dang*// lha rnams kyi ni dge ba'i mthus// ji ltar tshangs pa 'bad med snang*// rang byung sprul sku de bzhin no// sangs rgyas stong pa'i ngang nas sems can gyi bsam pa dang mthun par ston pa ni/ 'pho dang lhums zhugs bltams dang yab kyi khab gshegs dang*// dgyes par rol dang dben par spyod dang bdud bcom dang*// byang chub cher brnyes zhi ba'i grong khyer lam ston dag /bstan nas thub pa skal med mig gi lam mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ nyi ma'i dpes bstan pa ni/ ji ltar nyi ma rtog med par// rang 'od cig car spros pa yis// padma rgyas par byed pa dang*// gzhan dag smin par byed pa ltar// de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yi// zhes pa nas/ chu yi snod ni thams cad la// bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni// dpag tu med pa cig car 'char// rtag tu thams cad la khyab par bstan pa ni/ chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil du ni// sangs rgyas nyi ma gdul bya yi// ri la ji ltar 'os par babs// zhes gsungs/ nor bu'i dpes bstan pa ni/ ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu ni// rtog pa med kyang cig car du// spyod yul gnas pa rnams kyi ni// bsam kun so sor rdzogs byed ltar// de bzhin sangs rgyas yid bzhin la// brten nas bsam pa tha dad rnams// sna tshogs chos ni thos gyur kyang*// de ni de la rnam mi rtog// ces gsungs so// sgra brnyan gyi dpes bstan pa ni/

ji ltar sgra brnyan gyi ni sgra// gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba// rnam rtog med cing gzo med la// phyi dang nang na mi gnas ltar// de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung*// gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba// rnam par rtog med gzo med cing*// phyi dang nang na gnas ma yin// zhes gsung*/ nam mkha'i dpes bstan pa ni/ cung zad med cing snang ba med// dmigs pa med cing rten med la// mig gi lam las rab 'das pa// gzugs med bstan du med pa yi// mkha' la ji ltar mtho dang dma'// mthong yang de ni de ltar min// de bzhin thams cad sangs rgyas la// mthong yang de ni de ltar min// zhes gsung*/ sa yi dpes bstan pa ni/ ji ltar sa las skye ba kun// rtog med sa la brten nas ni// 'phel dang brtan dang yangs 'gyur ltar// de bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa// rnam rtog med pa la brten nas// 'gro ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// ma lus par ni 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las bstan to// de ltar chos sku nam mkha' lta bu la// yon tan phrin las gnyis po de nyi zla lta bur 'byung ngo*// de ltar smon pa byang chub sems kyi rgyu 'bras skor cig la smon pa'i smon pa/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chen po la// nga khyod ji 'dra bar gyur cig par smon lam btab nas smon pa'i 'jug pa bskal ba grangs med dang po bslabs pas/ smon pa'i don dam/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chen po ci 'dra bar sangs rgyas nas/ dang po 'dul ba gsung*/ bar du mdo sde gsungs// bsod nams bsags pa can rnams la gsang sngags sde snod bzhi pa gsungs/ mya ngan las mda' khar mngon pa gsungs/ de nas dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis la gyad kyi yul du mya ngan 'da' khar mngon pa gsungs nas/ 'khor rnams la zhu rgyu yod pa rnams nga la zhus shig 'dri rgyu yod pa rnams nga la dris cig sang nas khyed rnams la dri sa med do gsungs pas/

byams pa la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams spros pa chod pas ci yang mi smra bas/ legs so// nga la dri rgyu med pa la legs so gsungs nas dgyes so// de nas thub pa mya ngan las 'da' ba nged kyis mi bzod zer nas/ sru skye dgu'i bdag mo nyan thos lnga brgya dang bcas pa mya ngan las 'das/ shā ri'i bu grong na la rgyur dgra bcom pa brgyad khri brgyad stong dang bcas nas mya ngan las 'das/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu rang gi grong shing thag can du dgra bcom pa bdun khri bdun stong dang bcas nas rang gi lus las me 'bar nas mya ngan las 'das so// de nas phyogs bcu'i zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams phyag la byon te/ lho phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' dmigs med rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i dpang du rdzus skyes su mdzad nas byon nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'gro bar yab la zhus pas/ 'dir ci 'dod pa la longs spyod/ ma 'gro zer/ byang chub sems dpa' dmigs med na re/ 'dod pa khyi dang phag pa dang*// wa dang bong bu 'dod spyod kyi// sangs rgyas mi spyod nyan thos min// gsung nas phyag la byon pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ kun dga' bo la byang chub sems dpa' dmigs med la phyag tshol cig nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu/ khyod lha dang mi thams cad kyi phyag gi gnas su 'gyur ro// lus btud cig nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu mi ma yin pa thams cad khyod la 'dud par 'gyur ro// gdan thengs shig nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu gdan rnam pa bcu thob par 'gyur ro gsung*/ de nas srod la sum cu rtsa gsum du byon nas dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' brtul/ de nas mar byon nas mu stegs kun tu rgyu rab bzang brtul/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis la bya'i lo/ smin drug zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nam gung*/ zla ba ri rtser nub pa dang mya ngan las 'das so// de nas kun dga' bo la sogs kyis sku gdung ras yug lnga brgyas dril/
de nas srin bal gyis dril/ de nas yang ras yug lnga brgyas g.yol nas/ lcags kyi sgrom bur bzhugs/ til gyi mar khus bkang nas me la bzhen

bsregs pa pas 'bar du ma btub bo// de nas 'phags pa 'od srung rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri pi pa la'i phug na bzhugs pas/ sangs rgyas dang mjal bar 'dod pas ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas rim gyis bltas pas gang na yang mi bzhugs par 'dug nas/ gyad gyi yul du mya ngan las 'das pa shes te/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra la de byas nas byon pas lam du 'khor lnga brgya 'dus pas rnams dang 'grogs nas byon pas/ lam du rgan zhugs cig dang 'phrad pas/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pas khyod mi 'gro'am byas pas kho na re/ sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das nas su// bslab dang slob pa'i bcas pa med// mgo bag gdugs dang 'dra bar 'gyur// da ni bag yangs ci dgar spyod// zer nas kho dga' 'dug pas/ 'di'i zer lugs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub tu 'gro bar 'dug pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka'i bsdu ba byed dgos par 'dug snyam nas byon pas/ gyad kyi yul du 'phags pa ma 'gags pa dang*/ kun dga' bo la sogs pa rnams dang mjal zhing*/ sangs rgyas ji ltar sku gshegs pa'i gtam rnams gsungs so// de nas 'phags pa 'od bsrungs kyis sku gdung la zhabs zhus/ srin bal dang ras spos nas/ ras srin bal stong gis sku gdung dril nas til mar gyis bkang bas me rang 'bar du song*/ ring bsrel ma gā dha'i khal stong byon pas cha brgyad du bgos nas/ cha gcig ni grong khyer rtswa can pa rnams la byin/ cha gnyis pa ni yul sdig pa can gyi gyad rnams la byin/ cha gsum pa ni rtogs pa yod pa'i rgyal po rigs bu lu gu la byin/ cha bzhi pa ni grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal rigs tro ta la byin/ cha lnga pa ni khab 'jug gling gi bram ze la byin/ cha drug pa ni ser skya'i rgyal rigs shākya rnams la byin/ cha bdun pa ni yul yangs pa can gyi rgyal rigs li tsa byi rnams la byin/ cha brgyad pa ni yul yangs pa can gyi blon po sna chen po la gtogs pa'i bram ze dbyar byed la byin/

gang gi sku gdung bcug pa'i bum pa de bram ze bre'o dang mnyam pa la byin no// tshems che ba dang po ni sum cu rtsa gsum du gdan drangs so// gnyis pa ni tshe 'dzin gyi grong khyer yid 'ong du gdan grangs so// gsum pa ni ka ling ka'i rgyal po'i yul du gdan drangs so// bzhi pa ni klu'i yul tu gdan drangs so// gdung sol ba rnams bram ze n+ya gro ta la byin no// de nas gdan sa 'phags pa 'od srungs kyis mdzad nas/ bka'i bsdu ba mdzad dgos dgongs nas/ gnas rgyal po'i khab/ pi pa la'i phug tu rgyal po ma skyes dgras dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i gnas mal dang 'tsho ba sbyar nas bka'i bsdu ba mdzad pas/ dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dpang por bzhag dgos pa la/ gnyis pa thems nas gcig 'phags pa ba lang bdag sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i yul nas gdan 'dren du btang bas ma byon/ gcig 'phags pa kun dga' bo mdo sde thams cad khong gi thugs la yod pas khong dgos pa la/ khong gis dgra bcom pa ma thob pas/ khong sgrub pa la bskul ba la khong rgyal rigs yin pas zhi bas mi thul bas/ drag pos 'dul bar dgongs nas/ skyo ba chen po brgyad kyis bcos te/ 'phags pa 'od bsrungs kyis gtso byas pa'i dgra bcom pa rnams kyis 'phags pa kun dga' bo la khyod nged tsho'i nang du ma sdod par song zhig bcom ldan 'das la bdud kyis mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa'i dus su khyod la bcom ldan 'das kyis dris pas/ khyod kyis bzhugs par ma zhus par kha rog bsdad pas/ da khyod 'dir ma sdod par song zhig bcom ldan 'das la chu rnyog ma can drangs pas khyod 'dir ma sdod par song zhig bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gos rdog pa'i 'og tu bcug nas btsems pas khyod 'dir ma sdod par song zhig gzhan yang khyod kyi sru skye dgu'i bdag mo rab tu phyung bas bstan pa lnga brgya phrag gcig 'gribs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba'i gnas bud med la bstan pa dang*/

bslab pa'i gzhi phra mo la zhu ba ma byas pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku lus gser btso ma'i mdog 'dra ba gzhan la rdzogs par bstan pa dang*/ khyod kyi bcom ldan 'das lo nyi shu lhag tu bsten kyang dgra bcom pa ma thob pas 'dir ma sdod par song zhig byas nas 'bri rdzi'i phug tu bskrad nas btang ngo*// der byon nas 'bri rdzi'i bu la chos bstan nas dgra bcom pa thob pas/ mkhan po dgra bcom pa thob bam ma thob snyam nas bltas pas ma thob par 'dug pas/ go'u tam khyod ni bag med ma mdzad par// shing drung dben pa brten la sgrub pa bgyis// ring por mi thogs dgra bcom thob par 'gyur// byas nas skul pas/ kun dga' bos sgrub pa mdzad pas dgra bcom pa thob nas mngon shes kyis bltas pas/ dgra bcom pa rnams kyis byams pas sgrub pa la bskul ba'i phyir bskrad par 'dug nas/ dpon slob gnyis pos rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkhar byon nas pi pa la'i phug tu dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i nang du gshegs so// de rnams kyi rnam sbyar lnga brgya'i steng du bzhugs te/ mdo sde rnams thugs nas ston nas bsdus so// de nas yang rnam sbyar lnga brgya'i steng du nye ba 'khor byon nas 'dul ba rnams bsdus so// de nas yang rnam sbyar lnga brgya'i steng du 'od bsrungs byon nas mya ngan las 'das pa mngon pa bsdus so// sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi dbyar de nas bka'i bsdu ba byas/ bdag gis bu'i bya ba byas so snyam pas bstan pa kun dga' bo la gtad de// 'phags pa 'od srungs ri kha ba can gsum la rdzu 'phrul gyi byon nas 'gog pa mya ngan las 'das so// de nas kun dga' bos bstan pa bzung ste/ slob ma nyi ma gung pa la sogs pa dgra bcom pa mang po byon no// de nas kun dga' bos bstan pa dgra bcom pa bram ze nyi ma gung la gtad nas 'phags pa kun dga' bo chu bo gaṅgā'i steng du rang nyid kyi lus la me byung nas mya ngan las 'das so// bram ze nyi ma gung gis sha na'i ras can la gtad/

des 'phags pa nyer sbas la gtad nas slob mar dgra bcom pa mang po byon no// sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas bstan pa lo lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas pa las// de la dus tshod bzhi ru byung*/ dus re la lo lnga brgya phrag gsum gsum yod/ lnga brgya phrag dang po la dgra bcom pa yong*/ gnyis pa la rgyun tu zhugs pa 'ong*/ gsum pa la phyir mi 'ong ba 'ong*/ de gsum 'bras bu'i dus so// de nas mngon par rtogs pa'i dus la yang gsum las/ dang po lhag pa'i shes rab 'byung*/ gnyis pa la lhag pa'i sems 'byung*/ gsum pa la lhag pa'i tshul khrims 'byung ngo*// de nas lung gi dus la yang gsum/ lnga brgya phrag dang po la mngon pa 'byung*/ gnyis pa la mdo sde 'byung*/ gsum pa la 'dul ba 'byung bar gsungs/ lnga brgya phrag phyi ma la rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub pa'i dus yin gsung*/ de'i dus su dgra bcom pa des pa bya ba/ 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa 'byung bar gsung*/ sde snod gsum pa slob ma can bya ba 'khor brgya dang bcas pa 'byung*/ de gnyis gcig mkhas pas ngas gso sbyong byed dgos zer/ gcig dgra bcom pa yin pas ngas gso sbyong byed dgos zer nas mi 'cham par/ 'khor rnams phan tshun byas nas dge 'dun gcig kyang mi 'ong*/ de'i dus su rgyal po dpung dmar can bya ba dad pa dang ldan pa zhig 'byung bas/ dge 'dun med pas mya ngan byed do// sa la kha bub tu nyal nas ldang bar mi nus so// de'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub pas skra gzhar ba yang mi phed/ gos ser por mi 'gro bas/ blon po shes rab dang ldan pas mgo mes bshur/ ba dmar gyi ko ba byon nas/ rgyal po chen po yar longs la bla mchod rnams byon nas yod byas pas/ rgyal po snyam na rab tu byung ba yin snyam nas bltas pas/ mgo mes bshur ba/ ba dmar glang dmar gyi ko ba gyon nas 'dug pa mthong bas/ da sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub nas 'dug snyam nas/

rgyal po mya ngan gyis grongs nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su skyes par gyur to// de nas sprul sku 'di'i bstan pa mi 'byung ngo*// de rnams sprul pa'i sku'i bstan pa tshad can la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin no// sangs rgyas kyi yon tan phrin las ni ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar du thugs bskyed pas/ de srid du sangs rgyas mya ngan las mi 'da'/ chos mi nub/ dge 'dun dkon mchog rgyun mi 'chad ces gsungs so// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi'i dpung pa las/ smon pa skor cig gi 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //da 'jug pa rgyu la dam 'cha' bar tshad med bstan par bya ste/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems la yang gsum ste/ 'jug pa'i smon pa/ 'jug pa'i 'jug pa/ 'jug pa'i don dam gsum/ sangs rgyas kyis bskal pa grangs med par longs spyod pa yin te/ dang po tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po las skyes pa 'jug pa'i smon pa ni/ sems can thams cad ma dga' ba dga' bar bya/ ma grol ba sgrol bar bya/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bya/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya snyam pa de 'jug pa'i smon pa tshad med pa yin/ 'o na smon pa'i smon pa dang khyad ci yod snyam na/ smon pa'i smon pa ni tshad can pa rang gcig pu sangs rgyas 'di gcig pu 'dra ba zhig bya snyam pa dang*/ sdom pa bar ma len pa'i dus su/ shākya thub pa/ shākya seng ge/ shākya'i rgyal po/ bstan pa'i gtso bo de rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag rab tu byung ste/ snyam du smon pa de smon pa tshad can yin/ 'di 'jug pa'i smon pa tshad med yin gsung*/ de gnyis mi 'dra/ gcig sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas thob par smon pa med/ rang nyid gcig pu sangs rgyas de 'dra zhig thob par smon pa yin/ 'jug pa'i smon pa ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du smon pa yin/

de sems can thams cad la tshad med pas tshad med yin no// da 'jug pa'i 'jug pa ni/ de'i ched du sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba yod tshad pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis mdzad tshad la 'khor ba ma stong bar du lus ngag yid gsum po 'di dge ba la skad cig kyang btang snyoms su ma lus par bkol ba yin/ de'i 'bras bu 'jug pa'i don dam longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'byung ba yin/ sku cig gis nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi don byed na yang der ston nus pa sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ lha'i bzo bo bi shwa karmas shākya'i sku tshad bya snyam nas/ zhabs kyi mthe bong nas rin po che'i thig gus/ dbu'i gtsug tor la mnyam pas/ dbu'i gtsug tor mthor song nas steng gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams na yar song nas dbu'i gtsug tor ma mthong bas/ tshad byar ma tub pa yin no// sku mang pos 'dul ba yang*/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los sems can gyi bsam pa dang bstun nas/ mang por ston pa yin/ dper na nyi ma gcig la sems can re res chu snod re re bzung na/ de'i nang du nyi ma re re 'byung ba yin/ chu snod med pa la nyi ma mi 'byung*/ dad pa med pas sangs rgyas mi mthong ba yin/ chos rje sgam po pas dus gcig la sku gsum du bstan nas rab gnas kha gsum du mdzad pa yin/ chos rje phag mo gru pas maṇḍal phul nas/ sku gsum du bstan pa lags sam zhus pas/ dge bshes khams pa ngas sems can re re'i mdun du sku brgya brgya ston kyang nus gsung*/ chos rje 'bri gung dus gcig la sku bzhir bstan pa yin/ mtshan nyid kyis 'dul ba rnam par snang mdzad du bstan nas ye shes ngo sprod pa yin/ bde mchog gi 'dul ba la bde mchog tu bstan nas ye shes ngo sprod pa yin te/ stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/

smon pa med pa dang*/ mngon par 'du byed pa dang po nas med pa'i brdar zhal bzhir byon pa yin no// spyan gsum ni dus gsum mkhyen pa yang stong par rtogs pa'i brdas ngo sprod yin/ mche ba bzhi ni sems stong par rtogs pas bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i brda/ dbu sku ral pa'i thor tshugs ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus par rdzogs nas dang po nas stong par rtogs pa'i brda/ thod pa skam po lnga ni ye shes lnga stong par ngo sprod pa'i brda/ spyi bor zla ba phyed pa ni byang sems rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel ba ngo sprod pa'i brda/ spyi bo rdo rje rgya gram ni phrin las bzhi dang stong pa zung 'jug tu ngo sprod pa'i brda/ sku mdog nag po ni byams pa dang stong pa zung du 'jug dgos pa'i brda/ spyan rtsa dmar zlum pa ni sems can gyi don la chags pa'i brda/ khros shing gnyer ma gyen du gnyer ba ni ye shes kyi spangs bya nyon mongs pa bcom pa'i brda/ yab yum zhal sbyor du bzhugs pa ni ye shes tha mi dad pa'i brda/ yab kyi phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa ni ye shes kyi chos nyid dbyings yul du byed dgos pa'i brda/ phyag g.yon dang pos dril bu bsnams pa ni rten 'brel gyi chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i brda/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa ni ye shes lnga rgyud la skyes pa'i brda/ phyag bcu gnyis ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs las ldog pa'i brda/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon bsnams pa ni/ 'gro ba'i gti mug 'joms pa'i brda/ g.yon gyi gsum pas kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa ni byang chub kyi sems dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i brda/ g.yon gyi bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa ni thugs rje dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i brda/ g.yon pa lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa ni stong pa yang dag pa'i zhags pas sems can 'khor bar mi stong bar tshur sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gugs pa'i brda/

g.yon drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa ni thar pa thams cad kyi mchog sangs rgyas thob dgos pa'i brda/ g.yas gsum na ḍā ma ru bsnams pa ni skye ba med pa'i sgras sangs rgyas rnams sems can gyi don la skul ba'i brda/ g.yas bzhi pa na dgra st+wa bsnams pa ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyes pa bshags nas rgyun gcod pa'i brda/ g.yas lnga pa na gri gug bsnams pa ni dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad rgyun gcod pa'i brda/ g.yas drug pa rtse gsum bsnams pa ni 'dod khams kyi srid pa dang*/ gzugs khams kyi srid pa dang*/ gzugs med kyi khams kyi srid pa gcad nas stong par sangs rgyas la 'god pa'i brda/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa ni chos thams cad dang po nas med par rtogs pa'i brda/ zhabs g.yas pas 'jigs byed mnan pa ni rtag par lta ba'i mtha' las grol nas rtag par mi lta ba'i brda/ zhabs g.yon pas dus mtshan ma mnan pa ni chad par mi lta ba'i brda/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs ni/ byams pa dang stong par 'gro ba'i zhe sdang 'joms pa'i brda/ phyag gdub dpung rgyan ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ mgul rgyan tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i brda/ rna cha gdub 'khor bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ dbu rgyan dang 'khor lo nor bu brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ mchod phyir thog dang sku rags dang 'og pag zhabs dub gsum bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ thal ba'i rdul gyi gos pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu 'gro ba dang bas yid 'phrogs nas chos la 'dzud pa'i brda'o// mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu ni ā li kā li lnga bcu/ don dam dang kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad de gnyis kyis ston pa'i brda/ nyi ma'i gdan ni ma rig pa'i 'dam rdzab bskams nas/

byang chub kyi myu gu smin par byed pa'i brda/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan ni 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pa'i brda/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor thams cad zhal gcig tu 'dug pa ni stong pa nyid gcig pu yin pa'i brda/ skra grol ba ni chos thams cad gdod ma nas grol ba'i brda/ na bza' med pa sgrib pa med pa'i brda/ sku mdog dmar mor 'dug pa ni bde ba chen po yab la chags pa dang*/ thugs rjes sems can la chags pa'i brda/ gzhon nu ma lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu 'dug pa ni bde ba chen pos gang ba'i brda'o// rgyan la sogs pa rnams yab dang mthun pas yab bzhin shes par bya'o// de thams cad kyis lus ngag dge ba la bkol ba dang*/ dang po nas stong pa yin pas zung 'jug gcig pur ngo sprod du shar ba yin no// nam mkha'i steng gi sems can rnams 'dul ba la thugs kyi 'khor lo byon/ sa steng gi sems can rnams 'dul ba la gsung gi 'khor lo byon/ sa 'og gi sems can rnams 'dul ba la sku'i 'khor lo byon/ sna tshogs pa 'dul ba la dam tshig gi 'khor lo/ sna tshogs dang bde ba chen po'i lha tshogs su bstan nas dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs pa byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyis khrid nas ye shes ngo sprod/ sa phyed dang bcu gsum gyi dus su sangs rgyas gcig pur bstan nas chos sku yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gcig pur ngo sprod/ bden pa bzhis 'dul ba rnams la phyag rgya bzhi bstan nas ngo sprod/ bden pa gnyis 'dul ba rnams la zhabs gnyis su bstan nas gsang sngags brda gcig pus gdod ma nas sangs rgyas grub nas yod par ngo sprod pa yin no// gang la mos pa'i lha dang bla mar bstan nas ye shes ngo sprod pa yin no// sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' gcig pus 'dul na byang chub sems dpa' gcig pur bstan nas sangs rgyas ngo sprod/ nyan thos kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos su bstan nas ye shes ngo sprod/

mchog gi skye bos 'dul ba la mchog gi skye bor ston nas ye shes ngo sprod/ dud 'gros 'dul ba la dud 'gror bstan nas ye shes ngo sprod/ yi dwags kyis 'dul ba la yi dwags su bstan nas ye shes ngo sprod/ dmyal bas 'dul ba la dmyal bar bstan nas ye shes ngo sprod/ sas 'dul ba la sar ston/ chus 'dul ba la chur ston/ mes 'dul ba la mer ston/ rlung gi 'dul ba la rlung du ston/ nam mkhas 'dul ba la nam mkha' bstan nas sems skye med du ngo sprod/ de bzhin du gnyis pa la gsum par ston/ gsum pa la bzhi par ston/ bzhi pa lnga par ston/ lnga pa la drug par ston/ drug pa la bdun par ston/ bdun pa la brgyad par ston/ brgyad pa la dgu par ston/ dgu pa la bcu par ston/ sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad du bstan nas shes bya'i sgrib pa spong*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dag nas chos sku gcig tu gyur nas sangs rgyas so// rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa 'byung*/ yun 'khor ba ma stong bar du 'byung*/ ched du bya ba thams cad dang po nas sangs rgyas pa yin pa yin par ngo sprod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la 'god pa gcig pu'i ched du mdzad/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la 'god pa'i rgyu 'bras thams cad sku lus gcig rgyan la sogs pa rgyan dang cha lugs re re 'am/ sku cig gis kyang sems can thams cad dang po nas sangs rgyas yin par ston pa dang*/ bde ba dang stong pa zung 'jug yin par ston pa dang*/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad la zhing khams thams cad du skus khyab pa'i brdar rgyan cha lugs yod pa bzhin no// bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bskal pa grangs med pa la thugs ye shes gcig pur shar ba'i rgyu 'bras yin no// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi dpung pa las 'jug pa byang chub sems kyi 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas 'jug pa de don dam du na 'phos nas/

bskal pa grangs med phyi ma la bcom ldan 'das bskal pa grangs med phyi ma'i dus su byang chub sems dpa' bram ze'i khye'u sprin du gyur pa'i dus su don dam gyi smon pa skye ste/ 'khor 'das kyi bzung 'dzin thams cad stong par 'dug pas/ sems can thams cad stong par rtog med cig tu song na dga' ba la snyam pa de don dam gyi smon pa yin/ de nas don dam pa stong pa gcig pur thugs bskyed nas/ sa brgyad kyi rtogs pa skyes bu dbang po lnga dang rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad do// stong pa gcig pur 'jug pa de don dam gyi 'jug pa yin/ de'i 'bras bu don dam gyi don dam ni/ rang nyid sgom med du song nas 'khor 'das dang snod bcud thams cad stong par rtog med cig tu song nas/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras dbyer med/ byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med/ 'khor 'das dbyer med nam mkha' blo 'das zhig tu song ba de don dam yin no// nam mkha' de chos sku yin no// gdul byas gsol ba gang btab 'byung ba de sems can gdul bya des sems ma rtogs bar du yon tan ster ba de sprul sku yin no// gdul bya'i sems rtogs nas ye shes gcig pur ngo sprod pa longs sku yin no// de gsum gcig par stong nyid rgyu 'bras dbyer med pa de ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin no// chos sku nam mkha' stong pa ni lha'i nor bu rin po che dang 'dra'o// gzugs sku gnyis ni de 'jug pa'i snod dang 'dra'o// gzugs sku gnyis la mos pa de la mos pa dang 'dra'o// gzugs sku gnyis chos sku rtogs par byed pa'i thabs las grub pa yin no// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gyi bye ma snyed tshangs pa'i gnas man chad byung bur bkang nas bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du dad pas mchod pa lhag ma ma lus par byas pa bas/

sems can thams cad stong pa nyid chos sku thob par bya ba'i phyir/ chos sku stong pa nyid thun cig bsgom/ kha 'don byed dam yi ger 'dri ba'i bsod nams kyi brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro/ stong gi char yang*/ brgya stong gi char yang*/ bye ba'i char yang*/ bye ba brgya stong gi char yang*/ bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro/ dper yang mi 'gro/ chos kun gdod ma nas chos sku byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbye ba med pa rtog med gcig pu'i ngang la btang bar bya'o// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi'i dpung pa las/ don dam sems bskyed kyi 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o/ //de ltar smon pa byang chub kyi sems tshad med pa de'i 'bras bu longs sku'i rten can gyi 'bras bu sprul sku'i bstan pa gnas lugs dang*/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems tshad med pas de'i 'bras bu longs sku'i bstan pa rgya dang yul tshad med par bstan pa dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems kyis 'khor 'das ma skyes pa nam mkhar sems bskyed pa de'i 'bras bu 'khor 'das thams cad nam mkha'i yon tan phrin las can du song ba rgyun chad med pa yin no// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi'i dpung pa las gnas tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //'jug pa'i bsngo ba bya ba ni/ thos pa ri rab tsam byas pa'i shes rab yod kyang*/ sgom pa'i shes rab nyung 'bru tsam la 'dud dgos/ thos pa rgya mtsho tsam byas kyang*/ nyams myong ba glang gi smig rjes tsam la 'dud dgos/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ong gis thos pa mtha' med pa byas pa'i dge bshes yin yang*/ chos rje rin po che sgom chen pa gcig la 'dud dgos pa 'byung ba yin/ thos pas dregs pa'i bla ma ngad phu ba yang chos rje la 'dud pas grub pa thob pa yin/ 'dul 'dzin gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpal thag ma bas kyang chos rje la 'dud pas grub pa thob pa yin/

rgyud mkhan dpal shi ri phug pa dang*/ bla ma dus 'khor ba dang*/ dge bshes jo nubs la sogs pas kyang chos rje sgom chen pa zhig la 'dud pas grub pa thob pa yin/ do ha mkhan po bla ma bal pos kyang chos rje la 'dud pas grub pa thob pa yin/ chos rje phag mo gru pa brgya dang bcu bzhi'i chos shes pa zhig gis chos rje sgam po pa sgom pa zhig la 'dud dgos par byung ba yin/ ma sgom par bslab pa gcig pus 'chi tsa na 'gyod pa skye ba rngog blo ldan shes rab lta bu 'byung ba yin/ phal chen las/ ji ltar long ba ri mo mkhan// ri mo legs par bris lags kyang*// rang gi mthong bar mi 'gyur bas// ma bsgom chos kyang de bzhin no// ji ltar 'on pa rol mo mkhan// rol mo legs par dkrol lags kyang*// rang gis thos par mi 'gyur bas// ma bsgom chos kyang de bzhin no// ji ltar bu ram mngar ba'i ro// brjod pas ro ni mi myong ste// myangs pas ro ni myong bar 'gyur// de bzhin stong pa nyid kyi sgra// thos pas ro ni mi myong ste// bsgoms pas ro ni myong bar 'gyur// zhes gsung*/ de nas byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dbye ba med pa'i stong pa nyid de dang po thos dgos/ de nas ma brjed par dgos/ de nas sgom dgos pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bong gi khyed mkhas pa zhig gis/ nged sgom chen pa la dad cing gus pa dang*/ gdung ba'i shugs kyis chos zhu ba 'di rig pa min kyang*/ shes pa'i mthar sgom pa la thug pa yin pas/ dpal phag mo gru pas gsungs pa'i chos/ theg pa chen po'i tshul zhes kyang bya/ bdud rtsi'i dpung pa zhes kyang bya 'di khyed la zab nas bstan pas/ spyi gtsug gi rgyan du thogs nas/ rang yang 'di la sgom par zhu/ gzhan la yang 'di ston par zhu gsungs/ 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'byar ba'i rdul tsam yang spyi bos len pa'i mos gus can/ bla ma'i gsung la gces par 'dzin pa'i shākya'i sras kyi bsod snyoms pa/

sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis dang ldan pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i ri khrod pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos rje rin po che 'bri khung pa'i chos 'khor gsum gyi snying po byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa 'di bris pas/ 'gal ba dang 'khrul pa byung na bla ma dkon mchog la bzod par gsol lo/ gegs sel bdud rtsi dpung pa 'di gsungs pa'i bsod nams kyis mtshon nas/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces pa'am yid la mi byed pa'i ngang nas bsngo ba byed pa des mjug gi don bstan pa'o// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi dpung pa las/ mjug gi don zhus lugs dang*/ bzod gsol dang*/ bsngo ba bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gcig pa'o// de ltar klad kyi don shis par brjod pa dang*/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang gsum gyis klad kyi don bstan nas/ gzhung gi don la/ rgyu mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ltar nyams su blangs pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa ltar nyams su blangs pa gnyis kyis/ gzhung gi don bstan to// chos kyi zhus lugs dang*/ 'gal 'khrul bzod par gsol ba dang*/ byang chub tu bsngo ba dang gsum gyi mjug gi don bstan to// de la rgyas par le'i nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstan to// gegs sel bdud rtsi'i dpung pa zhes bya ba spyan snga rin po ches yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// //

dam chos bdud rtsi'i dpung pa 'di// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje yis// gtsug lag bzhengs pa'i brag sko'i dus// las kyi chos su gsungs pa'i dus// rje spyan snga rin po ches yi ger bkod nas/ phyis dpal gyi phag mo grur tshogs chos su gsungs pa yin no// 821) ༄// zhal gyi gdams pa bdud rtsi dri ma med pa'i snying po// oṃ swasti/ rje lhun grub 'od gsal chos kyi sku// zung 'jug bde chen lhan cig skyes// mi zad sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /mnyam med rin po che la 'dud// rje kun tu snang ba bkod pa'i dpal// rgya chen dbang phyug chos kyi mdzod// spros med zhi ba'i ngang la bzhugs// bde gshegs chos kyi rje la 'dud// rje byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin nyid// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin rtag pa'i sku// kun mkhyen ye shes kun gzigs pa// brtse chen 'gro ba'i mgon la 'dud/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi gtam// 'dzam gling gangs can bod yul dbus// phyogs bcu'i zhing nas 'dus pa yi// rgyas sras rgya mtsho brten pa'i gnas// 'og min dpal gyi 'bri gung gi// rin chen chos kyi pho brang na// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che// mi 'jigs seṅge'i khri steng du// mi g.yo mnyam gzhag lhan ne bzhugs// dri med zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi// mtshan mchog dung gi tshems bar nas// ljags kyi dbang po brkyang mdzad de// zab cing rgya che dam pa'i chos// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gsung*// //thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad gang du don 'dus pa dang snying por gyur pa gang yin snyam na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// 'di ltar ston pa thugs rje can// skyob pa shākya'i rgyal po de// sngon tshad med snying rje chen po yis// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de// bskal pa grangs med mtha' yas par// rab tu 'bad pa'i brtson grus kyis// bya dka' bsam gyis mi khyab cing*// rlabs chen spyod pa dpag med pa'i// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad// lam pha rol phyin bcu mthar phyin te// sa bcu la gnas tshogs gnyis rdzogs// mgon po rgyal ba 'od bsrungs kyis// rgyal tshab skyes bu dam pa de// 'jig rten rnam par ma zhi ba// 'dren pa rnams kyis spangs pa'i zhing*// lta ba log pas dkrugs pa'i gnas// snyigs ma lnga ldan 'jig rten 'dir// gzigs pa rnam pa lngas gzigs te// yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lhums su zhugs// limbi yi ni nags tshal du// skyes bu gzhon nu bltams pa dang*// gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa dang*// btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol ba ste// nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu bzhugs// grong khyer ser skya'i sgo bzhi ru// rgas nad 'chi ba gzigs pa yi// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// thugs skyo ba skyes nas rab tu gshegs// nai rañdzā na'i klung 'gram du// lo drug dka' ba spyad pa'i mthar// dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga la// byang chub snying por bzhugs nas kyang*// gnyug ma byams chen ting 'dzin gyi// srod la bdud kyi sde bcom ste// tho rangs shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la// chags thogs med pa'i ye shes brnyes// rang byung rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma la// mi mjed bdag po tshangs chen gyis// bla med chos kyi 'khor lo de// bskor bar bskul ma rgya chen btab// wa ra ṇā sir gshegs nas kyang*// drang srong lhung ba'i gnas su byon// thub pas lnga sde bzang po la// bka' bden pa bzhi yi 'khor lo bskor// der gdul bya smin dang grol mdzad cing*// rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa las// rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du byon// bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la// bka' mtshan ma med pa'i 'khor lo bskor// mnyan yod gnas dang bad sa la// gnas khyad du 'phags pa du ma dang*// rtsa mchog grong khyer la sogs par// nges don gtan la phab pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pas// dpag med gdul bya'i skye bo rnams// byang chub rnam pa gsum la bkod// mgon po thams cad mkhyen pa des// spyir gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud tshod dang*// khams dang bsam pa ji bzhin du// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kyang*// gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te// sde snod rin chen rnam gsum yin// don nyams len bslab pa gsum du 'dus// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che// mnyam med bla ma'i zhal snga nas// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ma lus thams cad rang gi sems// sems skye med nam mkha' lta bu zhes// yang dang yang du gsungs pa 'di// thub pa'i dam chos ma lus pa'i// gnad dang don gyi snying po yin// gzhi rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems// de'i rjes 'brangs khyad du 'dzin pa'i chos// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las// dog dang mi dog gang gis kyang*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// bsgral bar nus pa ma yin te// srid pa gsum 'dir rgyun du 'khor// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems de nyid// skye ba med par rtogs pa'i tshe// 'du byed 'khor ba'i 'byung khungs la// nyams dang lhung dang 'jigs par mthong*// khams gsum po 'di yi 'dod chags spangs// 'du 'dzi'i spyod pas dben pa yi// nags khrod bas mtha' bsten nas kyang*// yang srid med pa'i gnas su 'jug

/kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems// gnyis med dbye ba med pa yi// lus ngag yid kyi las rnams kyis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog la bkod// 'di bdag rkyen chos kyi dbyings nyid dang*// gzhan rkyen sems can ma zad tshe// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsung thugs nyid bsam mi khyab// de mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yin// rang sems shes rab pha rol phyin// 'khor 'das yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// don dam phyag rgya chen po de// bla ma'i mos gus kyis rtogs pa yin// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu// byang chub sems su nges pa'i phyir// ma nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can gyi// don du byang chub sems bskyed pas// bsam pa de yi lus su 'gyur// byang chub sems kyi mi mthun phyogs// 'gal rkyen spang zhing mthun rkyen bsgrub// 'bras bu stobs bcu thob pa de// tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin// byang chub sems gnyis tshul khrims dang*// chos rnam pa gsum po 'di nyid las// zab pa'i dam chos bdag la med// khyod kyis 'di gsum bzung zhig ces// bka' stsal bka' nan chen po mdzad// //bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi dge ba tha dad du yod pa yin nam snyam na/ yang khams gsum rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon// thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs pa des// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin gyis// 'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal bskyed// de bas 'di ni spang bya ste// nyon mongs med cing de yi las// 'bras bu lha mi'i bde skyid dang*// byang chub rnam gsum thob pa'i phyir// rjes 'brang sras la bsgrub byar gsungs// 'di babs dang gshis kyi gnas tshul de// mkhyen cing gzigs pas sras rnams la// bslab pa bcas par mdzad pa las// sems can gzhan la nyes med pa'i// bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba// ci gsung bka' stsal mi 'da' zhing*// nye zhing brtse ba'i slob ma la// sgos byur du nyes pa bkal ba min// sems can rnams kyis ma shes pas// gti mug ma rig mun par 'thoms// sred pa'i zhags pas bcings pa rnams// nyes spyod spyad pas 'khor bar lhung*// da rung thar bar ma gyur pas// bu 'di dag 'byung bar byed pa'i rgyu// nyes pa mi mthun phyogs spongs shig

/'di lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yin// don rang rgyud la skyes pa'i nyon mongs 'di// spong bar byed pa'i thabs yin te// rgyas par phye bas nyis brgya dang*// lnga bcu'i rnam par dbye bar gsungs// de la kha cig 'di skad ces// de ltar 'gro ba spyir bcas na// dud 'gro la 'bral ba'i ltung ba dang*// lhung bzed sa la mi bzhag pa// tha mal spyod pas mtshungs zhes pa// tha mal byis pa thams cad kyis// lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa kun// nyon mongs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las// 'di dag pa'i bslab par gsungs pa yin// de yang thub pa'i zhal snga nas// sngon 'jig rten chags par gyur pa'i tshe// tshe dang bsod nams bzang po yis// 'od gsal gyi lha rnams gling 'dir lhung*// sa yi bcud dang sa yi zhag /myu gu'i tshal dang sa lu la// gsog 'jog byas pas rku ba dang*// chos dang mi mthun pa'i spyod pa byung*// des 'od med bem po'i lus su gyur// mkha' la 'gro bar ma nus shing*// kha dog bzang ngan byung ba dang*// bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa yis// je ngan je sdug du thal nas kyang*// las ngan gyi mtha' rgyas ngan 'gro byung*// de lta bas na dge slong dag /rnyed bkur gsog 'jog spang bar bya// de bzhin mi tshangs spyod pa dang*// ma byin len dang smod pa dang*// kha zas kyi ro la chags pa spang*// rgyal po chen po nga las nus// gling bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum gyi// brgya byin lha yi dbang po yi// stan phyed kyis ma ngoms gsod sems skyes// skad cig gis sa yi steng du lhung*// de bas sdong dum mes tshig la'ang*// ngan sems bskyed par mi bya zhing*// 'dod la ngoms pa yod med pas// de bas 'dod yon spang bar gsungs// de phyir chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi// lus ngag mi dge bdun yin pas// mkhas pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig gis// spong bdun 'khor dang bcas pa zer// 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral dang*// zhe sdang gti mug de bzhin te// sems dang shes rab rnam grol bar// 'dul ba'i sde snod du rgya cher gsungs// gar yod cha med kyi kha rgyugs la// bye brag gi bshad mdzod chen mo de// rgya gar yul na yod do skad// nyan thos dgra bcom thams cad pas// thub pa chen po mkhyen pa che// nged ston pa de yi rjes su 'brangs// de gsung 'dul ba bsdus pa ni// sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa zhes// mdo rgyud rnams su yang dang yang*// nan tan chen pos gdams pa de// da dung khyed kyis ma thos sam// slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis kyang*// 'du shes gtso zhes mi gsung ngam// 'di na khyed rang res 'ga' zhig

/ltung ba sde lnga'i khyad par 'di// nyon mongs che 'bring gi bye brag du// dang por dam bca' khas len mdzad// 'dul ba gleng bzhis bshad do zhes// mkhas pa kun gyis smra na yang*// 'phros pa dang nying 'phros la sogs par// dge dang mi dge 'dres ma'i las// rgyu de las 'bras bu 'di 'byung bas// rnam par gnag dang 'dres ma'i las// thams cad spang bar bya ba ste// dud 'gro rnams kyis legs spyad pa// cung zad yin yang bde ba yi// rnam smin 'bras bu 'byung ba'i phyir// gcig tu dge ba'i las rnams la// bslab par bya zhes yang dang yang*// thub mgon shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs// bu gcig rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// gshis kyi dge dang mi dge dang*// bcas dang rang bzhin gcig pa 'di// rgyal ba'i gsung nyid yin mod kyang*// tshig gi rjes su 'brangs pa min// gcig pur bsgrub pa byas pa yis// bde sdug mtho dman byung ba la// nyams len man ngag gnad rnams kyis// nyams su blangs pas nyes skyon dag /yon tan go rtogs myong ba skye// shin tu zab pa'i dam chos kyis// 'di 'ong bar nges so thugs la zhog/ //'khor 'das kyi 'dug lugs ji lta bu yin snyam na/ spyir thub pa chen pos gsungs pa'i chos// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas lugs 'di// sems can rnams kyi 'dug lugs yin// de ma go rtogs par ma gyur pas// rgyu rkyen glo bur du tshogs pa yin// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rtog pa skyes// 'di gti mug brtag pa'i log rtog la// 'dod cing chags pas bdag gzhan du// 'dzin pa de las 'dod chags dang*// zhe sdang gti mug skyes gyur te// yul lnga'i rjes su dbang po 'brangs// sred pa'i 'ching bas rgyun du 'khor// don med sdug bsngal mang po myong*// phung byed dgra bo mi bzad pa// mi gtsang lus 'dis gos gos nas// mi rtog dur khrod kyi nang du 'jug

/'di 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin// bu 'khor ba 'di las skyob pa'i skyabs// bla med byang chub chen po de// rang gi sems kyi de bzhin nyid// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yin// 'di gnas dang grogs dang bla mas kyang*// bskyed par nus pa ma yin te// bdag 'dzin gyi rtog pa skyes pa yis// ngo bo shes pa ma gtogs pa'i// mi rtog sgom rgyu yod pa min// 'di goms par byed pa'i man ngag gis// 'ching byed 'dzin pa las grol phyir// thub pa'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa dang*// nan tan chen pos 'bad par bya// yul gang la 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de// skye med rig par go ba la// chos kyi sgo zhes brjod pa yin// rtog 'dzin btang ba'i sbyin pa la// ngo bo lhun grub tshul khrims so// de la mi bzod med pa dang*// rtsol ba spangs pa'i brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan ting 'dzin de bsgom pa// de nyid shes pa shes rab yin// lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kun// mi rtog lhun grub du gnas pa de// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mkha' ltar rnam dag yin zhes gsungs// //byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas mi dge ba spyad pa'i 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung snyam na/ rgyu dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas// lam pha rol phyin drug spyad pa yis// 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob// phrin las bsgrub par 'dod pa dag /lam du ma zhugs mkha' la lding*// mi 'grub srog ni rab tu gcod// bsam pa bzang po'i rjes 'brangs nas// sbyor ba drag po'i las gyis kyang*// yun ring sdug bsngal myong 'gyur te// skye ba lnga brgya la sogs pa// byang chub thob pa'i rgyu 'gro ba// thar pa nag pos log par spyad// 'bras bu mi bzad smin gyur te// 'bras bus mi bzad gdug par skyes// rdo rje 'dzin pas gsol ba yis// sgrib sbyangs rnam dag sa la gnas// zhing rnam dag dkon mchog gsum po la// 'brel bas bde ba gsungs pa de// gnod pas ma yin bshags pa dang*// 'gyod pas dge la spyad pa'i mthu// rgyal po dpa' bas sbyin lta bu// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// dag dang ma dag rim pa yis// 'bras bu mtha' dag bslu ba med// zhing dang dngos po dag gyur kyang*// bsam pa dman zhing zhan na go// 'bras bu cung zad smin gyur te// lhag ma chu shing snying po 'dra// zhing dang bsam pa dag na yang*// dngos po ngan pa'i 'bras bu de// phyis mi dge ba rlabs po che// 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i rkyen du 'gyur// dge ba spyad pa'i 'bras bu de// rtsad nas zad dang mi zad pa// rang gi bsam pa'i sa la gnas// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa gang*// mi bzad las kyis mi gnod pa// gdug la byams par mi bya ste// bsgral ba'i zhing de bsgral nas kyang*// sems ni sangs rgyas gnas su spar// lus tshogs kyi 'khor lor byas pas kyang*// ji ltar byas pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*// sgrol byed yakṣa he ru kas// gdug pa gsol ba'i 'bras bu de// mi bsrun 'khor rnams dngangs shing brgyal// bcom ldan nyes pa kun spangs pa// sgrib pa gsum dang bral na yang*// rgyu las 'bras bu nges 'byung ste// 'khor dang bye brag med gyur pas// mya ngan sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur// nyon mongs dug gsum rgyal ba'i rigs// chos skur gsal bas he ru kaḥ

/de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis// nyes pa spang zhing legs pa bsgrub// rang gzhan kun la phan par bya// //chos kyi 'khor lo gsum gyi brjod bya'i don dang sa mtshams gang yin snyam na/ lar gyi mtshan nyid ldan pa yi// bla ma dam pa dang ma mjal na// zab mo'i mdo rgyud lta mi shes// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yis// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kun// bka' 'khor lo gsum du sdud par byed// rgyu las dang nyon mongs rjes 'brangs pas// 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung por smin// las nyon mongs gsum po med pa yi// 'bras bu 'gog pa'i bden pa thob// dag dang ma dag rgyu 'bras 'di// gtso bor yod ces gsungs pa kun// bden pa bzhi yi 'khor lo yin// sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa dang*// lam gyi bden pa stong pa nyid// dngos po dngos po nyid kyis stong*// 'khor 'das mnyam nyid pha rol phyin// 'di mtshan ma med pa'i 'khor lo yin// mnyam nyid rtogs pa gzhir bzhag nas// sku dang ye shes yon tan gyi// 'bras bu lhun grub rtag pa'i bdag /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa// nges pa don gyi 'khor lo yin// 'di dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod du// thub pa'i stobs dang mi 'jigs gzugs// yon tan ma lus thams cad gsung*// de nges don chos kyi 'khor lo yi// brjod bya mthil du bstan pa yin// pha rol phyin pa drug gi lam// bdag med rnam pa gnyis kyi don// 'di theg pa chen po'i brjod bya yin// smra bsam brjod med pha rol phyin// skye dang 'gag pa med pa'i don// 'di mtshan ma med pa'i brjod bya yin// dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod nyid// bden pa bzhi yi ngo bor gnas// bu de phyir chos kyi 'khor lo gsum// 'khor lo gcig la tshang ba yin// gsang sngags bla med rgyud rnams kun// rnal 'byor ma yi 'dul ba ste// bden pa bzhi dang sde pa bzhi// bshad pa'i don 'di go bar bya// chos kyi 'khor lo phyi ma yi// sa bon snga ma la gnas pas// nyan thos rnams dang rang sangs rgyas// byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang*// rgyal ba rnams kyi yum gyur pa// shes rab pha rol phyin pa de// tshogs drug tu gsungs pa nyan thos kyi// ngo bsrung mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir// byang chub sems dpa' sbyang gzhi de// nyon mongs can dang kun gzhi yin// de yi rgyu mtshan gang zhe na// 'bras bus rgyu rnams dpag pa'i phyir// so sor yang dag rig pa bzhi// rtog pa gcig la'ang tshang ba yin// shin tu phra ba'i nyon mongs dang*// rnam par rtog pa thams cad la// de yi rgyu 'bras gang yin pa// don dang tshig dang nges tshig dang*// spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa yis// lhar bcas kun gyi 'dren par 'gyur// 'di dgu pa'i dus su rtogs pa yin//

//mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags kyi khyad par gang yin snyam na/ mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang*// gsang sngags theg pa'i khyad par ni// dus shin tu nye dang ring ba dang*// bde dang dka' thub spyod pa dang*// tshor ba bde sdug khyad par zhes// mkhas pa kun gyis smra bar byed// 'di yang ston pa nyid kyi bka'// sems bskyed pa zhig gis sangs rgya bar// 'dod pas pha rol phyin pa las// bslab par bya zhes gsungs pa dang*// lo bcu gnyis dag gi nang rol du// nor bzang gis kun tu bzang po thob// byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus// tshe de la sa bcu'i pha rol phyin// de phyir tshe gcig sangs rgyas par// pha rol phyin par gsungs pa lags// dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod du// dka' thub dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis// byang chub thob par ma gsungs te// rje btsun byams pas dus gsum du// smon lam btab pas lam bde zhing*// 'jug pa bde bas byang chub thob// mtha' gnyis bral bas ting 'dzin gyi// dga' bde la brten rdzogs sangs rgyas// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyis// gsang sngags don rtogs 'dod pa'i phyir// zhing rnam par dag pa'i bla ma la// dka' las dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis// dka' chen spyad pas dngos grub brnyes// nyon mongs spyod pa'i 'tsho ba de// bram ze skar ma la sogs pa// rlabs chen spyod pa mdo sder gsungs// bdag gi 'dod lugs kyi khyad par ni// bum dbang gi khyad par gyis byed pa yin// mchog dbang gong ma zab zer yang*// nga 'bu bum dbang la brtsi tshod che// gzhi dang snod dang lus lta bu// de yi khyad par gong ma gsum// cho ga'i rnam bzhag ma gtogs pa// tshad ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs yin// myong ba skyes pa thob par bzhed// gzhan lus la sogs bsten pa dang*// byin rlabs kyi ting 'dzin la khyad par med// 'di cis kyang bskur na gsang sngags yin// sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' des// bsam gyis mi khyab phrin las kyis// 'gro ba smin par bya ba'i phyir// dbang bskur thob par 'gyur ba ste// rgyu de la brten pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*// gsang dbang shes rab ye shes sogs// 'dod chags spyod pa'i dbang med na// sangs rgyas bu smad kyi rnam pa can// rgyu med kyi 'bras bu mi 'grub pas// de yi rigs can gdul bya rnams// smin par byed pa'i mthu med lags// 'di 'og min gnas mchog dam pa der// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas pa la// rigs bzhi thub pas dbang bskur ba// de nyid 'dus par rgya cher gsungs//

//pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags kyi dgongs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gcig la gsang sngags shes pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ mtshan nyid gsang sngags thams cad du// skye med shes rab pha rol phyin// sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku de// rtogs bya'i 'bras bu yin par gcig /kun rdzob smon 'jug byang chub sems// de yi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las// pha rol phyin pa bcur rdzogs nas// sa bcu la gnas sangs rgya ba// don 'di mtshungs par 'dra na yang*// shin tu gsal ba'i khyad par yod// 'bras bu chos sku nye ba'i dus// gsang sngags khyad par 'phags pa yin// nyes pa du ma'i gzhir 'gyur te// mar 'grib snyigs ma lnga bdo bas// g.yul log chen po byung ba'i tshe// dpa' bo chen po khyad par 'phags// de yang phyi yi rnam bzhag go// mthong lam ye shes rtogs pa'i thabs// rgyu tha dad la brten nas rtogs pa la// theg pa'i khyad par bsam mi khyab// shes rab pha rol phyin pa las// dus gsum la sogs 'khor 'das chos// rnam par dag pas dag pa zhes// logs su byung dogs gsungs nas yod// thun mong ma yin khyad par chos// 'bru dang shing thog mar dang ni// mar khu chen po zhes bya ba// shin tu gsang ba'i gnad 'di yin// ye shes mthong bar byed pa yi// lam gyi khyad par gang zhe na// phyag rgya mtshan nyid ldan pa dang*// stan cig tu tshogs pas tshogs lam yin// dbyer med sbyor ba sbyor ba'i lam// ye shes mthong ba mthong ba'i lam// mthong lam la tha dad med gyur kyang*// gzhi la brten nas mthong ba'i phyir// rten gsum rnam par sbyong ba de// sgom pa'i lam zhes bla mas gsungs// de yang 'od gsal sems nyid du// nyon mongs dag par byed pa de// skyes nas sbyong bar byed pa la// sa yi rim pa rdzogs nas kyang*// 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen thob// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyi// brgyud ldan rje btsun mi la yis// don 'di rtogs shing khong du chud// 'ga' zhig shor dang ma shor zhes// smra bar gyur pa rdzun re che// 'di la dbab dang bzlog pa dang*// gzung zhing dgram la mkhas bya zhes// mkhas pas bzhi po bshad pa kun// mi 'dod 'bras bu 'byung bar nges// grol lam la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa dang*// rlung gi man ngag phyag rgya yin// bde chen ting 'dzin skyes gyur pa// dbab pa mi dgos bab pa yin// de la zab pa'i gdams ngag yod// gser 'gyur rtsi yi sbyor ba yis// rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems// de yis kha bsgyur gser du 'gyur// gser la sku mchog byas pa ltar// yi dam lha ru nges par blta// don spyi bsgom pa ma yin te// don rang gi mtshan nyid mngon du 'gyur// ba spu'i bu ga la sogs pa// gsal bar 'gyur ba the tshom med// rtsa bar gyur pa'i gnad 'di ni// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dang*// zhing sogs las rnams thams cad kun// rnal 'byor sems kyis kha bsgyur bas// 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i nges shes yod//

//rim pa lnga ltar nyams su len pa'i sgom 'di dang sbyar na ji ltar 'ong snyam na/ spyir thub pa'i dam chos ma lus pa// slob dpon 'phags pas thugs su chud// sa bdun la gnas byang chub sems// sangs rgyas bzhi la smon lam btab// thub pa'i dgongs pa 'grel pa las// phyi sgro 'dogs chod pa'i chos rnams kun// dbu ma'i bstan chos chen po yin// nang nyams myong skyes pa'i rim pa lnga// bskyed pa'i rim pa dang po yin// 'di skyon dang yon tan rdzogs pa dang*// byang chub sems las skyes pa'i lha// gsal zhing brtan pas bzlas pa bya// gsal byed yan lag yin pa'i phyir// spyod lam bzhi la khyad med pa// rdo rje bzlas pa'i dgos pa yin// lus ngag yid kyi dben pa'i don// tha mal lus 'di lhas spong ste// de nyid brtan pas 'jig pa'i don// gcig dang du bral gtan tshig ltar// rdo rje lus kyi phra mo brtul// ngag kyang dbye don 'grub mi 'gyur// sems 'di brgyud pa'i gdam ngag 'dis// nges par rtogs shing khong du chud// snang la ma nges 'khrul pa de// sgyu ma ma yin rten 'brel gyi// tshogs pa de la sgyu ma zer// de nyid gdod nas skye med cing*// mnyam nyid spros dang bral bar rtogs// 'di 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa yin// 'od gsal sgyu ma la sogs pa// gang du grub pa med gyur cing*// bsal dang bzhag pa med pa la// rgyu dang 'bras bu ma 'gags pa// zung du 'jug ces de la brjod// 'di rim gyis pa dang cig car ba// mi pham mgon pos sbyin pa la// pha rol phyin drug tshang bar gsungs// slob dpon klu yi byang chub kyis// rim pa gcig la'ang lnga tshang bar// bskyed pa'i khongs su bsdu bar gsungs// des na gnyis po gang la'ang*// 'gal bar gyur pa med pa lags/ //nges par thugs kyi dgongs pa'i phyag rgya chen po de gang yin snyam na/ 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// dam chos phyag rgya chen po de// rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yin// rten 'brel rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las// srid pa'i dra ba 'byung ba de// skye 'gag spros pa'i mtha' las 'das// skye med phyag rgya chen po de// spros pa 'di las gzhan du med// e ma mthar thug phyag rgya che// spros las gzhan du med par go// ma rig nyid kyis der 'gyur te// 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bka'// bu mo gser mchog 'od gsal la// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis gdams pa yin// rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog 'di// rang sangs rgyas kyi yin zhe na// ma rig 'khor ba'i 'byung khungs de// rtogs pas 'khor ba spong ba las// mthar phyin sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// bden pa bzhi po bsgrubs gyur te// ma rtogs 'khor ba sdug bsngal zhing*// rtogs pas mnyam gzhag sa la gnas// bla ma dam pas lam ston cing*// tshogs pas mnyes par byas pas thob//

//bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod rgya chen po 'byung ba la/ phan stobs che chung 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ bsod nams tshogs kyi 'bras bu la// phul dang longs spyod bsam mi khyab// byang chub sems kyis dbang byas pas// bsdus sdom sdoms su gsungs pa yi// rgya chen zad pa med pa la// longs spyod rgyu yang mi 'byung zhing*// tshan gcig dngos po chung gyur yang*// spyod rgyu chen po 'byung ba de// zhing rnam par dag la phul gyur pas// mngon mtshan che chung gi khyad par dang*// longs spyad dang ma spyad kyi bye brag yin// dngos po che chung gang yang rung*// brtsis gdab med par phul gyur na// gcig gi bsod nams khyad med de// gong nas gong du khyad par du// bsam gyis mi khyab bsod nams 'byung*// byang chub sems kyis dbang byas pa'i// dngos po gang yang rung ba de// sems can khams dang sangs rgyas khams// mnyam pa nyid du gyur nas kyang*// dngos po ji ltar phul ba ltar// 'bras bu de yi rjes su 'brang*// rgyal po chen po nga las nus// sran rdog phyed dang lnga po de// byang chub sems kyis dbang byas pas// 'gro ba smin par byed pa cig /'on kyang dngos po ji bzhin du// 'bras bu 'byung bar nges pas na// sum cu rtsa gsum du phyin pa dang*// sa yi steng du lhung ba yis// 'gro don byas la khyad par med// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong tshe// rgyu 'bras che ba'i 'khor lo de// rgyun chad med par 'byung ba'i phyir// bcas pa'i ra ba las 'da' na yang*// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// 'da' bar mdzad cing 'da' ba des// 'gro ba smin cing grol bar byed// 'di ltar gnas brtan 'od bsrungs kyis// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs zla ba gsum// rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi khab du bzhugs// de gnas nas 'byin par brtsams pa las// byang chub sems dpa'i cho 'phrul gyis// nyan thos chen po zil gyis mnan// nyan thos theg pa ba rnams kyis// byang chub sems dpa' chen po yi// ltung ba gleng bar mi bya zhes// de bzhin gshegs pas bcas pa mdzad// des na sems can smin grol de// nyon mongs gsum gyis byed mi srid// de la nyes pa med pa'i phyir// nyes med bsgrub pa'i bslab par gsungs// nyes par gyur pa'i gnad 'di gdams//

//gzhan pas khyad par 'phags pa'i chos gang yin snyam na/ yang 'di na 'ga' zhig rin chen gnyis// stong nyid dang rgyu 'bras tha dad 'dod// rje yis bka' stsal gsung na yang*// stong nyid kyi 'brug sgra ma gtogs pa// rgyu 'bras smra ba gcig kyang med// rnam par thar pa nub gyur te// dge bshes zhang gis tshogs 'khor bskor// sprang po yin yang yi mug skyes// rin chen zhal nas sgom chen gyi// tsam la bzang ba 'byung ngo zhes// lan gsum bar du lung bstan te// chen po kun phud de byon nas kyang*// yi ge gsum gyi gzungs brjod de// lung bstan the tshom med par byung*// de yi khyad chos gang zhe na// khyod chos la rna bas sems la bzung*// stong nyid mngon par rtogs pa yis// yon tan 'bras bu yin par bzhed// 'di 'khrul pa med par 'byung ba de// rang rig 'dor bar mi 'gyur ba// thub pa rnams kyi dam chos yin// stong nyid mngon rtogs kyis 'khor ba spong*// rgyu 'bras gnyis med sku gnyis med// de phyir byang chub sems nyid de// 'di snang mdzad chen po'i sku gcig kyang*// tha dad gdul bya 'dul ba la// rgyu la brten pa'i sangs rgyas sku// dpag tu med pa 'byung bar 'gyur// sems can gcig la mkha' mnyam gyi// sems can rnams kyi bag chags kyang*// de tsam sems kyis dbang byas pas// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yin// rgyu dang 'bras bu ma 'dres shing*// mngon par rtogs pas dbyer med pa// nges don gtan la phab pa yin// kha cig mnyam rjes gnyis yin te// mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig nyid la// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can// bden pa gnyis su 'dod gyur kyang*// phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa la// kun rdzob bden pa ga la srid// rtag tu mnyam par bzhag gyur cing*// mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun la 'jug /gnyis med mthar phyin ngo mtshar che// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// lar gyi rgyu 'bras bzhed tshul cig

/yod de zla ba dka' bar byung*// de ring khyed la bstan byas na// yid la bzung la brnag par gyis// nang du ting 'dzin gang skyes pa// rang gis lus 'di byin gyis brlob// lus kyis snang ba byin gyis brlob// skad cig 'di la mi srid pas// //chos lngar ma 'dus pa'i gdams pa'i man ngag yod dam snyam na med de/ spyir thub pa'i dam chos ma lus pa// chos lnga por ma 'dus gang yang med// de re re dbye bas phye lags na// gcig kyang thug pa med par 'gyur// byang chub sems kyi rjes 'brangs nas// lhag pa'i lha nyid gcig pu la// yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi yongs su tshang*// yul de dag dbye na tha dad de// gnas der bla ma dam pa yis// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi man ngag gis// skyon dang nyes pa 'dag pa dang*// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa// yon tan skye ba'i man ngag yod// 'di shes pa khams su ma song ste// go ba yod pa dbus na med// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang*// stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi tshogs// skyon dang nyes pa thams cad la// rang gi lhag pa'i lha nyid kyis// zhal dang phyag dang zhabs la sogs// sku yi rnam 'gyur gcig pu yis// gnad kyis grol bar 'gyur ba 'di// snying rje chen po'i gzungs las kyang*// gnod pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i phyag /phyag mtshan bcas pa la bltas te// mchod pa bya zhes thub pas gsungs// //mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa 'byon pa'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ nyon mongs pa rnam par rtog pa kun// spong sems brtan pos dbang byas na// yon tan mtha' med skye 'gyur ba// rgyu dang 'bras bu so sor dpag /'di khyod kyis gzhan la gsang ba yin// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i srog snying rje// dpal chen he ru ka la mnga'// de gzhan la ma bstan bcangs gyur pas// ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi// rdul dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor mas// zhabs 'bring zhabs tog rim gro byed// chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po la// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mngon du 'byung*// sgra che ba de slob dpon khams pa yin// dog la 'cham pa 'di lcong mo'i shar mo yin// grangs dang mnyam pa'i mkha' 'gro mas// dus la yol ba med pa de// g.yon pa dag pa'i rten 'brel yin//

//gsang sngags 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i go ba gang yin snyam na/ ma smin smin byed dbang bskur bas// theg chen sngags kyi brjod bya de// gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin// 'bras bu de nyid kyi rgyu lam du// grol bar byed pas mthar phyin 'gyur// des na gong ma'i gnad gsum po// bzhi pa'i ngo bor gdod nas gnas// rkyen las skyes pa'i bsam pa de// skad cig gis 'gag par gyur pas na// sems snang ba gsum po 'od gsal du// 'jug pas sems bskyed gcig pu yang*// 'od gsal yin phyir slob dpon gyis// sa brgyad thob par bzhed pa yin// sems dang lta ba'i rig pa 'di nyid de// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar rtogs// ting 'dzin mngon par shes pa dang*// rdzogs sangs rgya ba sems nyid rten// 'khor 'das kun gyi sa bon yin// sa bon kun gzhi rnam shes de// rigs dang snang bar byed pa 'di// yul dang dus kyi bye brag yin// //rje btsun lha lnga mas chos sgo phyed dam snyam na/ phyag mang po yod pa'i dgos byed de ci yin/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma gtogs pa// lha pho reng mo reng gang gis kyang*// dbang bskur thob par mi 'dod zhes// slob dpon chen po sa skyas gsung*// 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched kun// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rgya chen gsungs// mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rnam par grags// rdo rje skye mched thams cad ni// byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor nyid// dpung pa g.yas pa gshin rje gshed// mtha' yas bsam gyis mi khyab pa// rang nyid gcig pur gsungs pa yin// bum pa'i dbang gi go ba de// rang nyid gdod nas byang chub tu// rdzogs sangs rgyas par shes shing rtogs// 'di bla ma'i drin gyis thob pa yin// rdul tshon ras bris tshom bu dang*// rje btsun sku yi dkyil 'khor la// mos gus byas pas thob pa 'di// dbang po yang rab kyi spyod yul yin// dbang gsum po de yi khyad par chos// ngag dang yid dang rang bzhin gsum// dbyer med pa yi ngo bor gsungs//

//gsang sngags su 'byung ba rim rtsegs bsgom pa'i dgos pa ci yin snyam na/ lar gyi rgyud sde bzhi po 'di// spyi babs dang mthun pa'i chos yin pas// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi brjod bya'i don// rten dang brten pa'i rim pa 'di// gtso bor gsungs pas gzhal yas khang*// 'byung ba rim rtsegs kyi rjes su 'brang*// 'di bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas// rnal 'byor bla med dgongs pa'i don// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de// nyams len mthil du bsgom pa la// blo dman spros la dga' ba yi// blo rim gyis khrid pa'i thabs su gsungs// //lha zhal phyag mang po yod pa'i dgos pa ci yin snyam na/ he ru ka dpal zhal bzhi'am// bcu gnyis phyag dang ldan pa'am// yang na sum cu so gnyis pa// bsgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis// longs spyod phun sum tshogs 'dod na// gsang ba'i gnas nas spyi bo'i bar// shin tu gsal zhing brtan par bsgom// mdzes dang 'jigs su rung ba yis// zhal dang phyag dang rin chen gyi// rgyan gyi rnam pa gser la sogs// yon tan sna tshogs 'byung ba'i gzhi// thal chen zhag dang tshom bu yi// gcer bur gyur pa de bzhin du// dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs su bstan// de la dpal ldan nā ro pa'i// phyag rgya chen po thugs nyid kyis// yi ge bzhi pa ces bya ba// srog thig ler gzhug pa'i man ngag bya// dmu chu 'khrul 'khor de nyid kyi// dbye ba med par chud par 'gyur// //nges par 'chi ba'i ltas gang yin ji ltar bzlog snyam na/ bla med gsang sngags rgyud rnams su// legs par gsungs pa'i don gyi gnad// gdams pa'i mchog gyur rtsa dang rlung*// byang chub sems las med par go// phung po rgyu rkyen las bskyed pa// skyed byed rgyu gnyis a dang haṃ// ji srid gnas tshe mi 'pho zhing*// gal te 'pho bar gyur pa na// spre'u dkar sna dmar bzhon byas nas// shar gyi phyogs su 'gro ba 'byung*// 'di ni bzlog par mi nus te// byang sems sprin gseb sba bas bsring*// tha mar bug pa gnyis nas 'byung*// a haṃ gnyis kyi mthu stobs kyis// lus gnas phyir na mthun pa'i rkyen// me dang chu yi khams brten pas// 'phel bas yon tan du ma 'byung*// de yi rigs mthun rdzas rnams kun// bcud kyis len zhes yongs su grags// bcud len rdzas rnams 'byung ba yi// gnad kyi nges pa dpag med pa// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud du gsungs// rtsa gsum chags dang sdang ba dang*// dbu ma mi rtog ting 'dzin yin// g.yas g.yon gnyis nas rtag rgyu na// chags dang sdang ba'i stobs 'phel nas// myur du 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i phyir// rlung dbu mar tshud pa'i gdams ngag bya// nang gi ting 'dzin skyon med gsum// phyi ni bdud rtsi bcud kyi len// gnas ni gsal ba zhes bya grags// de phyir thub pa chen po'i chos// gcig shes kun la mkhas pa de// spang bya gnyen por 'gyur ba'i phyir// mtha' med bsam gyis mi khyab pas// rten 'brel mtha' dag go bar bya// yang theg chen gsang sngags ma lus par// mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sku 'byung ba// gdul bya nyon mongs can rnams la// phrin las dus gsum 'dres pa'i sku// rang 'od kyi rig ma pad gdan dang*// byang chub sems gnyis kyi khyad par la// rang nyid ci 'dra de 'dra dang*// rang bzhin gnas dang rkyen sad pas// rang nyid de dang 'dra bar 'gyur// gsad pa rigs sngags phyag rgya che// sgyu ma'i rtog pa zos pa la// skye dang 'byin pa kho na nyid// de la sdig tu mi 'gyur te// gsol ba lan gsum gdab pa'i chos//

//gtum mo'i gnad kyis yon tan bskyed pa de gang gis bskyed snyam na/ dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyis// gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa// gtum mo bla med dgongs pa'am// mi la chen pos nyams su myong*// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*// de bzhin nyid dang rtsa dang rlung*// bde chen gtum mo gang yin pa// gnad kyi man ngag rtsa ba yin// spyir gshis sam babs kyis sems can la// rang byung ye shes me chen yod// tshes gcig nas brtsams nya yi bar// 'bar ba'i me lce gyen du spyod// de bzhin gshegs dang rigs kyi yum// bsregs nas bde chen gnas mchog nas// dga' ba rnam pa bcu drug 'bab// mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo dang*// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo dang*// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ru// dwangs dang snyigs ma'i rim pa yis// phyed phyed mdangs dang bkrag stobs 'phel// thur du snyigs ma gnyis byung ba// 'khor ba'i babs sam 'dug lugs yin// 'di gtan du khegs nas chings gyur pa// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen de// yab dang yum las byung ba gnyis// brtan pa'i rtags su nyi ma dang*// zla ba nor bus brgyan pa byung*// nyin mo rtsa ba'i gnad khegs pa// mtshan mo 'gyur byed 'ching bar 'gyur// tha mal rnams kyis mi tshor te// mtshan du lhung bar 'gyur ba yin// de lta'i dus su drod che bas// zas kyi dngos po 'ju bar byed// khams la phan dang stobs 'phel phyir// thub pas zas tshod rig bya ste// bka' stsal nan tan chen por gsungs// slob dpon 'phags pas nyes pa rnams// ma zhu ba yi bskyed byed zhes// gsungs pa de dag thams cad kun// rtsa ba'i gnad 'dis bskyed pa yin// thog ma bar dang mthar dge bas// yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur pas// ye shes me dpung chen po yin// //rgyud rnams su rtsis kyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa de'i gnad gang yin snyam na/

theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// gza' dang rgyu skar tshes grangs dang*// khams dang dus kyi gnad rnams gsungs// 'di phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel yin// phyi 'byung ba bzhi yi 'du 'phrod kyis// phan dang gnod pa 'byung ba yi// rig byed gtsug lag thams cad kun// shes pa mu stegs byed dang mtshungs// de dag nang gi bsam pa'i gnad// 'brel pa gcig tu gyur pa 'di// thub pa chen po'i bka' yin pas// sangs rgyas byon pa'i khyad par chos// med na mi 'byung gi 'bras bu yin// de ji bzhin rdo rje'i lus kyi gnad// phyi rol de bzhin gnas pa de// bla med gsang sngags kyi nying khu yin// phan dang gnod par byed pa ni// spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil bar// thig le rnam gsum gyi 'phel 'grib kyis// rnam par gyur pa gcig pur nges// de phyir skar ma mi bo'i srog /'di la brten nas mthu bsgrub pa'i// man ngag yod de khar mi thon// gcig pur bsgrub pa byas pa yis// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gnad rnams go// rang min pa gzhan med kyi bsam pa skye// dpal stag lung thang pa la dri ba dris// khong bshad dam gsungs pa mi bshad par// zhu ba phul ba'i bka' stsal gsung*// 'di la 'byung ba bzhi po yi// gnad 'di min pa med pa yin// lus phung po lnga po 'byung bas bskyed// de bzhi po 'gyur bas nyes pa bskyed// 'di sems can dus dang lam gyi dus// 'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i tshe// rigs lnga yum gyi byed pa yin// byang phyogs sa yi dkyil 'khor la// grub pa rlung gi bdag nyid bzhugs// lho phyogs rlung gi dkyil 'khor la// rin chen 'byung ldan sa yi khams// chu ni me yi gnyen po ste// so sor skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir// de yi gnyen por bzhugs pa yin// bu rten 'brel ma lus 'di go mdzod// //bsgrub pa byas pas dngos grub 'byung ba'i tshul ji lta bu snyam na/

rang nyid yi dam lha bsgom zhing*// bza' btung bdud rtsir byin rlabs la// tshogs kyi 'khor lo gsol bar zhu// dam pa'i chos 'di shin tu gnyan// gsang sngags bla med bsgrub pa la// dngos grub mi mthun phyogs kun dang*// bar du gcod pa sna tshogs 'byung*// rgya mtsho'i 'gram du klu grub ste// nam mkha' lta bu'i rba rlabs kyis// mi g.yo ci 'dod dam pa sbyin// ro langs bsgrubs pas ha he zhes// sgrog cing langs par gyur pa'i tshe// dam rdzas sbyin cing ci 'dod bslangs// gnod sbyin sbyor ba sna tshogs kyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams bsgrub pa la// glang chen rab brtan rnal 'byor pas// zla drug goms pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dpon g.yog rim par zhabs tog byed// g.yog ni yid 'ong lha yi bu// dpon ni khro gtum rngam pa'i zhal// sa bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'am// khro mchog ya man ta ka sogs// gnyen por gyur pa bsgoms gyur na// ma dang bran mo 'grub par sla// chung ma mi zad cho 'phrul ston// lcang lo can nam sum cu'i gnas// bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas su 'dren// 'dir yang rtsa ba'i man ngag las// cung zad tsam yang 'dar mi rung*// 'di gsang sngags gcig pu ma yin te// rang nyid gsod pa'i gshed ma la// byams dang bzod thob chen po yis// phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas// khro la lan du slar mi khro// brdegs pa la yang slar mi brdeg /'jig rten mi chos 'dun ma yang*// rgad pos mi sha ma blang zhing*// sha tshod kyi bya dga' sbyin dang 'dra// 'di yang zab pa'i man ngag go/ //spyir mos gus che na gnas skabs kyi tung tung med kyang chog gam snyam na/ tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// sangs rgyas 'du skyes pa yis// de yi yon tan mngon rtogs 'byung*// 'du shes tung tung med gyur na// gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*// byin rlabs 'jug pa mi nus la// bsgom bya sgom du rtogs pa des// gzhan don khyad du bsgrub dgos te// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// 'gro ba'i don rnams bsgrub pa de// sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin//

//ro gcig rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la rtogs pa skye ba dang skye ba med pa gnyis su gsungs pa'i don ci yin snyam na/ gnyis med ro gcig rtogs pa yi// nyon mongs rnam rtog med pa de// go ba 'dzin pa med pa yin// ka ba mthong dang mi 'dzin pas// de med de yi snang ba med// des ni theg pa chen po mthong*// ka bar 'dzin pas drang zhes dang*// yo zhes rtog pa ma rig pa// //ro gcig rtogs pa la yon tan ci yang med par gsal ba snang na de'i yon tan gang yin snyam na/ ro gcig rtogs par gyur pa la// de yi yon tan gang zhig yin// ro gcig de la tha mal nyams// rtse gcig spros bral mi snang bas// phrag dog skyes dang gzhan gyi 'khor// gang yin de la bsal bzhag med// las dang nyon mongs de bzhin te// de las gzhan pa'i yon tan med// sems nyid 'od gsal rtogs pa de// bdud rtsi rnyed pa lta bu yin// bdud rtsi thu ba lta bu de// rgyun chad med par bsgom pa yin// de rgyun bsrings nas ma bsgom na// yon tan 'byung ba ga la srid// chos rjes bdag la gdams pa yin// //grib tshan chen pos gnod pa mi 'byung bar ting nge 'dzin gsal du 'gro ba srid snyam na/ spyir nyams su 'gyur ba mi rtag ste// rtag cing brtan pa phyag rgya che// lhan skyes kyi ngang tu gnas pa la// phyi rol du dug gsum gyi grib byung yang*// tshul khrims byang chub sems gnyis kyis// skyon med ting nge 'dzin du 'char// de tshe grags pa'i dam chos kyis// 'khor 'das dbang sdud bde ba che// byang chub shing drung bdud kyi sde// bcom pa ting 'dzin gsum lags pas// tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug dang*// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa nyid// mthar thug ting 'dzin la gnas pas// 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs kyi gnas// bha ga ling ga'i mchod pa yis// bu mang nor ldan dngos grub thob// //yon bdag mo gnyis kyis khab skud bskur ba la mnyes pas khyed la yang de 'dra ba 'byung bar 'dod na/

rang gis ji ltar byas pa yi// 'bras bu ma gtogs gzhan na med// sngon 'jig rten mgon po bla ma la// sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes// 'gro ba kun la phan bde yi// bsam pa drag po'i bskul mas bskul// mang shos zi bol srang bcu bzhi// srang bdun bdag gis phul ba la// dngos grub len ces bka' gsal gsung*// bu khyod kyis nga la ci byas pa'i// 'bras bu 'byung bar 'gyur ba la// bsgrub pa'i byed po gzhan na med// //bla ma rnams kyis slob ma skyong ba'i tshul lugs gang yin snyam na/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dang*// gnyis su med par 'dres pa yis// dge sbyor skyong bar shes pa rnams// bla mas bsgom la mi bskul te// dben par gnyid pas gdong pa skrangs// mdze por gyur pa dgos pa med// kha che dgon pas zangs dkar la// gtsug lag khang rnams gsos shig dang*// bar dor phyag rgya chen po yi// dngos grub tu byin gyis brlab bo zhes// gnang ba med dang ri khrod pas// mai tri chen pos bshad pa la// bskul bar gyur pa ji bzhin du// 'dir yang bya byed thams cad la// mkhas pas bya ba bsgrub par bya// rdzas dang yo byad mthun pa'i rkyen// sa phyogs gang du yang med mi srid// rang bsgrub bya'i zhe 'dod dmigs byas la// lan gsum gyi bar du tshod shes na// drod rtags mkhas pa chen por 'gyur// blon po rig par ldan pa rnams// rig byed dpag tu tshad gyur te// nyams 'og tshud nas rgyal po yi// spyan sngar brims pas bya dga' thob// de phyir rdzas kyi dngos po kun// so sor byed pa'i las re re// ro drug mngar bas bsdus pa dang*// skur bas 'jigs par byed pa 'di// phyi nang gnyis la khyad par med// rigs gang byed de yi gnyen po gcig /bsten pas snyam nas yon tan bskyed// 'di kha yo snam bu srong ba yin// //gegs 'byung ba'i rgyu dang sel ba'i thabs gang yin snyam na/

sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa la// bar chad bdud dang nye ba'i tshogs// bla ma la ji ltar bltas pa bzhin// de yi dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur// nyes skyon bzlog par byed pa'i thabs// rgyu gang las skyes pa'i 'bras bu de// sangs rgyas mthus kyang mi bzlog pas// skyon dang po de dag spangs pa yi// bla ma sangs rgyas su bsgoms byas nas// de nges shes skyes pa'i dus su bzlog /de gegs sel mthar thug gi man ngag yin// //myong ba skyes pa'i bogs 'don pa'i man ngag gang yin snyam na/ gcig pur ri khrod dgon pa ru// 'jig rten bsam pa btang nas kyang*// bsgrub pa nan tan byas gyur na// rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa 'byung*// de yi yon tan mngon shes dang*// rtags dang mtshan ma'i bye brag rnams// mtshan ma cung zad 'byung ba yang*// brtan pa'i bogs 'don 'di ltar bya// spyir skyon dag yon tan kun rdzogs pa// phun tshogs lnga yi rten 'brel yin// dus der mig gis phye btsum dang*// kha zas brtson 'grus 'bad brtsol dang*// bsgom dang gnas kyi rim pa kun// nges par bzung zhing legs par bsgrub// mthun pa'i rkyen rnams thams cad kyis// yon tan mu mtha' med par nges// //bsgom pa'i gnas la khyad yod dam snyam na/ ri khrod dben pa'i dgos pa dang*// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung gnyis// bsgrub pa byed par gyur pa na// gnyan dang mi gnyan khyad par med// 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas rnams su// rtsol ba brtson 'grus che na yang*// bla ma'i zhabs drung byin rlabs che// rtsol ba de nyid zhi ba yi// byin rlabs chen po 'byung ba yin// //'khor ba la mtha' yod med dang sems can la zad pa yod med kyi don ji lta bu yin snyam na/ lar sems can zhes bya rnam rtog ste// rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag /thog ma med cing tha ma med// de nyid rtogs par ma gyur pas// khams gsum 'khor bar 'khor gyur te// gti mug bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin// khyad par chos la zad pa med// 'di yod dang med pa ma yin te// gdod nas gnyis su med par gnas// de phyir gsar dang rnying ma yin// sems nyid 'od gsal rtogs pa'i tshe// ma rig sprin tshogs rang sar dag

/'khor ba'i chu bo skem par 'gyur// de phyir rtogs dang ma rtogs las// 'bras bu thob dang bsal bzhag med// rang sems dri med chos kyi sku// rang bzhin rnam dag gi snying po de// rig dang ma rig gi khyad par gyis// sangs rgyas dang sems can zhes byar grags// gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// tha dad gus pa med pa'i phyir// ma rig med cing zad pa med// rnam shes nyid kyang byang chub la// byang chub rnam par shes pa nyid// 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun// ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag /tha dad bag chags kyi sa bon de// thog med dus nas gnas pa yin// rgyu rkyen tshogs pas sad pa gang*// rnam shes de yi gzugs su 'gyur// nyon mongs gsum gyi khyad par dang*// nyon mongs med pas dbang byas pas// skye gnas sna tshogs su skye ba 'di// shin tu zab cing phra ba'i chos// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// //thub pa'i bstan pa snying rjes rab tu phye bar gsungs na/ mu stegs byed la yang snying rje yod pas khyad ci yis 'byed snyam na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de// snying rje chen po dngos yin pas// 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yin// de bas mu stegs 'tshang rgyar 'gyur// 'on kyang snying rje'i byed las dang*// de yi 'bras bu gang yin la// shes shing rtogs pa med pa yi// lam log la zhugs pa mu stegs pa// de nyid shes pa sangs rgyas yin// des na bdag tu 'dzin pa de// rgyang 'phen yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir// snod gcig gi nang du sman dang dug /'dres nas blug pa sman pas phyed// de bzhin thub pa chen po yis// dgag dang bsgrub pa'i bcas pa mdzad// //zhing gdam pa dang mi gdam pa gnyis gsungs nas 'dug pa de'i dgongs pa gang yin snyam na/ tshad med rnam pa bzhi po 'di// byang sems ma skyes bskyed pa'i rgyu// skyes nas bslab pa lam du bshad// mthar thug sangs rgyas 'phrin las yin// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// yul dman pa gsum po gces bya zhes// bla ma gong mas gsung na yang*// gnod pa bskyal ba gces gyur na// rang nyid la gnod pa rgyun mi 'chad// dam pa ma yin gces gyur na// sangs rgyas bstan la gnod par 'gyur// sems can gces par bzung gyur na// nyon mongs dug gsum gyi dbang thang rgyas// bu thub pas sbyin pa gtong ba la// dug mda' rtog pa ji bzhin du// zhing brtag na pha rol phyin mi rdzogs// de gsungs dgongs pa gang yin na// dman pa'i zhing rnams thams cad kun// chos kyi rgyu dang rkyen gyur pa'i// sbyin pa gtong ba ma gtogs pa// ma brtag dug gsum bskyed pa'i rgyu// rtsa ba'i ltung bas phog gyur pas// gdug la byams par mi bya zhing*// dam pa'i chos la btsud pa de// bsgrub bya byang chub sems dpa' yi// spyod pa yin par thugs la zhog/
