//bsod nams kyi tshogs rgyun chad med par byed pa'i thabs yod dam snyam na/ bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub de// tshogs gnyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du// rgyun chad med par bsags pas 'grub// 'di la zhing dang bsam pa dang*// dngos po rnam pa gsum yin yang*// bsam pa byang chub sems nyid kyis// dus ring thung byin gyis rlabs pa'i phyir// byang chub sems la rgyun chad med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba yi// rjes kyi man ngag zab mo yis// bla med byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur phyir// rgyun chad med pa chu bo bzhin// sbyor ba 'gro dang 'ong ba dang*// nyal dang 'dug dang nyan pa dang*// smra dang bsgom pa thams cad kyang*// bsam pa bzang po'i khyad par gyis// dam chos thos par ma gyur kyang*// bar chad bsrung phyir sgo bsrung ba// khro bo chen por bsgyur ba ltar// sbyor ba rgyun chad med par bsgrub// dngos po phra ba gcig phul yang*// byang chub tu bsngos pas 'di dang gzhan// mthar thug sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i phyir// 'bras bu gsum po de la tshang*// skye ba phyi ma gcig pur bsngos// skyes nas myong dang gzhan la myong*// 'bras bu gzhan la smon lam gyis// khyad par gyis 'grub par 'gyur ba yin// rten 'brel gsum po tshang ba yis// yon tan thams cad skye bar byed// //sangs rgyas kyi zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa de las kyi sgrib pa yin nam snyam na/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' de// las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa spangs// shes bya'i sgrib pa yod gyur pas// rgyu de la brten pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*// de nyon mongs rgyu 'bras yin par nges// byang chub sems kyi dbang byas pas// 'gro ba byang chub thob pa'i thabs// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub bya yin// de spros bral gdod nas dag pa la// byas pa dang byung ba gang yang med// sems kyang gdod nas med gyur na// las dang nyon mongs smos ci dgos// dang po khas len gsum po la// ji ltar byas kyang btub pa yin// don go ba gsum pos go bar bya// mdo gsum gyi dgongs pa dus 'dir go/

//byang chub sems dpa' skye ba sna tshogs 'dzin pa la// smon lam ma gtogs pa'i rgyu dgos sam snyam na/ dgos te/ yang byang chub sems dpa' bsam mi khyab// skye ba'i sa bon lhun gyis grub// byang chub sems dang rtogs pa dang*// bsod nams tshogs kyis 'grub 'gyur kyang*// smon lam gyi ma yin klur skye ba// 'grub byed rgyu yang gang yin dgos// klu yi rgyal po e la'i 'dab// rgyu 'bras la rmongs shing zhe sdang bas// shing gi yal ga bcad pa yis// klu yi skye gnas su skyes pa yin// //skye byed kyi sa bon yig 'brur gsungs pa de'i don gang yin snyam na/ skyes pa'i sa bon yi ge'i sgo// don ston mig gis gzugs ston pa// de ring min pa gsang ba yin// mig gis yi ge la brten nas// rab 'bring tha ma gsum mthong ste// chags dang sdang dang rmug pa skye// chags sdang skyes pa'i mig gi gzugs// sa bon gang yin dbang byas pas// de yi mthun rkyen sgrub pa yin// ji ltar me long gzugs brnyan bzhin// 'byung bar dka' sla'i bye brag gis// bag chags sa bon gang yin pa// gsod par byed pa'i rkyen rnams kun// tshogs ma tshogs gnyis kyi bye brag gis// 'byung dka' sla'i bye brag de yin zhing*// byams pa skyes pa'i snang ba la// pha bsad pa'i mi la phan pa bsgrub// zhe sdang skyes pa'i snang ba la// slob dpon a ba glang mgor mthong*// rtog pa re re skyes pa la// mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa lnga// shin tu rgyas pa'i bka' gsal gsung*// //dag pa'i sa gsum gyi mnyam rjes kyi khyad par ci yin snyam na/ yongs su dag pa'i sa gsum la// lus dang ngag dang yid gsum po// don thams cad sems las med gyur pas// gcig la gsum ga tshang na yang*// gtso bor gang gyur gyi khyad par yin// sems chos nyid spros bral rtogs gyur kyang*// rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yi// snang ba rtogs par ma gyur pas// mnyam rjes kyi 'dzin pa nyid dang ldan// dngos po ting 'dzin mnyam bzhag la// dngos por 'dzin pa rjes yin zhes// rtog ge ba dag smra na yang*// snang dang mi snang spros pa'i tshogs// mnyam bzhag chen por gyur pa la// de las gzhan pa'i rjes de gang*// 'di mnyam nyid rtogs pa yan chad nas// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi khyad chos yin//

//de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la a ba glang mgor mthong ba'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// bsam gyis mi khyab skur snang ba// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de nyid// 'ga' zhig gnod pa byed par snang*// de kho rang gi bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin// skos phor la ri mo yod gyur na// sa tsha la ri mo 'byung ba ltar// rgyu yi 'brel pa de nyid kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog la 'god// da ltar nga yi tshig ngan dang*// rgya gad rnam pa sna tshogs pas// nyes pa bzlog cing yon tan sgrub// 'di yang de ltar go bar bya// dag pa'i sa la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// skad cig bskal pa rgya mtsho dang*// rdul cig zhing rnams mtha' yas pa// zhing khams mtha' yas rdul cig tu// 'du zhing 'jug pa shes pa 'di// ngo mtshar smad du byung ba yi// rgyas sras rnams kyi spyod pa ste// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin// thob par rnam par 'di spyod par// thub mgon chos rjes bka' stsal to// 'di ting 'dzin de yi mthu stobs dang*// snang ba rang gi sems yin pas// thob par gyur pa ma yin te// rje btsun chen po mi la yis// stong gsum yung 'brur tshud par gsungs// yung 'bru gcig pu de nyid du// rang gi bsam pas de bsams dang*// de nyid de las gzhan pa med// ngas ni stong gsum 'jig rten pas// mtha' med 'khor 'das 'dus par go// byang chub sems kyi sku de nyid// gangs chen rnam par snang mdzad yin// da nang snyung dri byas pa des// de ring nyi ma blo bde bas// phye gtor ma gtogs gzhan med pas// rang nyid kyis rang la phye gtor dgos// nga 'grangs pas bza' ba mi za'o// snyam nas dang ga khad kyis 'gags// 'di dang gzhan yang bza'o zhes// snyam na bza' btung mang po thub// 'di yi rtsa ba'i man ngag cig /yod de khyed kyis 'dzin mi 'dzin// 'dzin na mna' skyol dam bca' gyis// gang la'ang mngon par zhen pa spangs// ma byin rnam par rtog pa med// da ltar de nyid kyi ngang du thim// slad ma ma grub mtha' gnyis bral// dbu ma'i don gyi gnas lugs la// bde dang skyid pa'i yon tan 'byung*// phan byed rgyun de 'di nyid de// dmigs pa'i gnad rnams don 'di yin// 'di khyed kyi gtan du mi bya ste// zhi byed rtogs pa gong 'pho ba// gnad 'dis yon tan sgrub byed kyang*// sus kyang go zhing rtogs pa med// dam pa rgya gar khong rang gis// don de khong du chud de mchi// thub pa'i chos rnams ma lus pa// bdag med rnam gnyis rtogs pa'i gnad// bstan par bya zhing thugs la bzhugs// rkyen dang bral ba gzhi de nyid// yod dang med pa gnyis yin pa// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kyis rtogs// de nyid bsgom par byed pa la// yod dang med pa gang yang min// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang*// rdo rje lta bu la sogs pa// bye brag dus 'dir rab spangs te// rkyen rnams de nyid yin pa'i phyir// rtogs pas mnyam pa nyid zhes bya// lhan skyes de las skyes pa yis// rtog pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pas// 'bras bu tha dad rnams su 'gyur//

//sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhengs pa la tshad dang mi ldan pa la nyes pa 'byung gsung ba de sangs rgyas la 'byung ba mi srid snyam na/ skyon dang nyes pa du ma rnams// thub pa'i sku la 'byung ba min// tshogs gnyis las byung mtshan ldan pa// de med de yi nyes skyon 'byung*// snang ba rang sems yin pa'i phyir// rtags dang mtshan ma sna tshogs pa// bzang ngan gyi bye brag thams cad kyang*// ston pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad las// bde legs yon tan du ma 'byung*// de las bzlog pa'i mtshan ngan pas// skyon dang nyes pa rgya mtsho bskyed// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// brtag pa rnam pa brgyad du gsungs// nyes pa'i mtshan ma de dag kun// bzlog pa'i gnad cig yod pa 'di// khyed bzhi po 'bul ba gyis dang bstan// zhing rnam dag bla ma dkon mchog la// dngos po rgya chen tshogs bsags pas// tshogs des tshogs min bzlog pa'i phyir// dngos po ngan pa ma lus 'jig /'byung ba ldog par 'gyur ba yin// bsam pa ngan pas bzang po yi// dngos po 'jig par 'gyur ba 'di// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// thang bkram du yod kyang rnal 'byor pas// myong ba skyes pas srog tu 'gyur// //nan tan chen po byas nas bsgoms pas bde ba chen po skyes nas mi nyams par byed pa'i thabs ji ltar bsgom snyam na/ dran pa rtse gcig tu bsgoms pa yis// bde stong ting 'dzin bzang po skye// yul la dmigs par mi bya bar// yi dam lha la nges shes bskyed// dpung de nyid kyis bskyed byas nas// thur du ltung ba'i 'jigs pa med// snang med mtshan mo nyam nga bral// //'dre yod pa'i gnas su ji ltar bya snyam na/ shin tu 'jigs shing nyam nga ba// 'dre srin mang po gnas pa der// rang dbang med par sdod dgos shing*// rgyal po chen po la sogs pas// cho 'phrul kun gyis gtses byed na// phyi rol gdon bgegs thams cad kun// gnod pa bsgrub byed logs su med// 'di yi gnod pas mi tshugs pa// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dpag med gsungs// bdag gis nyams su myong ba ni// skyabs bla na med pa'i dkon mchog la// nges par skyabs su song gyur na// de dag skyabs gnas mthar thug yin// byang chub sems dang ldan gyur na// sangs rgyas byang chub sems par 'gyur// rtsa ba'i dam tshig ma nyams na// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du// stong nyid bde chen du ro gcig na// snang srid bla ma dam par 'char// 'di dag kun gyi rtsa ba'i gnad// bu gcig gces pa'i thugs la zhog

/snang ba rang sems yin pa'i phyir// 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun// 'di las med par kho thag chod// //rmi lam ngan pa ji ltar bzlog snyam na/ phan gnod chen po rmi lam du// mthong bar gyur pa bzlog pa la// rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'ga' zhig gis// de nyid du bsgyur bar byed pa dang*// gnyis pa sad cing ma 'gyur ba// nyes pa de las bzlog pa dang*// gsum po de yi rjes su 'brang*// 'di go na nyes skyon thams cad kun// sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi 'khrul pa la// sbyor ba choms pas nyes pa med// dngos gzhi cung zad 'byung 'gyur zhing*// rjes ni shin tu yun ring bar// sdug bsngal drag pos 'tshe bar mchi// rmi lam phan gnod che ba de// dang po sems la rag las pas// dge slong gi nyes pa cung zad kyang*// lhar bcas 'jig rten rnams kyis smod// ngan pas dge ba spyad gyur kyang*// de la su yang yid mi rton// dge sbyor lhun grub tu gnas pa de// nyes pa gsal zhing bzang bar mchi// //bzang po zhig 'dod pas bya ba sgrubs kyang bzang po mi 'byung bar nyes pa 'byung ba'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ 'di shin tu zab pa'i dam chos yin// rang gi nyams su myong ba las// bsam pa bzang po zhig skyes nas// de yi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las// byas pa dang byed pa rgya chen po// phan bde 'dod pa'i phyir 'bad kyang*// bsgrub bya'i don rnams mi 'grub par// nyes phung rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i// rgyu dang rkyen la zad pa med// mi 'dod sdug bsngal khur gyis non// gnyen 'dun gyi zhen pa la mi thar bas// dpal ldan chen po 'tshal pa yis// rgya chen 'gro ba'i don dgongs pas// rlabs chen mdzad pa'i brtul bzhugs spyad// sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams// snyigs ma'i dus su dam chos bsrung*// 'khor srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur bas// 'dre srin mang pos gnod pa bsgrubs// 'di 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan yin nam snyam//

//rmi lam mam dngos su lha 'dres lung bstan pa byung na bden nam snyam na/ spyir lung bstan 'byung ba thams cad kun// bden nam mi bden cha med de// sngon yi dwags drag pos bdag byas pa'i// khang pa stong par bsdad pa la// srod nas tho rangs bar du non// khyod rang non cig ces byas pas// yang na gtan nas chos ma byed// chos kyi bya long mi 'byung ste// lo gsum na ni khyod 'chi zer// nga ma shi bar du chos byed ces// smras pas de nas kho song ste// da rung bar du ma shi lags// 'on kyang khong gi de rdzun min// khong rang gi mi min snang ba la// de 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i snang ba 'byung*// de yang bsam pa 'gyur bas so// des na chos byed thams cad la// bar chad 'byung ba gang yin pa// khong la 'chi dang med 'gyur ba'i// snang ba 'byung bar nges pa yin// bdud rigs lha rnams thams cad kyis// khong gi gnas las 'das par mthong*// gzhan yang 'da' bar byed dgos nas// padma'i phreng ba'i mgo bo la// dug lnga mtshon pa'i mda' lnga brgyab// ngan pa bsgrub par med min te// 'di ni bar du gcod par 'gyur// 'di la zab pa'i gdams ngag ni// gnod par byed la zhe sdang yang*// byang chub sems kyi rjes 'brangs nas// bha ling la sogs kho yi don// ched du bsams la bsngo bar bya// gzhi ning gdan sa'i zhabs tog byas// bdag nyid chen po mi bzhugs pas// dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab// lung bstan sgra cig mkha' la grags// lo nyi shu rtsa lnga thub po zhes// de bden nam mi bden bdag gis thos// //gza' skar ngan pa'i bcos ji ltar bya snyam na/ tshes grangs gza' dang rgyu skar gyi// rtsis de bdag gis ma 'tshal te// bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba'i thabs// don 'di khyod kyi thugs la zhog /bskyed rim brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// snang dang srid pa lhag pa'i lhar// shar bar gyur na rab gnas dang*// gsang sngags phrin las bsgrub tu rung*// de las sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa'i// snang bar gyur pa gzhan pa med// snang ba chos nyid phyag rgya cher// rtogs par gyur pa gang yin la// phyag rgya chen por ma gtogs pa'i// gza' dang rgyu skar de la med// de nyid rang byung phyag rgya che// dus bzang dang ngan pa'i spros pa bral// 'di yis rab gnas la sogs pa// phrin las bsgrub pa dus med de// rtsis kyi rnam pa thams cad kun// so so skye bo tha mal gyi// chos su gtogs shing go bar bya//

//nad kyi bcos ji ltar bya snyam na/ zhing rnam dag bla ma dkon mchog la// bsam pa rnam dag byang sems kyis// dngos po gang phul gyi 'bras bu smin// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rnams// rten 'brel mthu yis bzlog par 'gyur// sbyor ba'i dam chos rnam gsum gyis// rang lus gnad du bsnun nas kyang*// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rnams// bla ma rdo rje 'chang bsgom la// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'gyur la// dran pa ma yengs rtse gcig pas// 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi gnad// rang lus rgya mtsho chen po la// bde chen gru yi sbyor ba yis// gang 'dod nor bu rin chen len// 'grub byed rtsi bcud cung zad kyis// rim gyis gso ba'i thabs su bstan// lte ba'i 'og tu nyi ma rgyu// steng du rgyun chad med par bzlog /shin tu gsang bar ma bsgom na// tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i skyon du mchi// //nad bying che ba 'thibs pa dang zug che ba gnyis la bsgom pa'i khyad yod dam snyam na/ 'du ba rnam bzhis bsdus pa yi// zug dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs la// spros med phyag rgya chen po yis// gnyis med mkha' ltar dag gyur pas// dngos gzhi gang yin hril gyis 'byung*// de dgos 'dod dbang gi rgyal po ru// nges pa'i shes pa bskyed byas nas// de nyid dngos med mkha' la bstim// de bstim bya stim byed med pa ru// rang byung chen po'i ngang du gnas// ma skyes pha rol phyin pa las// 'khor 'das yon tan thams cad 'byung*// bsgom bya dmigs pa'i yul nyid la// sgom byed kyi shes pa ma yengs dang*// 'bad rtsol gyi mtha' la zhen pa yi// lhun grub kyi sa la gnas pa dka'// 'di chos kyi ye shes kyi go ba yin// gti mug mun pas 'thoms gyur cing*// mi shes mun pas non pa la// de nyid de rgyun bsring byas nas// bsgoms par gyur pas dkyil 'khor gyi// gzhi gang la nad rnams yod gyur nas// ji ltar chu rlung dwangs pa la// nya dang chu srin 'phyo ba bzhin// de nyid chu bo'i rang bzhin yin// nyes pa'i gzhi nyid med gyur na// mkha' la nyi ma shar ba'am// ji ltar padmo chus brlan ltar// gsal zhing rgyas pa'i yon tan 'byung*// kha tsam 'od gsal du song gyur pas// khyed 'gro dang 'ong ba thams cad mthong*// nyams len gyi gnad 'di shes gyur na// yon tan 'byung ba dka' ba min// 'dis ni dam chos ma lus pa'i// dbu rnams dus gcig song ba yin//

//nad thams cad la phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig gis chog gam snyam na/ dngos kun nam mkha'i rang bzhin te// chos rnams stong nyid ro gcig kyang*// bye brag dmigs byed ma grub na// nyes pa'i skyon las mi grol bas// glen pa dmu 'thoms byed pa rnams// gnas lugs go yul gyi bslu bar zad// stong nyid dmigs las gzhan ma yin// dmigs nyid gdod nas dmigs kyis stong*// stong pa nyid kyi chos rnams la// 'khor 'das sna tshogs tha dad 'byung*// gzhi gang la brten nas 'byung gnas su// skyes bu rjes su dran pa gzhug /mi bskyod g.yo ba med pa yi// ngang la gnas pas yul de zin// mi mthun dgra bo'i g.yul bzlog nas// lhun grub sa la gnas pa de// e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am// //gza' dang bdud la sogs pa'i nyes pa 'byung ba'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ mi zad drag po'i gnod pa de// phyi rol nas phog par gyur pa min// rang gi rdo rje'i lus 'di la// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le yi// rnam 'gyur gcig pur nges pa'i phyir// 'pho dang stobs ldan ror 'gyur ba// thabs gzhan kun gyis mi phan te// yon tan shes la gsal po 'byung*// spyir yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyi// phyed dang phyed min gsal bar snang*// de nyid gsal bar nan tan bskyed// 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// chu mda' gnas der 'du ba yi// sgrub thabs yin te mi phan pas// nang du gnas pa la brgal te// phyi rol du 'chor bas 'chi bar 'gyur// nan tan chen pos bsgoms pa las// thabs gzhan yod pa ma mthong lags// //gnyid log pas khams ldog pa'i rgyu gang yin mi ldog pa'i thabs ji ltar bya snyam na/ nad rnams 'tsho byed sman pa yis// sa yi khams dang me yi khams// skyes pa tshad par gyur par 'dod// de la chu dang rlung gis snyoms// nyon mongs gti mug gnyid log pas// gnod pa bskyed cing ldog par 'gyur// dri med 'od gsal chos kyi sku// ting 'dzin bdag pos dbang byas pas// dkar phyogs dge ba'i rtsa ba yis// gnod pa mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog

/gang la ji ltar gnod pa 'di// rdzas kyi dngos po 'dod gyur na// mi 'dod sman gyi rnam pa dang*// gnyis su med par byas la gtang*// mthon dman cha chu'i rim pa yis// snyoms par gyur na de la bzhag /'di yang zab pa'i gdams ngag go/ //mi tshe ring por bsgoms bsgoms pas skyon med yon tan ma byung na de'i rgyu dang*/ yon tan bskyed pa'i thabs ji ltar bya snyam na/ yul gang la mnyam par bzhag pa yis// nyes dang yon tan du ma 'byung*// de nyid gang yin shes par bya// bde legs yon tan du ma rnams// ting 'dzin nyon mongs med las byung*// skyon dang nyes pa thams cad kun// nyon mongs dug gsum gyis bskyed par byed// rdzu 'phrul rtags dang cho 'phrul dag /thams cad rgyu las 'byung ba ste// 'phags pa legs 'ong chen po dang*// gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi lta bu ste// rgyu ji ltar spyad pa'i 'bras bu la// longs spyod thun mong ma yin pas// tha dad rgyu yi rjes su 'brang*// don dam 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// rang gis rtogs pas 'khor ba spong*// //mi mthun pa'i skyon sna tshogs la skyon sel thabs sna tshogs yod dam snyam na/ bar du gcod pa gsum la sogs// nyes pa mi mthun phyogs rnams la// gdams ngag tshig tshogs spros pa yis// cung zad phan par mi 'gyur te// mdor bsdus kun rdzob don dam gyi// sems gnyis nor bu rin po che// bye brag lam du btang ba dang*// chos lnga dag la 'bad par bya// zla ba gza' las thar ba ltar// nyes pa'i skyon las grol bar 'gyur// gal te nyams su blangs pa las// skyon las thar bar ma gyur na// bla ma dam pa lhag pa'i lha// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis// bslus par 'gyur te 'di las med// theg chen gsang sngags rgyud rnams su// bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis skyon sel zhing*// yon tan sgrub pa med pa na// bu gcig rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// 'di las gzhan pa'i gdams ngag dang*// man chung yig chung bsags gyur kyang*// rang gzhan gang la ma phan pa// rang gis nyams su myong bas grub//

//bla ma rnam pa bzhi khams kyi tshul lugs gcig pa yin gsungs pa de gang yin snyam na/ bla ma la stod dmar po dang*// lo ro 'tshal pa nga 'bu bzhi// khams gcig ces smras pa gang yin pa// gcig shos kyi khams su gcig pa yin// bla ma chen po 'tshal pa de// de kho na bzhin du bzhugs zhad gda'// khong sangs rgyas bstan pa thugs su song*// bstan pa dar bar byed pa la// gzhi gtsug lag khang dang mi mthun phyogs// gnod par byed pa'i phrin las kyis// gsad dang 'gar dang 'jigs par byed// thugs dang po'i sa bon gang yin de// zab pa'i chos kyis dbang bsgyur bas// rlabs chen spyod pa 'grub pa yin// ngas ni sdang byed dgra rnams dang*// gnod byed bgegs kyi gtso byas pa'i// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can la// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// ci byed khong gi don du bsngos// gar phyin gar 'dug thams cad du// mi min gdug pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// mang rje drug tsha la sogs pa// gdug pa can gyi mi tshogs rnams// legs par dul nas mthun rkyen sgrub// //byams snying rje bsgoms pas gnod pa 'byung ba'i skabs gda'/ de'i tshul lugs gang yin snyam na/ byams dang snying rje bsgoms pa yis// nyes pa'i skyon rnams slongs pa'i tshe// rgyud chad med pa'i sbyor ba yis// dngos grub phun sum tshogs par 'gyur// badzra yo ga'i bsgrub pa la// 'bras bu skyon du 'gyur ba dang*// dngos grub thob pa'i khyad par ltos// //nyon mongs gsum khyad par du zhe sdang che na nyams len gyi gnad ji ltar bya snyam na/ rang rgyud la skyes pa'i nyon mongs gsum// khyad par zhe sdang drag po yis// 'khrugs pas yul dang 'dres pa yis// rtags dang mtshan ma byung ba'i tshe// sdig dang dge ba'i grogs po yis// tha dad lam du khrid gyur pas// dbang po rab kyi nyams len gyis// byams dang snying rje'i stobs 'phel ba'i// zhe sdang ri bo chen pos kyang*// snying rje'i mkhal ba sleb mi nus// bla med byang chub sems gnyis kyis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa 'di// bla med gsang sngags chen po ste// sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba rnams// 'dzin par byed pa'i bdag por 'gyur// dbyer med gcig tu ma gyur cing*// tha dad gyur pas rgyal ba yi// zhing du skye bar gyur na yang*// nad dang gnod pa nyes pa yis// rgyun du 'tsho bar 'gyur ba dang*// 'gro ba'i mig tu mi sdug cing*// gshe zhing smad pa'i gnas su 'gyur// shin tu zhan pas sangs rgyas kyi// rigs su sems bskyed gcig pa'i phyir// mi bzad 'jigs pa'i skur bstan te// gsad dang 'gar dang mnan la sogs// phrin las sna tshogs du ma yis// rim gyis bla med sa la 'god//

//nyams su blang ba'i rim pa skad skad cig yod dam snyam na/ ting 'dzin gcig la mnyam bzhag cing*// myong ba skyes par gyur pa'i tshe// snang mdzad kun tu zhal bzhin du// nyams len yul la bye brag med// shin tu dma' ba'i sbyor ba yis// dpal ldan 'bri ba chen po yis// yon tan bskyed pa'i gnad cig gi /myong ba skyes pa gsang bar bya// lha 'dre thams cad mi dga' bas// sne'u zur pa'i yig 'phrin de// nye gnas kyis bltas pas ko long byung*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa dag /de dag kun la khyad par med// //sgrub pa byed pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba srid dam snyam na/ sgrub pa nan tan byas gyur na// bar chad mi 'byung mi srid pas// dngos grub bar chad rang dbang che// lhan cig skyes pas dbang byas pas// rang nyid ye shes he ru kaḥ /gzhan du ci 'dod bsgrub byed pa// gnod sbyin ngo bo gcig tu mchi// chos 'di gsang ba yin mod kyang*// na so rgas pas khyed la bstan// mthar thug shes rab chen po gang*// 'khor bar skye byed shas che bas// sems skad cig gnas par mi gtub ste// phyi rol yul la zhen pa des// khug cing gnas pas zin par 'gyur// de dang 'dra bar gzhan la yang*// don 'di nges par 'dri bar 'gyur// //shes rgyud tha dad pas gzhan la gnod pa bsgrubs pas rang nyid la gnod pa 'byung ba yin snyam na/ snang ba rang gi sems yin pas// pha rol rtag par 'dod pa'i blo// sems can rnams kyi srog gcod pa// de nyid rang nyid yin pa yi// sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur// gnas der sdug bsngal sna tshogs la// gshin rje'i skyes bu rnams kyis bsgrub// log par lta ba gzhir gyur pas// log par gyur te gnod pa 'byung*// gnod pa'i lan du gnod pa bskyal// ji bzhin rgyu 'bras lags mod kyang*// phan pa bsgrubs pas gnod pa de// log lta'i 'bras bu yin par nges//

//nged gsum mkha' 'gro mas gdan 'dren pa la kho 'tshal pas nga rten 'brel la dbang bsgyur bas mi 'gro ste 'ong zhes pa de ci yin snyam na/ bstod pa chen po gsungs pa des// phag mo gru ru byon nas kyang*// zhogs pa nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe// dbu rgyan gnas nas sun ma byung*// rten 'brel mdzad pas bzhugs par gyur// de yi gdams ngag zhus pa las// de cung zad bzla bar mi btub ste// 'on kyang khyod la phyogs tsam bstan// rang nyid dpal ldan he ru kaḥ /bsgoms pas mkha' 'gro'i bdag por 'gyur// 'khor 'das dbyer med de yi srog /bar chad dang po mi 'byung zhing*// byung ba rnams kyang bzlog pa yin// dpal ldan bde mchog la sogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thams cad kun// shin tu yod pa'i rigs su gda'// rang nyid de ltar bsgoms byas pas// de dang 'dra ba'i go 'phang thob// 'di gang yang 'gal bar gyur pa med// gtso bo sems dang sems las byung*// de nyid 'khor du gyur pa'i phyir// tha ma 'gyur zhing 'jam dbyangs dang*// gshin rje gshed la 'gal ba med// gal te kha gdong gtsor gyur na// de nyid zhal gyi rnam par 'gyur// bde stong yab dang yum gyur de// lha mo thams cad skur mthong bas// bde chen rgyas pa'i yon tan 'byung*// //zhe sdang med kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis mda' gzhu la reg par ma gnang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ sems kyis lus dang snang ba dag /byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dge dang mi dge'i 'bras bu dag /'byung bar nges pas mda' gzhu las// brten pa'i zhe sdang gdug sems 'byung*// de yi las kyi rnam smin gyis// sdug bsngal ci phyir 'byung mi 'gyur// pha bsad gcig pus mtshams med ces// gzhan mi nus te bar skabs med// mnar sems rgyud chad med ces pa// thub pa chen pos bka' stsal to// nga yis brdegs dang gshe ba la// 'bras bu mi 'byung ma yin te// phan dang bde ba'i bsam pa yis// 'gro ba'i rgyal por cis mi 'gyur// de phyir sna tshogs snang ba rnams// rtog pa'i bye brag tha dad las// 'byung ba de kho na nyid do//

//zhabs drung dang ri khrod gcig gam snyam na/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// go bas ri khrod gtan la 'bebs// ri khrod dgos par ngo shes pa// zhi gnas la gnas lhag mthong dang*// lhag mthong la gnas zhi gnas kyis// mnyam pa'ang khams kyis 'gro zhes gsung*// //nad dang gnod pa la dang po byin rlabs byas pas bde ba la/ de nas log byung na ci yin snyam na/ 'di shin tu zab pa'i gdam ngag ste// mthar thug byin rlabs chen po yis// dang po lhan gyis bde bar 'gyur// cung zad de rgyun bsrings byas pas// nyes kun slong nas sdug bsngal 'byung*// dpe dri ma langs pa lta bu yin// de rgyun cung zad bsrings pa yis// yon tan rgya mtsho dpungs kyis 'gyur// 'di la mgon pos lung bstan pas// yongs su 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// mtshan nyid dpag tu med pa gsungs// //c-i tsam brtson 'grus byas pa tsam gyis khams ngan par 'ong bar 'dug pa la ji ltar bya snyam na/ snod bcud du 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir// 'byung ba rim rtsegs gsung na yang*// nyan thos rang rgyal yin pa'i phyir// yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis// 'od zer spros pas sems can gyi// sdig dang sgrib pa bsal nas kyang*// yi dam lha ru gyur pa las// 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim// de las gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor du// bsgoms pas des kyang sems can gyi// ma lus rgya chen don 'byung ste// 'di byang chub sems kyi rgyu 'bras yin// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la// 'od zer med pas 'gro ba kun// smin cing grol bar byas pa med// rab gnas la sogs gsang sngags kyi// phrin las kun gyi rtsa ba yin// //dam pa rgya gar gyi zhi byed du// nad dang sdug bsngal byung gyur na// rig pa rten dang phral zhes gsung*// jo bo chen po lha cig gis// dngos po cig la gzhug ces gsung*// jo mo lab sgron gdam ngag las// thabs lam nam mkha' sgo 'byed yod// pha 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// zab mo rten 'brel mnga' ba de// zab mo lus ngag yid gsum la// rtsol bsgrub 'bad rtsol byas pa yis// bde ba ma yin sdug bsngal 'byung*// rlung ldang 'jug gnyis kyis sbyor ba des// gshis la gnas pa med pas so// 'di la tsha tsha 'debs pa dang*// chu gtor gtong ba la sogs pa// dkar phyogs dge bas yon tan 'phel// e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am/// /

bla ma la ji ltar 'bul ba byas pa ltar/ slob ma la yang de bzhin du 'ong bar 'gyur bas/ dpal ldan mar pa lho brag pas// rje btsun chen po'i zhabs tog la// brtags kyang rten 'brel ma mdzad la// 'dir chu'am nas sam me tog gis// legs par bkang nas dkar rdzis byung*// bkra shis shing gi steng bzhag nas// bzlog pa'i thabs la mkhas pa yin// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la// bzang po lta bur snang bas kyang*// dngos po ngan pas 'bab pa yi// na zhing 'chi bar 'gyur nges pas// bu kun rdzob snang ba ban bun la// ji ltar byas pa'i 'bras bu de// bzang ngan khyad med rnam smin 'byung*// 'di chos rje bla ma rin chen gyi// phyag bzhes rten 'brel zab mo lags// //mdze nad la byams snying rje med par lha bsgoms pas phan nam snyam na/ 'jigs su rung ba'i gnod pa de// chu bdag 'khor bcas kyis byas pa min// zhe sdang gdug pa'i nga rgyal des// khro bo chen por bsgoms na yang*// rang nyid la brub ka byas par zad// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyis// gnas skabs mthar thug ma lus pa'i// bde skyid yon tan kun 'byung bas// zhag dang zla ba 'ga' res kyang*// nyes pa'i skyon las grol bar 'gyur// 'di ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// //dus mchod bzhi bsod nams che ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ shin tu gnyan pa'i dus tshod der// nyon mongs rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs// nyes kun rnam par 'dzoms par 'gyur// bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma rnams// u rgyan rgyal pos btul ba yis// dam tshig bdar bas las rnams grub// gti mug wa ra ṇa sīr te// e la'i 'dab sogs klu rnams dang*// mnyan du yod pa zhe sdang ste// gnod sbyin gdug pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// byang chub snying por 'dod chags te// bdud kyi sde rnams btul ba yi// chos skyong srung ma chen por bzhugs// khyad par de dang gzhan yang 'dra// de phyir dus kyi mchod pa dag

/nan tan chen pos bzung bar bya// //nyon mongs pa'i sngon du byang chub kyi sems gtong ba'i dgos pa ci yin snyam na/ spyir nyon mongs rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs// spang bya gnyen po gdod nas med// de nyid shes shing rtogs gyur na// rig pa ye shes kyi dbang byas pas// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor yin// mi shes gti mug dbang gyur pas// khams gsum 'khor ba sdug bsngal myong*// rtogs pa'i gang zag de nyid la// mi dger gyur pa gang yang med// de yang byang chub chen por bsngo// rtogs par ma gyur go bas kyang*// srid pa nus med du btang ba yin// mtshan nyid pha rol phyin pa dang*// gsang sngags theg pa khyad par med// bla na med pa 'dod chags la// dga' ba bzhi dang skad cig bzhi// bcu drug byas pas 'grub mi 'gyur// tha mal phung po'i gnyen po de// yi dam lha nyid yin gyur kyang*// ril po gcig 'dzin gyi shes pa de// dben pa khams dang skye mched sogs// 'khor lo'i bye brag mtha' yas 'gyur// ngag dang sems kyang de bzhin no// gti mug gdod nas yod ma myong*// bde gshegs snying po khams dge ba// mi shes 'khor ba'i 'byung khungs la// rnam dag btsal bas 'grub mi 'gyur// //rje gong ma'i zhal nas// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhal mthong na// 'jigs su rung ba'i klu 'byung ba// de nyid de ru 'gyur ba de// gang mi 'dod pa 'byung lags pa// dngos grub 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid yin// 'on kyang klu nyid gsungs pa de// gang zag gi rigs la dgongs pa lags// //dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas kyis dngos grub nye ba'am/ che ba yin nam snyam na/ 'jigs shing nyam nga'i gnas rnams su// rnal 'byor rab 'bring tha ma yi// rim pas srog gi bar chad dang*// dngos grub yon tan du ma ster// don lung ma bstan du 'ong ba yin// //dmu chu la sogs pa'i nad chen po la sogs pas bsod nams chen por byung na/

de ji ltar yin snyam na/ 'jigs dang sdug bsngal med pa yi// chu bo'i rlabs bzhin 'phyo bas na// snang ba dgra yi 'du shes skye// nyon mongs sred pa'i mthu stobs kyis// rang lus rgyas shing gang ba'i tshe// dug gsum 'bar bas 'khrug pa dang*// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// khyad par gyi dgos pa bsgrub pa yin// spyi la yon tan ma lus dang*// bye brag tha dad tha dad pas// rtsa ba'i dam tshig mig bzhin bsrung*// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// nyes tshogs bdud las rgyal na yang*// dkar phyogs dge ba'i chos rnams la// rgyun chad med pa'i sbyor bas 'grub// thub pa chen po 'od bsrungs nas// mkhyen bzhin bzhugs dang 'byon pa dang*// bltams dang rdzogs sangs rgyas pa yin// dmigs dang rang bzhin thams cad la// nor ma nor go bar byung na ni// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan yin// //char 'bebs pa'i gnad gang yin snyam na/ 'jig rten khams kyi sems can rnams// las mi dge drag pos dbang byas pas// char chu dus su mi 'bab cing*// nyes pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung*// byams dang snying rjer ldan pa yis// skyes bu chen po cig yod pas// phrin las bsgrubs pas char pa 'bab// dpal gyi lha mo'i dam tshig gis// klu dang sa y-i snying po yi// thug dam rgyud bskul de nas 'byung*// chos lnga dag la 'bad byas na// de las 'byung bar nges pa ste// snang ba rang gi sems kyi phyir// byams pa chen po'i mthu stobs kyis// mi mthun rkyen las skyes pa yi// rig pa ngar dang ldan pa'i tshe// lha dbang lha min 'joms pa dang*// bden pa'i tshogs rnams 'grub pa dang*// de las skyes pa 'byung ba dang*// byams pa chen po sngon 'gro ba'i// 'jig rten dbang po'i klong zhes pa// ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu stobs ltos// //gang la yang dus kyi gnad skad cig las med pas 'di'i dus su bsgoms na phyi ma'i nyes pa bzlog pa'i tshad gang yin snyam na/

shes pa phra bar gyur na go// zab pa'i gdams ngag bstan rgyu yod// 'dod chags chos la spyod pa'i tshe// bskyed byed rgyu nyid 'byung ba de// dus dang yun gyi khyad par gyis// byung dang ma byung ji lta bar// rten 'brel tshogs pa'i sbyor ba yis// sdod dang 'gro ba de dag la// khyad par de las med par nges// nges par nyams su myong bas grub// dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad kyis// mkha' la nges par 'khrid byed cing*// mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro ba la// da lta bzhugs pa ngo mtshar che// //bla ma mnyes pas don 'grub pa ji ltar yin snyam na// rta brgya phul bar gyur pa bsad// de na 'ongs pa de nyid thob// go ba skyes pas rtogs pa phul// de las logs su 'khor 'das med// des ma phul med de stong gsum 'di// gser gyis bkang ba'i do ma yin// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal tshe gcig gis// gling bzhi la dbang zhing sa kun// 'bad pas rang 'tsho tsam las med// 'di rnam dag 'gres su go bar mdzod// //sngags kyi grangs kyis phan nam snyam na/ kha cig bsgoms kyang mi phan zhing*// kha cig yengs bas gzhan la phan// sngags kyi de nyid ma shes na// bzlas pa don med go bar bya// //rten rnying pa'am/ lha 'dres bzung ba'i rab gnas byed na ji ltar bya snyam na/ lha 'dres bzung ba'i rten rnams la// gang ltar brtags pa der 'gyur bas// thams cad ta tha sang kra har// ston pas ma thul gang yang med// chos skyong yin pas byams pa dang*// snying rje bsgom ste rgyal po la// khong gi ched du dge ba spyad// nyes pa de dang bdag cag gis// rjes la dge ba mnyam par bya// phyi nas 'brang bar mi 'gyur bar// gtor ma gtang de gter dang mdzod// 'dod par bsams nas de gtad do// gang ltar byas kyang bdag nyid la// grib skyon byung bas phan pa la// gnod par mi 'gyur bdag bsrung ba// nyams len rim pa ji lta ba'o// des na rgyal po bla ma dag

/bdag la ngo mnyam shes par bya// //bskyed rim la brtan pa thob kyang*/ 'drer skyes pa dang gnod pa bskyed pa dang phan pa mi 'byung ba'i rgyu ci yin snyam na/ byang chub sems las skyes pa yis// gsang sngags bskyed pa'i rim pa la// mtshams sbyor gzhan gyis byas gyur na// de 'gyur dpung dang stobs med pas// sbyor ba'i gnad 'di shes nas kyang*// lha yi bar chad cung zad de// cis kyang 'byung ste lta ba yis// thag bcad dge dang mi dge'am// btang snyoms bde sdug la sogs pa// sku gsung thugs kyi nges pa bskyed// 'dis ni cung zad mi gnyan par// go rtogs ldan pas shes par bya// //rtsa dang 'khor lo'i grangs mang nyung zab pa yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ rtsa yi gnas lugs mi gtso ste// rang gi bsam pas bsgyur ba'i phyir// lam gyi rim pa gsum du go// des na 'du shes gtso shes bya// g.yos la mkhas pa ltar bcas pa// dge ba mi 'dod gang yang med// de gzhan gyi dbang du mi btang bar// bdag nyid kyis ni bsgrub par bya// 'di babs la gnas na gdams ngag go/ //sdig pa bshags pa dang 'dag pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ sa bon rnam par shes pa gang*// des khyad par du byas pa lus ngag las// las de sems las 'byung ba'i phyir// skad cig gis lus dang snang bar 'gyur// snang ba sems kyis dbang byas shing*// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel las 'byung ba'i phyir// las ji ltar spyad pa mi zad cing*// gnyen po bsten pas 'joms par 'gyur// rkyen mi mthun gnas nas 'byung ba'am// zhi bar bya ba'am sgrol lo zhes// spyi don rnam gsum gzhan lugs lags// shin tu phra ba'i rnam pa yis// gnas lugs kyi ngang du lhan gyis zhi// mda' gzhu lta bu'i sbyor ba yis// rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol brgal// me dpung 'bar ba chen po yis// dngos po ma lus thal bar brlag /'bar ba'i mgo bo mi bzad pas// steng gi chu rgyun 'bab pa gcod// rgya mtsho chen por bying ba'i tshe// rnam dag nam mkha'i mthong khung dbye// cis kyang mi phan 'chi gyur na// nges par 'pho ba'i gdam ngag brtsam// tshe zad pa'i mtha' ru mi phyin na// rtsa rlon lag pas dkrugs pa ltar// smyo 'bog snying rlung gi gnod pa 'byung*// tshe dang las zad mthar thug na// chu khams zad pa'i rtsa dang 'dra// 'di brgyud pa'i gdams ngag nying khu yin// rgan po mdze po rten zhan la// btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba gsungs pa de// nges par sdug grir shi bas na// rab tu byung bas mi bya gsung*// gnad lnga dang ldan pa'i 'pho ba 'di// khyad par kun las 'phags pa'i phyir// yul dang bsam pa rtsa dang rlung*// dus kyi gnad kyis tshegs med par// dpal rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob//

//gnas las byung ba'i grib sel gyi// gdams pa dpag med gsungs na yang*// thal tshan chu grang gi sbyor ba dang*// rim cig bri dang bstan par bya// bdag gis ting 'dzin rtsed mo yis// brag la mi mthun phyogs rnams 'phos// de la me yi sbyor ba byas// 'byung ba bzhi po 'dra bar gda'// nges par pha phogs yin pa'i phyir// cis kyang 'byung bar nges pas na// ting nge 'dzin gyis len byed cing*// ting 'dzin gcig pus sel ba yin// mos gus ldan pa'i slob ma de// drung du phyin dang ma phyin med// shin tu gces par gyur na ni// dus yun ring gces par mdzad pa yin// mi gces myur du phyung ngam snyam// spyir phan dang bde ba thams cad kun// bskyed par byed pa'i gdams ngag ni// rig par ldan pa'i sa ga mas// ri dwags 'dzin gyi rim 'gro ltar// brtags shing dpyad pas rtog pa yis// phan pa bskyed byed de bstan pas// nad dang sdug bsngal dag las thar// 'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal po yis// sa yi steng 'di sman gyis gang*// thams cad rtogs pas mkhas pa yin// 'di 'jig rten rig byed thams cad dang*// thub pa'i dam chos ma lus pa// thog ma bar dang mthar dge gang*// dang por dge ba bar dang mthar// dge ba gcig pur 'gyur ba 'di// myong ba can gyi dam chos yin// //rdzas kyi rten 'brel shes pa de mchog yin nam snyam na/ phyi rol rten 'brel ma lus pa// mo bon ju yag dang khyad par med// bdag la lo gsum bar du byung*// bdag ni shin tu gsang dam pas// phyi rol du ma shor bsam pa'i gnad// mi rtag rten 'brel go ba'i phyir// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyis// dam pa'i chos su phebs pa yin// rlung gi stobs kyis bsal ba las// skyon dang yon tan gang yang min/ /snang zhing shes pa de dag kun// mkhyen pa'i ye shes khyad par med// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho de// phyag rgya chen por yong ba las// rdzu 'phrul rtags dang mtshan mas min// 'di bon pos skyug log yi chad lags//

//rang gi 'khor gces pa snying por gyur pa tshe ring bar 'dod na ji ltar bya snyam na/ rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs skyong ba'i// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams// rang dang 'khor rnams tshe ring zhing*// bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba dang*// khyad par bar chad med 'dod na// rang bskyed rim brtan pa gzhir bzhag pas// ma 'ongs 'byung ba yi dam lhar// bsgoms pas mthong tshad lhar 'gyur lags/ khyad par gces pa de bzhin no// //srog thig ler gzhug pa'i man ngag ni// nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*// ting 'dzin bzang po skye 'dod pas// dang por nyon mongs lam du btang*// de rjes byang chub sems las byung ba yi// khams gsum bdag po chen po yis// 'od ma 'grim pa lta bu la// ind+ra ni la mtshan gyi 'od// 'bar ba rtsa ba lta bur bsgom// rlung a wa dhu tīr tshud gyur pas// mtha' dbus med par bde chen 'bar// sems ni gzugs kyi khams nyid de// 'od gsal khams gsum ngo bo nyid// de rgyun chad med par bskyang bar bya// //gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa la byams snying rje bsgoms pas de 'chi ba nges par 'dug pas mi 'chi ba'i thabs yod dam snyam na/ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs gyur pas// phan dang gnod pa 'byung ba dang*// byams dang snying brtse yod par gcig /nges par phung bar gyur pa yin// ma 'ongs dus su thugs rjes bzung*// de las gzhan pa'i gdams ngag med// ma bsgoms dus su 'byung ba de// dam chos phyag rgya chen po yin// bsgoms pas nyams su myong ba de// rnal 'byor ting 'dzin kha zas yin// gzhan don bsgoms pas 'byung ba'i phyir// mi mthun bsal bas bcos par bya// bde ba 'gro ba thams cad 'dren// mi rtog ting 'dzin skye ba'i gnas// phyi rol yul la dmigs pa de// 'phros pas rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang*// stong nyid ngang du gnas pa de// bsdus pas yum gyi mkha' la 'khyil// 'di 'gro ba'i don phyir de bzhin gshegs//

//tshad med bzhi sems can gyi dus na gang yin pa dang*/ yon tan ci skye snyam na/ byams pas sems kyi rnam par gdungs// yi mug snying rje chen po nyid// dga' ba yul la 'dod cing chags// btang snyoms rnam pa gsum du 'dod// kun khyab byams pa chen po'i sems// de yi rje 'brangs sems las byung*// yon tan sgrub pa man ngag gnad// snying rje gnod pa'i sgor gyur pas// gshe dang brdeg dang 'jigs par byed// dbang ni 'dod pa'i gnas gyur pa// de bas lhag pa yod pa'i phyir// de yi rdzas kyi sbyor ba rnams// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dngos grub kun// dbyer med rang bzhin gyis len gyur pas// phyi ni dga' zhing nyams bde ste// nang gi dngos grub de nyid kyang*// bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel pa yis// don rtsa ba'i rdzas kyi gnad du nges// //phyag rgya chen po'i khrid ma gtogs pa'i bskyed pa'i thabs yod dam snyam na/ sbyor ba'i chos kyi dbang byas pa'i// bden pa gnyis kyis man ngag dang*// thun 'jog a ro la sogs pa// khong rang grub mtha'i bye brag rnams// bsgoms par gyur pa'i dus gcig na// ngo sprod byas pas chog pa yi// gcig tu 'dre ba'i dus gnas yod// nyams skyes pa 'dag par nus pa yi// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma dgos// 'jig rten mgon pos mdzad pa lags// //rin po che'i bu slob la/ rnam par thar pa dang rtogs pa tha dad par 'ong bar 'dug pa de la ji ltar blta snyam na/ sems can kun gyi nyon mongs dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'phrin las 'di// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yis// tha dad rim pa gsum du gnas// 'di shes shing mthong bas 'gro ba la// yun ring bskal par bsgom mi dgos// de nyid mthong bar ma gyur na// bskal pa lhag par bsgoms na yang*// 'bras bu thob pa'i dus med pas// grangs med bskal pas ga la phan// grub mtha' tha dad sna tshogs pa// bzung na yon tan mi skye bas// sems rtogs pa'i gang zag min pa med// rtogs pa de nyid gzhir gyur pa'i// yul gyi dngos po rtogs pa yi// bye brag mtha' yas tshad med pas// e ma rnam thar bsam mi khyab// de ltar bltas pas yon tan gyi// phung po chen po khyed la skyes// sde 'khrug byas pa'i gnas la sogs// grib kyis sems la phog gyur cing*// shing skam dang 'dra bar gyur pa las// snang ba zil gnon gyi gdams ngag dgos// 'di la dkon mchog gsum gyi rten// tsha tsha 'debs pa la sogs dang*// thub pas gsungs shing byin rlabs pa// zab mo'i mdo sde bsgrags pa dang*// dge slong bzhi sde la sogs par// byin gyis brlab par zhu ba 'di// phyi yi rten cing 'brel pa yin// nang ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag ni// thabs dang shes rab kyi bogs 'don gyi// man ngag la brten zab mo'i rlung*// bcom ldan 'das kyis dbu snyung bzhes// sems las su cung zad rung ba'i tshe// zhe sdang 'pho ba'i byed las gcig

/gnyis kas 'chi bar byed pa yin// slob ma rnams la gdams pa de// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la// zhe sdang gis ni mthar byed 'gyur// 'dir yang 'dod pa'i yul de ru// zhe sdang gi de yi lus su 'gyur// //dang po bsod nams byung nas phyis bsod nams chung ba de rgyu gang yin snyam na/ dran dang shes bzhin bag yod dang*// chog shes nor rnams don gcig phyir// snga ma'i thog tu ma gnas nas// phyi ma 'dod pa'i skyon gyis 'byung*// snga ma de nyid chog shes na// yon tan ngo bo nyid kyis skye// thub pa'i dam chos ma lus pa// mi chos mdun chos zab mo yin// gshis tha dad du yod pas mi 'gyur bar// sbyor dngos gnyis po mi 'gyur yang*// rjes la 'khor ba bskyed par 'gyur// bsam pa mi dge ba'i bsam pa dang*// gnyis med dbye ba med gyur kyang*// phyi ma bsgrub byed las kyis 'byed// 'di yon tan rgya mtsho bskyed pa'i gzhi// //man ngag 'di rnams mi bzhed yang bsgoms pas phan par 'dug pa ci yin snyam na/ blo sbyong gi man ngag zab mo dang*// bdag nyid chen po'i bha ling gis// lus srog gnyis la chags zhen bral// nad dang gnod pa ldog pa de// gshis 'gyur ba med pas phan lags kyang*// don 'di sus kyang go ba med// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// 'khor lo mgo la bzod bya ba// sdug cing bsngal bar dogs pa'i sems// bzod pa'i stobs kyis zil gyis mnan// 'khor lo mkha' la 'khor ba de// don ngo bo nyid kyis mkhas la 'byung*// ded dpon ston pa'i man ngag med// gal te man ngag yod gyur na// cung zad de la ltar gyur pas// rang byung byang chub sems su gnas// phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob bo// 'di khyed kyi dri ba la brten te// de ring go ba skyes pa min// gnad 'di snga nas mngon du gyur// spyir 'jig rten mgon po'i bzhed pa yis// pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis kyi don// bla ma'i gdams ngag rim pa yis// don 'di 'byung bar gyur pa de// zhi gnas ting 'dzin bzang po yin// de spros med 'od gsal du rtogs gyur pas// lhag mthong ting 'dzin dag pa yin// phun tshogs yon tan ma lus pa// byang chub sems las 'byung bar nges// ngan zhing brnyas par gyur pa de// bzang po yin snyam nga rgyal skye// bcud dgu ldan pa snod byas na// me yi nang du bsregs pas dri ngan byung*// gos bzang po 'dod kyang ma rnyed de// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// 'gro ba'i don phyir 'bad pa des// phun tshogs yon tan rgya mtsho byung*//

//mi'i lus dge ba bcus 'grub pa la chags sdang gis mtshams sbyar ba'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// las dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan// chags sdang rmongs gsum kun gyis bskyed// skye med chos skus 'khor ba spong*// byams pa byang chub sems nyid la// 'khor gsum du rtog pa ma rig pa// de dang mthun dang 'gal rkyen gnyis// chags shing sdang ba khyad par chos// 'khor ba skyed byed byed pa'i gzhi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i bdag /sangs rgyas rnams dang sems dpa' dang*// 'khor 'das thams cad 'di las byung*// 'di ni rmad du byung ba'i chos// dge sbyor la mnyam par bzhag dus su// bar chad bdud kyi tshogs 'byung ba// de nyid choms par ma gyur na// phyis kyi bkren rnying ldang bar 'gyur// bla med dbye dgon spongs pa ru// thab tu 'ong bas 'brum bu byung*// sal sil dang khrul ma byas pas ldog /'di la byang chub sems nyid dang*// chos lnga de dag yin gyur kyang*// dngos po de nyid phyag rgya che// yi dam lha ru gyur pa yis// snga ma byang zhing phyis mi 'byung*// de phyir dngos po re re yang*// rgyal ba rigs lngar gyur pa'i phyir// rigs kyi dbye ba bsam mi khyab// //phyi yul gyi dngos po nang du ting nge 'dzin bskyed par byed pa ni/ phyi rol rten 'brel ma lus pas// rang gzhan sgrub par byed pa 'di// thub pa chen pos mkhyen pa yin// bde chen skye ba'i gnas dros pas// byin rlabs ma yin ngo bo nyid// rten 'brel grub pas 'byung ba de// dpal birwa chen po'i bzhed par gda'// 'on kyang 'grig dang bsgrig mkhan gang*// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyis// stong nyid snying rje yin zhes gsungs// khyed kyis cis kyang 'di gnyis las// gzhan pa'i dam chos ma tshol cig/ //bya ba 'grub pa'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ spyir shes pa'i stobs la gnas pa yi// bya ba dang byed pa rgya chen 'grub// mtho dman bya ba thams cad la// bdag 'dzin btang bas phyal gyis 'gro// khyed kyi thog tu de 'dra ba'i// bya ba byung ba ji ltar bsgrub// gcig pu gnyis su med pa ru// ri khrod dgon par shad kyis 'gro// de bya bar dka' ba'i spyod pa yis// de yang nyon mongs sems kyis min// dam pa'i chos la bsgrub pa byas gyur na// phun sum tshogs pa kun gyis 'du// skyu ra yon bdag nya bzang gis// ja zho lnga la yi chad de// sgrub pa byas pa zhe sdang yin// thun mong ma yin gdams pa ni// ji ltar bstan dang bshad pa dang*// lo rgyus mtho dman thams cad kun// rtsa bar gyur pa 'di las med// mi mthun gnod pa tshan chen la// gzung 'dzin byas shing bros na yang*// phyi phyir 'jigs pa chen po skye// de nyid kyi thog tu bsdad nas kyang*// lam du btang ba'i man ngag dang*// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po yis// yon tan rgya mtshor dpungs kyis 'gyur// nyon mongs dug gi dmag tshogs de// gnyen po ye shes rdo rjes 'joms// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen des// khro gtum rngam pas gdug pa sgrol// kun bzang chos dbyings khyab par yang*// zhi ba'i bdag nyid lhun gyis grub// thub mchog bla ma mnyes bya'i phyir// gus pa'i bdag nyid phyi bzhin 'brang*// phyi rol yul gyi rkyen dbang gis// skyed byed bsam pa de yi lus// gcig dang du mar snang ba'o//

//lar gyi bya ba'i 'dug lugs kyis// dbyings 'di byas na bsdad pa ste// dngos por gyur pa ci yang rung*// bya byed ma lus thams cad la// ma byas dbyings su glod pas grub// stong pa nyid la mnyam bzhag pas// shes bya kun la thogs pa med// rig bya rig byed med pa ste// bzo rig pa yin zhes bla mas gsung*// glod dang sgrim pa rab spangs nas// spyir mtha' dang bral na legs par 'gyur// dmigs pa mos gus stobs su 'byung*// mos pa myong ba skyes na thob// snyan cing mjeb pa'i dam pa'i chos// dpag tu med pa bshad na yang*// mos gus med par gyur pa de// shin tu skom pas gdungs pa la// me la bsten ces smras pas nyes// chu bsil 'thung zhes bstan na go// de nyid myong ba'i man ngag des// lus sems gnyis po tshim gyur nas// cis kyang phan btags drin du go// nyams myong lha la skyes pa de// rgad po rgan mo mdze mo'ang rung*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa yin// de cis kyang spong bar mi 'gyur ro// bu cig khyed kyi dam chos la// nan tan 'bad par bya bar rigs// ngas ni dka' las sdug bsngal gyis// chos 'di'i go ba rnyed pa yin// ngas dka' bas bsgrubs pa'i man ngag gnad// khyed la nan tan chen pos gdams// legs par g.yos pa'i kha zas la// zos pas chog pa'i dus dang 'dra// de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis// bsgrub la nan tan 'bad par zhu// gdams ngag man chung gi mgo bskor dang*// tshig dang tha snyad kyi spros pa la// zab cing rgya che chos kyi gnad// 'byung bar gyur pa ma yin te// tshig phreng ri bo bsnol ba'i bar// don mnyam nyid yangs pa'i yangs thang yod// ston pa'i dam chos bsdus pa'i don// 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs dgongs mchog /byang chub sems gnyis ma gtogs pa// tshig tshogs gdams ngag gi spros pa chod// bla ma rnam pa sna tshogs kyi// gdams pa tha dad sna tshogs pas// rlabs chen don du mi 'gyur te// rje gong mas thams cad phyogs sngar bzhag

/nga yang gcig tu de rung 'brang*// gzhan la sna tshogs gdams pa mnga'// mkhas dang rmongs pa'i khyad par gyis// skyes chen gnyis kyis mdzad pa la// da lta khyed kyis lta bar gyis// de phyir 'jig rten mgon po yi// rjes su 'brang ba nyid du mdzod// //lar gyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog la// nges par skyabs su song ba dang*// nyon mongs rnam rtog spong ba yi// tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang*// snying rje chen po las byung ba'i// byang chub sems kyi mthu stobs dang*// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// dbang las byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis// sdom gsum gcig tu gyur pa yis// thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba dang*// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal dang*// mi mthun bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs// bdud kyi sde rnams bcom nas kyang*// chos rje khams gsum las rgyal bar// thob par 'gyur ba the tshom med// bu de phyir dam chos shes bya la// rnam gzhag tsam du ma song bar// rang rgyud dag pa shin tu gces// thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab kyis// nyon mongs las sdug bsngal 'byung ba 'di// mngon gsum du mthong zhing go na yang*// spong ba'i thabs la mi 'bad na// dgra 'byung bar shes kyang mi 'bros pas// rang nyid gsod par 'gyur dang 'dra// de phyir de nyid bsgom pa la// bsrung bzlog man ngag logs su med// gal te rkyen ngan bzlog gyur kyang*// lam dog po'i 'phrang du tshud gyur na// mnyam nyid sum gnyis sum cha yi// don ma go bas lan pa yin// mnyam dang lhag pa cis kyang dgos// de ltar nyams su blangs pa yis// gzugs snang tha dad sna tshogs pa// gnyis med ye shes phyag rgya che// tshogs drug lha yi dkyil 'khor yin// mig ni sa yi snying po ste// sdug dang mi sdug bar ma gsum// padma rdo rje sangs rgyas rigs// de nyid yum lnga'i rang bzhin te// ring dang thung dang bar ma dag

/rigs gsum de nyid lngar gyur pas// bde gshegs rigs brgyar 'gyur ba yin// de dag thams cad gnyis med cing*// lhun grub sems kyi de nyid du// gcig pa rigs gcig tu grags pas// 'di ni 'bras bu mthar thug pa// sems can khams dang mnyam pas na// bsam mi khyab pa'i phrin las yin// //de ltar 'gro mgon zhabs drung du// shākya'i dge sbyong bsod snyoms pa// rgyal sras shes rab 'byung gnas kyis// legs gsung dri med rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bsam gyis mi khyab thob na yang*// nam mkha' lta bur mtha' med phyir// dman pa'i rang blos 'dzin ma nus// brjed pas 'jigs pas bsdus pa'i don// 'khor 'das kun gyi srog snying rnams// yi ger bris par gyur pa la// bla ma mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// thugs rje chen pos brtser dgongs te// byin gyis brlab cing bzod par bzhengs// bdag ji srid 'khor ba ma stong tshe// mnyam med bla ma rin chen dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing*// mnyes pa dam pas mnyes par shog /bdag chos dbyings zhing khams ma lus par// rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab rnams// sgrib pa med par mthong ba dang*// dge ba mtha' dag bsgrub par shog /bdag dri med gsungs pa'i dam chos la// spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*// mi shes rmongs pa'i sems can kun// bdud rtsis tshim par byed par shog /bdag nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing*// bsod nams mi g.yo lhun po yis// skye 'gro nye bar 'tsho ba dang*// mthar phyin rtag pa'i sa thob shog /bdag mthar thug stobs bcu la gnas shing*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// ma nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang chub mchog la 'god par shog /dge ba 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa des// bdag dang sems can ma lus pa// bla med byang chub myur thob shog /rje 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rje rin po che'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi dri ma med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba rdzogs so//

// 822) ༄// thabs lam gnad bdun ma// bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la phyag 'tshal lo// de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig bka' bstsal pa las/ theg pa che chung gnyis su 'dus la/ de la theg pa chen po la gnyis te/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags so// gsang sngags la rgyud sde bzhi/ de la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ de'i don hril gyis dril nas nyams su len pa la/ zab pa rtsa rlung thig le gsum yin par gsungs so// de las rtsa rlung byang sems kyi gnad 'di la don bdun te/ sgrub pa po gang zag gi gnad/ dus khyad par can gyi gnad/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i gnad/ dbang du bya ba byang chub sems bskyed kyi gnad/ gsol ba gdab pa bla ma'i gnad/ dngos gzhi nyams su blang pa'i gnad/ de'i bral 'bras kyi gnad do// de'i dang po ni/ chags grol gnyis gang yin yang/ lus phun sum tshogs pa dbang po sgo lnga la skyon med pa/ na tshod dar la bab pa snying stobs che ba/ skad gcig la sangs rgya bar 'dod pa zhig gis nyams su blang bar bya ba yin no// gnyis pa/ dus kyi gnad ni gtum mo 'bar 'dzag la gnad du song bas 'dod chags skyes pa'i dus dang*/ khyad par du nya stong la sogs pa'i dus bzhi dang*/ bud med mthong ba la chags pa drag po skyes pa'i dus su gnad du bsnun no// gsum pa/ gnas ri khrod dam dgon pa dben pa sgra'i ku co dang mi tshogs g.yeng ba med pa shin tu dben pa gal che ba yin no// bzhi pa/ sems bskyed kyi gnad ni/ gang nyams su len pa'i sngon du/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rtsa rlung byang sems la gnad du bsnun par bya snyam du dar cig bsgom/ des dbang byas pa'i rtog pa thams cad byang sems su 'gyur ba dang*/

chags can lta bu yin na'ang nyon mongs pa thams cad byang chub sems kyis dbang byas pas legs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab/ nyams pa'i skyon thams cad des khegs pa yin no// lnga pa/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha' 'am/ spyi bo'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum gyi rnam par bzhugs/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drang zhing bstim/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod la/ nyon mongs pa thams cad bde stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gdung pa dang bcas pas lan mang du gdab bo// bde chen skye mi skye'i gnad 'di la rag las/ drug pa/ nyams su len pa'i gnad la gsum ste/ rtsa'i ngo bo gang yin pa dang*/ rlung gi ngo bo gang yin pa dang*/ byams sems kyi ngo bo gang yin pa'o// dang po rtsa la mang yang gsum po 'dir 'dus pa yin te/ g.yas ro ma nas khrag 'bab/ g.yon rkyang ma nas dri chu 'bab/ dbus dbu ma nas byang sems 'bab/ de la lus dkyil krung bcas nas drang por bsrang bas/ rtsa drang por gnas par 'gyur bas/ a ba dhu ti la gnad du bsnun pa 'di shin tu zab par 'ong ste/ de ltar yang*/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas/ a ba dhu tī'i stong ra 'di// stong ra'i nang nas mchog tu gsungs// ces so// gnyis pa rlung la mang yang gsum du 'dus pa yin/ sna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba'i rlung de rtsol ba zhes bya ste sdug bsngal bskyed par byed do// g.yon nas rgyu ba'i rlung srog zhes bya ste/ bde ba ster bar byed do// cha mnyam du rgyu ba de ye shes kyi rlung yin te/ de la gnad du bsnun pas yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bskyed par byed do// de ltar yang slob dpon arya de ba'i zhal snga nas/ rlung gi de nyid rab rtogs nas// sems kyi de nyid rtogs par 'gyur// zhes so// gsum pa byang sems ni/

'dod chags chen po skyes pa'i dus su/ skyes pa dang bud med dang dud 'gro dang*/ de rnams la rang dbang med par 'dzing snying 'dod pa 'byung ste/ de la byang sems zer/ chags pa de nyid la gsang sngags nas bde ba zer bas/ pha rol tu phyin pa nas 'dod chags sam nyon mongs pa zer bas/ lam nye ring gi khyad par yang de yin/ de la gnad du byed pa la gsum ste/ rab kyi phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad pa dang*/ 'bring gis dngos grub tu 'khyer ba dang*/ tha mas gegs sel du bya ba dang gsum mo// dang po ni gong ltar du skyes pa'i dus su/ phyag rgya chen po rgyu phyam phyam bsgoms pas thig le'i dwangs ma thams cad ting nge 'dzin du gyur nas/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'char ro// gnyis pa 'bring gis sum khrid ltar 'dod chags kyi rtog pa de ma shor phar phur tshugs su bsgoms te/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa de shor na/ dngos grub shor ba yin pas 'bad pa chen pos nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa gegs sel bya ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa rlung bsgoms pa'i dus su rtsa mo rtsar/ rlung pho rlung zhugs pas tha mal pa'i 'dod chags pas kyang bcu drug char yang mi phod pa'i chags pa tshugs thabs med pa skyes pa'i dus su bsgom pa yin te/ de la dang po rlung la 'di ltar byang bar bya ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gtum mo ltar ram/ yang na dkyil krung du byas la/ 'og sgo 'khor ba'i rgyun thag gcad pa zhes bya ste/ sgro bshang gnyis kyi bar rus pa'i steng na byang sems rgyu ba'i rtsa yod pas/ rkang pa'i rting pas tsir gyis mnan/ lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis kyis srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan cing khu tshur bcangs te 'khyud pa'i tshul du bya/ rkang pa'i sor mo rgyu zhabs su bskum par bya'o// de nas rlung gi gnad dang sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ rtsa dbu ma gsal gdab/ gsang gnas rdo rje'i rtsa bar hūṃ dkar po zhig bsams la/ ngag tu hūṃ zhes ring ba dang*/

hūṃ zhes thung ba'i dus su hūṃ gis rlung sems gnyis 'dus/ de nas yar hril gyis spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor 'gro yang 'gro la spungs kyis song bar bsam zhing spyi bo'i steng du rig pa byang chub kyi sems 'di 'dzin med rtog med du ma yengs par rlung bzung bar bya'o// de nas yang 'khor lo bzhi rim pa ltar yar mar dbab/ yang yar then/ de ltar yar sbyong mar sbyong byas la rjes sam skabs su lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis rlung dang byang sems lus la khengs par bya'o// de ltar yang yang sbyangs pas/ 'byongs pa'i rtags rgyun je chung je chung rgyun 'chad/ ma chad kyang nyung du 'gro/ rdo rje sbubs su nub/ thig le phyir lan gcig kyang mi 'chor ro// de nas 'dod chags tshan po che skyes pa'i dus su// gong ltar lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang*/ rlung gi byed pa dang*/ sems kyi dmigs pa gsum gyis gnad du bsnun la lus dgram zhing phyag rgya chen po bde stong mtha' dbus med pa'i ngang la 'byams su gzhug de ltar yang 'dod chags nyid kyis 'dod chags 'dag ces pa'am/ de yang rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ rtsa ba'i bde ba gang yin pa// 'khor ba'i gnas su bsgom par bya// shes rab mchog gi mda' dag gis// rtog pa'i rgyun la rab tu 'bigs// zhes pa'o// bdun pa bral 'bras la gnyis te/ sgrib pa 'dag tshul dang phan yon dang 'bras bu thob tshul lo// dang po ni 'dod chags drag po skyes pa'i dus su/ snying rus chen po bskyed nas yang dang yang du bsgoms pas nang du rtsa mdud mang po grol te/ de'i dus su las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad rtsa ba nas 'dag pa yin no// gnyis pa rtsa dpa' mo'i rang bzhin dang*/ rlung dpa' bo'i rang bzhin dang*/ thig le gnyis med kyi rang bzhin gnad du song ba'i tshe na/ tshe ring ba dang*/ nad nyung ba dang*/ 'khor 'du ba dang*/ rin po che'i rdzas la sogs pa thams cad 'byung ba dang*/

mngon par shes pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa grub chen brgyad/ dmigs pa gang la gtad kyang gsal ba dang*/ yi dam gyi lha zhal mthong zhing*/ gsung thos pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnad 'di las 'byung ngo*// yang sa dang lam gyi rim pa thams cad kyang skad gcig la bgrod nas 'gro ba la thogs pa med de/ sprul pa'i sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ chos kyi sku mngon du gyur ba yin te/ de yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i sangs rgyas las khyad par du 'phags pa/ zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yan lag bdun ldan du gyur pa yin te/ de la yan lag bdun nam/ dbyings ye shes dbyer med pa'am/ spros pa thams cad dang bral bas na/ rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag dang*/ ye shes kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba theg pa chen po'i chos la longs spyod pa'i rten du gyur pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i yan lag dang*/ snying rje dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i brdar/ btsun mo dang zhal sbyor gyi rnam par snang bas kha sbyor gyi yan lag dang*/ zag med kyi bde bas rgyud yongs su gang bas bde chen gyi yan lag dang*/ nam mkha' ltar mdzad pa'i 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pas rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yan lag dang*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pas/ thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pas/ nyid kyis 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag snying rjes yongs su gang ba'i yan lag go// de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyis// ma rnams bde chen myur thob shog /thabs lam gnad bdun ma rdzogs s+ho// bka' rgya dang bcas pa'o// gu ha'o// 823)

༄// seng ge'i sgra sgrogs de nyid bzhi pa// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel gyis// me long gzugs brnyan gsal ba ltar// gang de de ru rtogs par byed// bde chen zung 'jug phyag 'tshal lo// gsang sngags snying po don gyi bcud// bde chen de nyid bzhi pa 'di// skal ldan gang gis rab bsgom na// skad gcig de la bde gshegs 'gyur// de la 'dir ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad khrid kyi rim pa yin la/ sangs rgyas bsgrub par byed pa yin mod kyis/ de'i nang nas tshe gcig lus gcig gis/ skad cig gcig la sangs rgya bar byed pa'i chos gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud yin/ de hril gyis dril bas/ rtsa rlung thig le gsum la 'dus te/ de ltar yang rje btsun chen po tilli pa'i zhal snga nas/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas/ sems las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas med// lam rtsa dang rlung las myur ba med// ces gsungs so// de la bzhi ste/ rtsa'i de nyid/ rlung gi de nyid dang*/ byang sems kyi de nyid dang*/ bde chen gyi de nyid do// de la rtsa la dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de la rtsa'i de nyid lus ril ril po 'di yin/ de yi dam gyi lhar shes pas gnad du bsnun/ des rtsa thams cad dbang du byed do// yang rlung la dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de gang yin na/ dran rig sna tshogs su 'gyu ba 'di rlung gi de nyid yin/ de la ma yengs par gnad du bsnun/ des rlung thams cad dbang du byed do// yang byang sems la dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de gang yin na/ phyi nang gi bde ba de byang sems kyi de nyid yin/ de la bde chen lam slongs kyis gnad du bsnun/ des thig le thams cad dbang du byed do// bde chen la dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab te/

de gang yin na bde stong zung 'jug gi de nyid yin/ de la zung 'jug gis gnad du bsnun/ des zung 'jug bsam gyis mi khyab par 'gyur ro// de ltar na phyi 'dod yon lam du khyer bas/ nang gi bde ba cher 'bar ba ste/ bde chen du nyams su myong dgos/ de ltar myong na tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba'am/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa bya ba yin/ yang bde ba ltar gyis rgyas pa'i dus su/ phyag rgya chen por phril gyis bsgom/ stong pa la'ang bde bas bsnun la bsgom/ de ltar bde stong zung 'jug la nyams su blangs pas/ rjes shes thams cad kyang bde chen du 'khyer ro// de ltar ma shes na lus thig le'i gong bur song yang dgos pa med la/ sems nam mkha' ltar rtogs kyang sangs mi rgya/ dug lnga las mi bral ba'i phyir ro// de ltar bsgoms pas thig le rgyas te 'chor 'chor 'dra na/ bzlog pa dang dgram pa ni/ zhal las shes par bya'o// de ltar rtsa rlung thig le la gnad du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ skad gcig la sangs rgya/ grub thob dang*/ 'ja' tshon dang ring bsrel 'ong ba'i rgyu dang*/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul rig pa dang*// yi dam lha zhal mthong thos 'gyur// bde chen sems las skyes pa yis// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis kyang*// bsrung zhing byin gyis rlob par 'gyur// nad med tshe ring longs spyod che// 'khor 'das ma lus dbang du byed// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel go ba dang*// rin chen rdzas sogs 'byung bar 'gyur// rtags bcu yon tan brgyad sogs dang*// sangs rgyas yon tan 'di las 'byung*// rus pa'i rgyan drug 'ong ba yang*// 'di yi gnad du shes par bya// de ltar phan yon 'phel ba'i rgyu dang*/ mi nyams par bsrung ba'i dam tshig gsum rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o// de yang chos 'di la tshogs dang gtor ma gal che ste/ rtsa'i de nyid 'di yin zhes pa dang*/

rlung gi de nyid 'di yin zhes pa dang*/ byang sems kyi de nyid 'di yin zhes pa dang*/ bde chen gyi de nyid 'di yin zhes pa la mkha' 'gro ma'i bka' rgya yod pas/ gzhan la bstan na mkha' 'gro mas snying khrag 'thung bar 'gyur ro// gsang bar bya'o// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba dang*/ 'di las byung ba'i bsod nams tshogs rnams des// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// de yis 'gro rnams bde chen myur thob shog /seṅge sgra sgrags de nyid bzhi pa zhes bya ba/ rdzogs s+ho// bka' rgya rim pa gsum yod do// sa ma ya tha// 824) ༄// 'jig rten mgon po'i zab chos rnal 'byor bzhi ldan// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ bla ma rtogs pa dang ldan pa byang chub kyi sems rnam gnyis 'dres pa gcig btsal/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bya zhing*/ mos pa dang gus pa rgyun mi chad par bya/ dbang po rab kyi rten gyi gang zag gis mos gus tsam las rang gi don grub nas 'ong*/ dbang po 'bring gi rten gyi gang zag gis/ maṇḍal dang yi ge brgya pa'i bsnyen pa zla ba phyed tsam yan chad bya ste/ sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma/ skyugs pa dang*/ 'khru ba dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa dang*/ lus las khrag mang po 'byung ba dang*/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi khar phyin pa dang*/ rang gi steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba dang*/ nam mkha' la skas btsugs nas 'gro ba la sogs du ma 'byung*/ de'i dus su zhi gnas kyi nyams zhag gsum tsam gyi bar du btsal/ de nas bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes zhag gsum gyi bar du bskyed du gzhug de'i rjes la lhan cig skyes sbyor ram/ phyag rgya chen po btab pas cig car ba'i rten gyi gang zag gis sgom med du 'gro ba yang yod/ thod rgal ba'i rten gyi gang zag gis rang gi sems rtogs nas der rang gi sems chos skur yang go// res nyams med pa tsug 'gro ba yang 'ong*/

'di'i rtogs pa bsha' ma bar dor 'char gsung*/ rim gyis pa la dang po rtse gcig de nas spros bral/ de nas ro gcig de nas bsgom med skye ste/ rtse gcig la yang nyams bzang ngan gsum du 'ong ste/ btab pa tsam gyis gsal yer gyis 'ong la/ gsal ba de yang res bzang*/ res ngan na rtse gcig tha ma/ gsal ba rgyun chad med par 'ong na rtse gcig 'bring*/ gsal stong zung du chud nas 'di bas bzang ba bla ma dang gang zag su la yang med de 'ong snyam pa rtse gcig rab bo// spyir rtse gcig gi dus su shes pa brlan dang bral ba'i dus su nga la sgom med pa yin snyam pa yang yong*/ nyams mthug pa'i dus su 'di bas bzang ba logs na med snyam pa'ang 'ong*/ rtse gcig rab la yang cig car ba dang*/ thod rgal ba dang*/ rim gyis pa dang gsum/ cig car du skye na gsal stong gi nyams la 'phel 'grib med pa 'ong*/ thod rgal du skye na mtho dman shin tu che/ rim gyis pa sgom yun ring zhing bla ma la mos gus che na myur du cig car bar 'gyur ba la tshegs med do// spyir rim gyis dang thod brgal gnyis ka yang nyams ma rdzogs pa dang nyams mi brtan pa yin pas bla ma la mos gus bsha' ma zhig skyes na cig car bar 'gro ba la tshegs med/ mos gus la mtho dman du yod na nyams mtho dman du yong*/ rtse gcig las bogs ma thon na bogs 'don par bya ste/ zhen pa gsum btang ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la dus gsum gyi bla ma rnams gsal te/ rang gi lus dngos su ci nas btang ste nang gtor bya'o// longs spyod dngos su gtang ba ni/ dge 'dun la tshogs bsags/ dkon mchog la mchod/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor ma mang du bcol lo// ting nge 'dzin la zhen pa btang ba ni nyams bzang ba la dga' ba yang mi bya/ ngan pa la mi dga' ba spang zhing rtog pa mi bsgug gsol ba mang du btab cing zab pa'i tshigs bcad dang*/ kho rang gi nyams bstun pas/ ci zhig ltar la spros bral gyi rtogs pa skye/

spros bral la yang rab 'bring gsum du skye ste/ rab ni dmyal bar 'gro rgyu med sangs rgyas la 'thob rgyu yang med/ chos sku dngos 'di yin snyam zhing*/ dbang med du bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes tha ma la 'ong*/ chos kyi don dang gdams ngag gis kyang nga'i sgom 'di la ma slob snyam pa 'ong*/ 'jig rten gyi chos la blo shin tu ldog tha na rang gi gdams ngag la yang zhen pa chung*/ gdams ngag thams cad kyang rtsa ba bla ma la mos gus bsgom pa kha yar gyis chog ang snyam pa'o// gnyid kyi dus su yang rang gi sems rtogs pa de shar nas 'ong*/ spros bral 'bring po skyes tsam na dmyal bar 'gro rgyu med/ sangs rgyas la 'thob rgyu med snyam pa yang res yong res mi yong ngo*// sems skye ba med pa rtag tu shes shing bsgom/ 'di kha yar gyi chog snyam pa cung med/ nyams la mtho dman dum re 'ong*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skabs su 'ong*/ phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad kyis bla ma dang grogs la the tshom za ba'ang 'ong*/ res nyams ngan pa'i dus su sgom rang la'ang the tshom za la 'di chos ji ltar yin na snyam pa'ang 'ong*/ de'i dus su bla ma dam pa gcig dang ma bral bar byas shing rang gis rtogs pa la bogs 'don dgos te/ sdug bsngal can la snying rje shin tu skyes/ chos zab zab nyan/ blta ba gleng slong bya/ bla ma la yang mos gus bcos ma tshun chod kyis bskyed/ maṇḍal bya zhing gsol ba rgyun tu btab pas spros bral chen po mthar thug tu 'gyur/ bla ma'i kho bos sems kyi chod che bas des na 'di dkar po chig thub yin/ mthun pa'i chos 'di nyid yin/ 'di las bzang ba'i chos gzhan med/ spang bya spang rgyu med/ gnyen po sgom rgyu med/ rnal 'byor pa lus rgya yin/ des rgya gnyis dang sbyar zhing kho la brtan pas nges shes cher 'gro'o// dbang po 'bring yin pas phyi rol gyi bdud 'jug dogs yod de/

nga rang la 'don 'dis chog pa yin snyam pa dang*/ bla ma yang mi dgos snyam nas mos gus logs pas rgyu 'bras la yang mi 'dzem/ snying rje dang dad pa yang je chung la 'gro nas nag po kha 'byams du 'gro ba'i dogs kyang yod/ de ltar song na rtogs pa la bogs mi thon/ bsgyur ba yang mang*/ rang re yang nyes pa la 'jug bdud kyi lcags kyus zin dogs yod pas bla ma dam pa'i ngag sman bzhin du bkur ro// spros bral tha ma ni sems rang ngo shes tsam rtog pa ma grub par shes/ myong ba nang du ma grub par mi shes/ rang gi sems la bag tsam 'thob kyang*/ chos zab pa dang rgya che ba bltas kyang mi go// rang gi sems ngo shes kyang sgom mthar thug tu mi shes/ byis pa chung ngus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang 'dra/ 'di'i dus su bla ma dang bral ba'i thabs med/ bogs 'don par byed pa ni zhen pa rnams gsum btang*/ rang gi lus longs spyod gnyen 'dun gsum la ltos pa med par bya/ bla ma dam pa dang gdams ngag rin po che dang rang gi rtog pa gsum la yang dang yang du nges shes khyad par can bskyed/ smra bcad 'am dben par bsdad/ gsol ba drag tu btab de ltar byas nas skad cig gis bog thon no// spros bral rang la yang cig car dang thod rgal dang rim gyis dang gsum du gnas te/ cig car ni dang po rang nas spros bral mthar thug pa 'char/ thod rgal ni res mtho res dma'/ rim gyis pa ni rim pas 'char ro// du ma ro gcig rab kyi dus su 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs/ snang ba dang sems gcig tu nges don dam pa'i bden par go// mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'ang 'ong*/ rang gi yi dam gyi dngos sam/ smin lam du lung ston pa'ang 'ong*/ phrag dog rtsa ba nas zhi/ ro gcig 'bring gi dus su snang ba dang sems gcig tu nges/ lus dang sems dang snang ba gsum gcig tu 'dres pa'i nyams kyang skye/

snang ba nyid kyang 'di na rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad snang kyang tshur ro gcig go// de bzhin du rgya mtsho chen po ro gcig pa bzhin du sems nyid kyi ngang 'ba' zhig tu thim/ phyi rol gyi gdul bya rnams la mos gus can phan pa dang gnod pa mi mthun par bltas na yang 'byung*/ sgom 'di bas lhag pa med snyam pa yang 'byung*/ de'i dus su sems can yang rang*/ bla ma yang rang snying rje bya ba med mnyam pa'i bdud 'ong dogs yod/ bla ma la mos gus bya ba logs na med rang gi sems su 'dug snyam pa'ang 'ong*/ de la dgongs nas bla ma rin po ches kyang*/ gzhan phan gyi snying rje zhen med 'di// thabs kyis mchog tu tsir gyis bzung*// ces pa dang*/ rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang rdo rje slob dpon mi spang*/ zhes pa'o// 'di 'ang bla ma la mos gus byas/ sems can la snying rje bskyed/ dben par bsdad/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi don dran pa spang*/ snang ba la thugs phrad tsam bya/ res tshogs su bsdad/ res dben par bsdad/ phyir la ri'am sa bstod dmigs pa la drag tu yang res bsdad/ nang du sems la yang blta/ blta mkhan rang la yang blta/ de ltar byas na mtsho la kha ba babs pa'am/ nags mthug po la me shor ba'am/ dug lnga sman du bsgyur ba'am/ rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs zhi ba bzhin du rab tu 'gro ba la tshegs med/ ro gcig tha ma ni rang gi lus sems snang ba gsum dbyer mi phyed/ res sems su 'dug pa tsug 'ong*/ res dbyer med byed pa la nges med/ sa la sogs pa sra 'thas can du yang snang*/ phrag dog spong mi nus/ las rgyu 'bras la mi 'dzem/ sngon gyi shes pa dang rang gi shes pa gnyis la khyad med snyam pa yang res 'ong*/ chos byed pa la lkog mi thub/ res mkha' lta tsa na mthar thug 'di rang yin snyam pa'i nyams skye/ bogs 'don par byed pa ni khyad par du yang snang ba la phyir ri la sogs pa la gtad cing lan re bsgom/ spyir nam mkha' gsum 'dres pa

steng 'ong bar gsum la yang bsgom/ theg chen rnal 'byor bsgom/ bla ma la mos gus khyad par du bcas/ tshogs bsogs pa'i rigs thams cad bya/ da lta'i dran pas dran pa rang la ce re gzung*/ mchog tu 'gro ba la tshegs med do// bsgom du med pa la bzhi ste/ rab ni mnyam rjes med pa 'ong ste/ bsgom mi dgos pa'i sgom med do// bsgom pas shes pa rang rtsa ba nas chod pa'i dus su/ sgom khan rang yang ma grub/ sgom yang ma grub pas/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bar go bas yang med do// sgom pa'i 'od gsal dang shi ba'i 'od gsal gnyis gcig tu gyur te/ nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa'i chu bo'i rlabs zhi ba bzhin du 'od gsal gnyis gcig tu gyur cing*/ chos sku 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ba ni mthar thug pa'i sgom med do// spros bral skyes pa yan chad la/ mtshams med pa'i las dang rtsa ltung ma byung na de nyid du sangs rgyas nas bar do'i snang ba'i dod la gzugs sku gnyis kyi snang ba shar nas sems can gyi don byed pa'o// tshe 'dir 'char ba'i sgom med mthar thug ni/ rang sems sangs rgyas su lhan gyis go nas spang bya spang rgyu med/ gnyen po bsten pa bya rgyu dang bral/ bya sems dang bral/ shi ma shi med snyam pa'i nges shes bting nas go ste mnyam rjes med par nges shes lhangs kyis skyes nas gzhan snang mkha' 'gros bskor ba'am/ lus du mar mthong ba'am/ mos gus can gyis rten gyi gang zag la sangs rgyas rang gi snang ba shar nas kyang 'ong*/ ngag ci smras kyang chos su 'gro/ lus spyod pa ci byas pas kyang sems can dad nus/ gnas gar bsdad kyang byin rlabs skye/ grogs med par gcig pur bsdad kyang lung pa thams cad du gar phyin pa thams cad kyang 'jigs pa med/ res byis pa'i spyod pa byed/ res 'jig rten 'di la dga' snyam pa'i bsam pa yang gzhan la 'ong*/ don mdor bsdu na bya sems dang bral ba'o// spyir sgom med mthar phyin pa la/

sems can la snying rje rang shugs kyis skye/ las rgyu 'bras mngon sum du 'gyur/ tshig thams cad skye med kyi don du mthong*/ gang la yang zhen pa med/ gtsang btsog gi rnam par rtog pa chung*/ gsang ba'i gnas bstan kyang ngo tsha rgyu med snyam pa'i sems skye/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis mchod pa 'bul zhing*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs byed/ bdag skye ba gcig gis thogs pa yin ang snyam pa'i nges shes khyad par can skye/ sems can thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher 'gyur ro// bla ma rje btsun thugs rje dang rtogs pa mnyam du 'dres pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nas yongs ba'i nyams kyi gdams ngag bla ma gong ma rnams kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa dang*/ nyid kyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i nyams myong rnams chu snod gcig nas gcig tu byo ba bzhin du rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi rnal 'byor pa thugs kyi rdo rje la snang ba'o// / dge'o/// / 825) ༄// thabs lam gsal ba'i sgron me// na mo ratna gu ru/ chos sku bde chen ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// mos pa'i snang ngor gzugs sku kun la gsal// gang 'dod yid bzhin de don rdzogs par mdzad// bla ma chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo// mdo brgyud kun gyi snying po bsdus pa'i don// bla ma rin chen thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud// zhal nas legs gsungs chos drug gdams pa 'di// dran pa gso phyir cung zad yi ger bkod// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos drug rnying ma legs par tshar nas sdod/ chos drug gsar ma 'di mdzad/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ chos drug rnying ma bka'i khrid 'di phyi lus lta bu ma 'di khong pa'i snying lta bu yin gsung*/ de yang snying ma la chos rje sku tshe'i stod la rgyas par gsung ba gcig dang*/ sku tshe'i smad la sku nas su byon pa dang tshogs pa che ba'i stobs kyis dmigs pa dang tshar chos sogs pa thams cad bsdus nas gsungs pas gcig dang gnyis dang po las/

de gnyis gang tshar kyang gsar ma'i khrid bya ru btub gsungs/ de yang dus kyi mi dran dgu dran 'dis 'khor bar byed pa'i sa bon rgyun yin pas na mi dge ba'o// de ltar yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'du byed yin// gsung ngo*// 'o na lung ma bstan de gang yin snyam na/ de res lcags srang stong po de la rkyen gser srang gang gis bsgyur na 'gyur la/ ma bsgyur na ni kun gzhi lung ma bstan bya bar gsungs so// de la yid kyi las ni lung ma bstan ces so// lar lung ma bstan bya ba 'gur tung gcig la byed pa yin/ de la kun gzhi dang*/ khams gnyis don gcig pas na/ bde gshegs snying po khams dge ba// snying po de la kun gzhi sgras// de bzhin gshegs pas bstan par mdzad// ces so// lar 'di mi la ma 'dri rang gis nyams su long gsungs/ phyi ni gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti ser gsungs pa de mngon du gyur gsung*/ mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyis// thugs kyi snying po gyur pa kun gzhi tshogs 'khor bka' rgya ma'i ngo sprod/ bka' rgya gsum rim mo/ lho brag khar chu pa le'u phyug tu'o// / 826) ༄// dpal ye shes mgon po'i bstod pa/ hūm̐ gang gi bde gshegs spyan sngar zhal gyis bzhes// 'jig rten las 'das 'jigs byed chen po'i tshul// bya rog ming can bdud 'dul bstan pa srung*// dam can dge 'dun skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan nā lend+ra yi gnas dang sde// stong nyid sgom dang bde mchog rnal 'byor pa// nye bar srung mdzad mgon po bya rog gdong*// bsil ba tshal bzhugs mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// slob dpon smod cing sangs rgyas bstan la sdang*// rdo rje spun khro sems can yongs la 'tshe// ma nyes log lta gang du 'grogs pa rnams// gtum po khyod kyis tshar chod brlag par mdzod// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di 'jig rten mgon pos mdzad pa'o//

827) ga sha dril bu'i ri gnas bshad ri pa rnams la lung bstan gnang ba// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pas// ri pa snga phyi rnams la 'di skad gsungs// 'di nas nyi ma nub kyi phyogs rol na// spyi gtsug dzaland+ra yi byang ngos su// gar zha mkha' 'gro'i gnas zhes bya ba yod// khyad du 'phags pa gnas mchog 'gran zla bral// lung pa'i phu ni shar du bstan pa yod// mdo ni nub tu bstan zhing lung pa'i dbyibs// phu ral gnyis bcas mdo dang gsum du yod// dbus su zung 'jug dbu ma chen po'i ri// de la gnyis su med pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs// de rgyab chos skyong srung ma'i lha tshogs bzhugs// de rgyab mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i skor lam yod// skor lam de nas rim bzhin phyin pa na// lha dang lha mo'i sku dang phyag mtshan yod// thabs shes chu dang dngos grub chu mig yod// 'chi med chu dang yan lag brgyad ldan yod// a li ka li la sogs yig 'bru'i rigs// rang byon lhun grub tshul du bzhugs nas yod// skal ldan bu rnams gnas mchog de ru byon// 1$0000360༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi kha skong bzhugs so// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi'i dpung pa le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa// 820) bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ tshe gcig lus gcig la bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar byed pa rgyu mtshan nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis su gsungs pa las rgyu mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa gong du shes par bya'o// 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la gsum ste/ dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/ lam gyi sgom tshul dang*/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// dang po dngos po'i gnas lugs la gsum ste/ chos sku dang*/ yon tan dang*/ 'phrin las gsum lhun grub tu tshang ba'o// de la lus dang*/
