ro gcig dus su mtshan nyid gnyis su med par rtogs pa yin/ rnal 'byor bzhi tshigs bcad ma nas/ rtse gcig dus su/ 'di rnams lugs gcig yin/ dang po rtogs/ rang bzhin gsal bar rtogs pa yin/ spros bral dus su ngo bo skye 'gag spros pa thams cad dang bral bar rtogs/ gnyis pa rtogs/ ro gcig dus su gsum pa shes gsung ngo*// de la spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig zhag bdun du mnyam par bzhag go// de la nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pas bar ma bcad na nges par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya gsung*/ sangs ma rgyas pa de gang gis lan snyam na/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pas bar du bcad pas lan pa yin/ de la 'brug pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig spros bral rtogs na rtog pa mi skye bar 'dod lo// chos rje yab sras kyi bzhed pa sgom med rtogs kyang rtog pa skye gsung*/ de la bcu chos 'di ston pa'i dus nam yin snyam na/ bcu chos ro gcig rtogs pa'i lag cha yin gsung bas/ ro gcig rtogs pa nyung du 'gro/ ro gcig rtogs nas de bas kyang nyung du 'gro/ sgom med rtogs nas rtogs pa rnams la ran pa yin gsung*/ rtse gcig dang spros bral gyi dus su ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur/ ro gcig gi dus su nye bar bsgrub bar du 'gyur/ sgom med kyi dus su yon tan du 'gyur/ de ltar yang dang po ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur/ gnyis pa lam du yon tan 'byung*/ gsum gsung kyang rtogs pa rab 'bring gsum kar skye ba'i dus su dgos gsung*/ na gong nas gong du na 'phar ba yin gsung pa mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung*/ ces gsungs so// spros bral gyi dus su tshogs pa skyong ba la mi dbang*/ de cis te zhe na mnyam rjes yod pa'o// mnyam bzhag la spros bral yin yang*/ rjes rnam par rtog pa langs pas/ des gzhan gyi skyon spong ba dang*/ yon tan bsgrub par mi nus pa yin/

rang nyid la rjes shes yod pa'i gnad ka yin/ spros bral gyi rtogs pa yod pa'i rnal 'byor pa des bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ lus longs spyod la sogs pas mchod/ gnas dben pa ri'am/ gangs sam/ nags khrod du bsgoms pas ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'char te/ dkar dmar rnam pa sna tshogs rnams// rang gi sems su lhan cig go// gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba sbad kyi chod// gnyis snang gi 'khrul pa ngang gis zhi// ces pa/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa skyes nas rnam rtog skye'am mi skye gleng slong byung bas/ skye'am mi skye na so so skye bo dang khyad par med par skye gsung*/ rjes la khyad par yod dam med na yod/ so so skye bo'i rtog pa rang rgyud pa yin/ rtogs ldan gyi rtogs pa skyes pa skye med bya ba yin gsung*/ rtog pa rang rgyud pa min gsung*/ de ltar yang*/ gzung 'dzin bag chags sna tshogs rnams/ sgom ro gcig gi dus su lhongs pa yin// lhongs rgyu gong du song ba yin// nyon mongs la gab sa med pa yin// rig pa spyang por 'gyur ba yin// ces gsungs so// da lta rtogs ldan la nyon mongs pa de mi yong du sha ba la zer te/ de ma yin/ rtogs ldan la yang nyon mongs pa rnam rtog skye/ skyes pa de chos nyid phyag rgya chen por ma song bas de lta bu yin/ cig gis chos rje la/ bla ma ldum lta bu la jo mo yod lo byas pas/ jo mo yod kyang chos sku yin gsung lo// rje sgam po pa'i slob ma rnal 'byor chos g.yung gis chags pa spyad zer ba rje sgam po pas gsan pas/ chos g.yung khyod kyis bud med la spyad dam byas pas spyad/ phyag rgya chen po las ma 'das par 'dug zer lo// de min na dpal phag mo gru pa tsam cig yin lo// la stod dmar po la 'dod chags chos skur rtogs pa'i sgom yod lo// bla ma lha bas gtsang nas mar byon pas/ la stod dmar po'i dgon pa gzigs su byon pas/

bcu chos kyi gnad 'di yod na grub thob yongs su phebs pa chos rje rin po che lta bu skyon med yon tan rdzogs pa 'byung ba yin gsung*/ khong cig po la gnad 'di med pas grub thob skyon can du gyur pa yin gsung*/ de la bcu chos 'di ya gi sangs rgyas man chod nas/ rtse gcig yan chad la dgos gsung*/ tha na bzo byed pa yan chad la dgos te/ dpal gyi bsam yas brtsigs rtsa na rgyal pos tho rangs skad rings btang nas/ thams cad kyis bzo bka' rgya can sgoms shig bya ba'i skad gtong lo// de yang bcu chos kyi gnad yin gsung*/ sku 'bag gcig 'dug pa la chu rten chen po gcig la phyag gnyis kas 'chang pa cig 'dug lo/ bla ma zhang tshal pa la zhe sdang chos skur rtogs pa'i sgom yod lo// lo ras chung pa la gti mug chos kyi skur rtogs pa'i sgom yod lo// ro gcig rtogs pa'i dus su bag chags la gnas sa med pas rgyu 'bras myur ba yin/ bla ma gtum skom grir grongs/ bla ma ltum 'dod chags kyis khyim btsun du gyur/ rje rin po che la rmu gab byung ba yin gsung*/ phyag rgya chen po mi rtogs pa yin kyang*/ da res 'di nas rtogs mi rtogs gcig ston gsung*/ rtogs pa la rab 'bring tha ma gsum/ tha ma la 'dod chags kyi rtog pa gcig skye ba de la gnad kyis ma zin na longs spyod chags can gcig gi dbang du phar 'chor/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa skyes nas de la gnad kyis ma zin na/ longs spyod dgra la phar 'chor/ gti mug la gnyis/ rgod pa rnam pa sna tshogs su 'phro ba dang*/ bying ba gti mug gi gnyid gnyis la gnad du ma song na longs spyod sa bdag la 'chor/ de bzhin du nga rgyal dang phrag dog la sogs pa thams cad des 'dre'o// rtogs pa rab la pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshad med pa bzhi/ thos bsam sgom gsum/ byams pa/ snying rje/ byang chub sems/ bla ma'i mos gus yod na phar 'gro/ 'bring po la zhing*/

khang pa/ mkhar/ nyi ma zla ba/ la che btsan dregs pa'i dbang du/ sprin pa la sogs pa'o// sngon la phar 'gro la rgyas par bshad/ de nas tshur 'du rgyas par bshad/ de nas mgo gnyan 'dzin pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ 'dod chags la sogs pa rnams la gnad du ma song na 'khor du 'dod chags spong mi nus pa chags pa spyod pa 'byung*/ zhe sdang la zhe sdang spong mi nus par 'khor du 'thab mo mod pa 'byung*/ gti mug gis mdze pa'am/ 'dre gnod can 'byung*/ nga rgyal can/ skye sa nga bzang*/ yon tan nga che/ shes rab nga che/ sgom sran nga che snyam pa'i nga rgyal spong mi nus pa chags/ phrag dog can phrag dog spong mi nus pa 'byung ngo*// rab mos gus can rang la zhu/ mos gus gzhan la byed pa 'byung*/ yang na mos gus gcig po chog zer ba'i rigs 'byung*/ byams pa la sems can la byams pa chen po'i rigs 'byung*/ snying rje la sems can la snying rje ba de'i kha 'dzin pa 'byung*/ byang chub kyi sems des 'gre'o// gnad du song ma song*/ thos pa la thos pa'i kha zin pas sangs rgyas byang chub thob 'dod na/ thos pa mang po'i mi phyir 'brongs/ bya ba yin zer nas kha 'dzin/ slob dpon pa dang thos pa ye chung yin zer ba byung*/ bsam pa la 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa ma bsams na mi phan zer ba byung*/ sgom pa des 'dre/ tshul khrims la/ tshul khrims dgos pa yin/ tshul khrims med na rtogs pa mtho yang mi phan zer ba 'byung*/ sbyin pa la/ sbyin pa dgos pa yin/ slob dpon pa yang phyag dam zer ba 'byung*/ 'bring po la/ zhing khang 'dra ba la sogs bya mi dgos par nas 'bul ba yong ba la/ de yang drin dran pa/ slob dpon pa yang ngas bskyangs pa las byung ba yin zer ba'am/ de'i rigs 'byung ngo*// da gsum pa skyon med pa yon tan rdzogs pa mgo snyam mi 'dzin par byed pa la lnga ldan sgom par byed pa'i lag rjes bstan pa ston/ 'dod chags la rigs bzhi/ rigs 'dra'i bde ba mo la sgyur ba ni sla'o// gyi na'i bde ba gnas sbyong gcad/

'dod chags kyi rtogs pa gyan gyun tsam pa des yi dwags kyi lus chu sngan ma len pa yin/ de gcod pa la phyag rgya chen po sgom/ yang na sems skyed lus yi dam gyi lhar sgom/ lte bar bla ma dam pa sgom/ rigs 'dra dang*/ gyen dang yul med dang yul can no// de la dang po/ bla ma dam pa'i sku las yas kyi me 'bar bas/ khong ba'i nang gi rnam par rtog pa thams cad tshig par bsam/ yul med kyi bde ba mkha' 'gro ma ces pa/ nam tho rangs khar yul yid la med pa'i bde ba de mkha' 'gro ma yin pas lam du btang mi dgos/ phyag rgya chen po sgom/ bla ma zhang tshal bas spos kha ba chos zhur phyin pas sku 'tshams bcad nas/ sa bdag dang bag chags ngan pa/ ma mjal bas zhu phyin bskur bas/ rnal 'byor ma'i brgyad cha la thabs shugs gnas skam po langs nas/ skabs skabs su ri bong can thur la rgyug de la thabs ji ltar bya ba zhus pas/ thabs shugs gnas skam po langs pas mi lto/ ri bong can thur la rgyug pa la thun gzhug la rlung sems gnyis yin/ yi ge haṃ la lhan lhan pa gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bsgoms gsung lo// yul can gyi bde ba nyams su blang zhes pa/ yul mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la nyon mongs pa skye ba'o// skye ba de la dam pa rgya gar gyi bzhed pas/ rtog pa skyes ma thag tu gnad du ma gtang na rtog pa rags par song nas mgo mi non gsung nas skyes ma thog sgom lo// dam pa rgya gar 'bur 'joms byed/ de yang zab pa yin te/ a ma'i bu chung bskyangs pa dka'/ zhes pa ni/ rtog pa 'bur byung ba dang nyams su blangs pas/ yang 'bras bu'i dus su 'khor btsun chung chung ngun ma dang*/ longs spyod yin/ rta rte'u dang*/ snam bu tshang du ma longs pa dang*/ des 'gre'o// dga' zhing dgra byung ram zla phyi la rgyug bde chen ye shes dus gnad 'chugs/ rgad po'i zhabs tog sgyid pa skyur/ zhes pa ni rnam rtog spyad pa'am yal nas nyams su len pa rnam sang gnangs 'bras bu'i dus su/

'khor du rgad po bu phogs bu mo rdzangs nas rgas kha 'dir slob dpon ba can du ma ṇi 'dren gyin sdod pa yin zer ba'i rgad po/ dug po bying rmed chad pa bzhin du gnya' khung du spung nge ba 'ong*/ phyag rten la rta rgan nam/ glang rgan nam/ gos yin na rnying pa zad pa yong gsungs/ 'ga' zhig sbyor bas nyams su len ston pa'i bstan pa bag tsam gnod/ ces pa/ slob dpon padma dang*/ rgyal po chags spyod cing lam du gtong*/ slob dpon padma ling ga phur bas 'tshog cing*/ bdag gi zhe sdang 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dag par gyur cig zer zhing lam du btong lo// de gnyis shes par ni bya/ nyams len ni mi bya gsung*/ 'o na ji tsam na nyams len bya snyam na/ rtog pa gang yin yang sbal rgyas pa la nyams blang gsung*/ bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ then then pa gcig rgyab pa la btab/ nang du nyon mongs rtsal rdzogs pas/ phyi ru longs spyod mdangs dang ldan/ lang 'tshos brgyan pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ ces pa ni/ 'khor du na so dar la bab pa/ lang 'tsho dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'byung*/ longs spyod pa rta bzang po'am/ gos snam yin yang legs pa yid du 'ong ba la sogs pa byung*/ de yang rtog pa nyal ba la skyes na mi lang*/ langs pa la skyes na mi nyal/ 'gro 'phro la skyes na mi sdang*/ sdod 'phro la skyes na mi 'gro/ mig phye ba la skyes na mi 'dzum/ rtsums pa la mi 'byed/ sprang po'i gtam rgyud dang*/ dpal chen rdo rje ye shes kyi gtam rgyud gnyis go sla'o// des na rgyu la las su ma song bar/ bar chad bsrung ba nan tan bya/ rags pa byung na gzhi nas skyar/ phra ba byung na thad kar gcod/ ces gsung*/ 'dod chags kyi rtogs pa lam du btang ba ni/ bdag gi 'dod chags kyi rtog pa 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa dag par gyur cig nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag par gyur cig shes bya'i sgrib pa dag skyes pa'i dga' tshor yang mi bya/

yid mug kyang mi sgom/ yan par yang mi gtang*/ bdag tu yang mi bzung gsung*/ par gyur cig byur dang*/ gyod dang*/ lto 'gong dang*/ phung 'dre dang*/ nyes pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dag par gyur cig byas la lam du btang*/ thun tshod nyams su myong bas bzung*/ gsung*/ de nas sems bskyed de/ yang 'og ma rgyas shos zab gsung ngo*// de nas lha sgom pa la rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa dang gsum mo// bying nas gnyid du 'gro na mas yar gsal gdab/ rgod nas rtog pa 'phro na yas mar gsal gdab/ bying rgod gnyis med khams bzang ngan thad kar dus gcig la bkra lam sgom gsung*/ gzhan yang ma gsal na spyan dbus ma gsal gdab/ de nas bla ma sgom pa ni gdan khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa sgom/ de nas bsngo ba bya ba ni/ nyal yod na langs nas bsdad/ rkang pa dkyil krung bya/ lag pa thal mo sbyar/ ngag tu gsung snyan po'i sgo nas bya gsung*/ de 'dod chags la gnad du gtong ba'i thabs so// zhe sdang la gnad du btang du btub pa dang mi btub gnyis/ mi btub pa ni/ rang gi dpe rtan pha dang ma/ bzhi sde bla ma'i sku 'khor la/ zhe sdang bskyed par mi bya'o// skyes na spongs sems gnad kyi bzung*/ de rang nyams len yin/ des na yar bzang rtog gi gseb tu rtog /dug rta sman gyis byas pa'i dpe gsung*/ de ya gir bshad/ de nas dgra la skye ba'i zhe sdang la sgom pa ni gong mas 'dre/ lar zhe sdang la gnad du gtong ba bcu chos/ 'dod chags la gsum chos/ gti mug la kun tu gros na 'chi ba dang 'od gsal gnyis so// da rtog pa bzang rtog la gnad du gtong ba ni/ mos gus la mtshon na/ bla ma la mos gus dung pa skyes ma thog kyang ma yin/ skyes ma thog nas mig nas mchi ma 'don pa dang ngag tu thon nas kyang ma yin/ nas bsgrub phyogs nyams su blang gsung*/ mos gus gdung gdung ba'i dus su mal du gtang*/ dgag phyogs lam du btang ba dang bsgrub phyogs lam du btang ba'o// 'bri gung dbon rin po che'i zhal nas/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa 'ga' zhig bzang rtog lam du gtong zer te/ bzang rtog lam du gtong gtong na/ ngan rtog lam du gtong bzhin du/ bdag gi mos gus 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mos gus kyis gtso byas pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa dag par gyur cig zer ram ste de ni mi 'ong lags gsung lo/ rin po che sogs pa'i zhal nas/ lan cig spyan sngar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig gnyis dang nye gnas pa yang gcig gnyis yod dam tsa na/ gcig gis chos cig dris dang gsung bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig gi zhal nas/ sangs rgya kyi sa na sems yod dam med dris pas/ gcig gi zhal nas sems yod/ yod lugs da lta'i 'di ka bzhin du yod byas pas/ sangs rgyas rtog pa dang bcas par thal byas bas/ rtog pa yod na ci to ste/ khyab pa ma grub byas pas/ khyab pa grub ste byams pa'i zhal nas/ sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa/ sgra rtog rnam pa can rtog yin// byas pas/ byams pa'i kha la gtad pa med zer lo// chos rje zhal nag rog song nas/ an tsam cig na/ sgom rin slob dpon la chos cig dris dang gsung lo// zhe sdang la zhe sdang 'dag pa'i mthu bdog gam mi bdog byas pas/ med gsung lo// 'o na bdag gi zhe sdang 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dag par gyur cig byas pa'i mi 'dag gam byas pas/ 'o 'du ta/ 'o 'du ta/ bdag gi zhe sdang 'dis bdag gi zhe sdang 'dag par gyur cig byas na mi 'dag bdag gi zhe sdang 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dag par gyur cig byas na 'dag de bsam pa rgya chen po des 'dag pa yin gsung*/ 'o na bzang rtog lam du gtong ba yod dam med byas pas/ yod gsung ngo*// 'o na ji ltar gtong zhus pas/ dgag phyogs lam du gtong ba dang*/ bsgrub phyogs lam du btong ba gnyis yin gsung*/ dgag phyogs la bdag gi mos gus 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa dag par gyur cig

nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag par gyur cig de dag shes bya'i sgrib pa dag par gyur cig bya/ de dgag phyogs lam du btang ba'o// bsgrub phyogs lam du btang ba ni/ bdag gi mos gus 'dis bla ma rin po che'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan par dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig ma mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig bya/ de bsgrub phyogs lam du btang ba'o// de rnams gsungs pa dang chos de su la yong ngam snyam pa na su la yang ma byung*/ chos la bdag po dgos pa yin gsung*/ thun tshod nyams su myong bas bzung*// ces pa/ sngar dang mi 'dra gsung*/ lam du btang zhing mos gus kyang bskyed/ de nas sems bskyed/ mos gus kyang bskyed/ lha bsgom mos gus kyang bskyed/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ bsngo ba bya/ rjes la phyag rgya chen po snga ma cag ge'i yun tsam cig bsgom/ bzang rtog thams cad des 'gre'o// rtog pa 'bring po la/ rags pa byung na gzhi nas bskyar ces pa go sla'o// phra ba byung na thad kar bcos/ ces pa/ sa'am rdo'am shing me'am chu'am/ bem bo la zhes de rnams dang mos gus sdeb pa yin gsung*/ sdang skyes pas las mi bsog par 'dod pa yod de/ chos rje'i bzhed pas las bsog par bzhed pa 'dug pas zab gsung*/ de rnams kyis skyon med cing yon tan rdzogs par bya ba dang*/ mgo snyam mi 'dzin par byed pa lags/ lnga ldan sdom pa thal nas/ da de dag gi lag rjes bstan pa ni/ rtog pa rab 'bring*/ tha ma gsum la/ de la 'dod chags lam du btang bas/ nang du rang gi nyon mongs pa 'dag phyi nas 'khor 'dod chags shas chung ba 'byung*/ sems bskyed pas byang chub sems dpa'i rigs 'byung*/ lha sgoms pa la lag rjes bzhi/ rnam pa gsal bas dbang po drug po 'byung*/ nga rgyal brtan pas rigs mi 'dor ba/

dbang skyabs la/ 'dir 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i slob ma dge bshes nyang gol lta bu'o// rnam dag dran pa la gnyis/ kun rdzob lha so so'i rnam par dag pa zhen pa chung*/ don dam de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par dag pas/ phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa 'byung*/ bla ma bsgoms pas rang la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i byin rlabs 'byung*/ phyi rol nas slob ma mos gus can 'byung*/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pas mnyam du sangs rgya gsung*/ da bsngo ba byed pa'i dus su nyal na yar langs/ 'gro 'phro yin na bsdad/ rkang pa dkyil krung bya/ lag pa thal mo sbyar/ ngag snyan pa'i gsung dang bcas pas bsngo ba bya/ lus 'khrul 'khor legs par sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'grub/ gsung snyan pa'i mdangs dang bcas pas gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'grub/ yid phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pas thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'grub/ des dug gsum 'gre'o// bzang rtogs la rab mos gus lam du btang ba'i lag rjes la/ dgag phyogs lam du btang bas nyon mongs pa dag pa 'byung*/ bsgrub phyogs lam du btang bas mos gus can de bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar byed par 'gyur/ sems bskyed pa/ lha sgom pa/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa/ bsngo ba byed pa dang tsho snga ma dang 'dra'o// rtog pa bzang rtog thams cad des 'gre'o// rtog pa ngan pa dang bzang po gnyis las slob ma grangs 'grub/ 'bring po la yon bdag 'grub gsung*/ 'di'i skabs su rgyu cig ston pa yin/ rtog pa la gang nye ba/ spang dka' ba de la gnad du song na nye gnas 'grub/ de bas sla ba rnams la gra pa 'grub/ rtog pa za zi phra mo rnams la yon bdag 'grub/ rtog pa bzang po dang ngan pa gnyis la gnad du song nas 'bring po la gnad du ma song na/

mi chen po dang*/ 'bring po dbang du 'dus/ mi chung sgog ga na ngan mi mgu ba yin gsung*/ phra mo la gnad du song nas de min gnyis la gnad du ma song na/ mi chung chung mgu yang chen po mi mgu ba yong ba yin gsung ngo*// snang ba sna tshogs la gnad du song na snang ba 'ur langs pa/ pho 'gam/ mo 'dur/ byis pa te te brdung*/ de chu rang 'phrog pa de snang ba thams cad la gnad du song bas yong ba yin gsung*/ des lnga ldan sgom pa dang de'i lag rjes bstan pa'o// gsum pa'o// da de nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu ston/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal mnga' nas/ 'grub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu des/ rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa 'grub/ 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa ru/ sems rnams la sman gyur cig /ces gsungs pas/ chos byas 'bras bu gang yin na/ grags pa dang snyan pa/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti/ 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad chos byas pa'i yon tan yin te 'bras bu men gsung*/ 'bras bu gang yin na/ ma nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'o// 'bras bu chos kyis phan thogs pa'o// chos nyams su len pa la slob ma yongs pas/ de la 'bras bu bzhi 'byung gsung*/ zhe sdang lta bu la dbang gi 'bras bu rang bas lhag pa'i rin po che skyon med yon tan ldan pa 'byung*/ bral 'bras de'i mi mthun bral/ zhes pa rtog pa yod na zhe sdang dang bral ba'o// de yang ngo mtshar can du mchis/ rnam smin zhe sdang skye na yang*/ dbang du mi 'chor nyams su len mkhan de yang ngo mtshar can du mchi/ rgyu mthun rtogs yod na yang*/ zhe sdang mi spong de la spyad/ de lam gyi dus su skyes pa nor/ 'bras bu'i dus su phun tshogs 'khor/ mi spang mnyam pa nyid du rol/ 'og ma gong mar 'pho ba yin/ dus gsum thams cad des 'dre'o// rab mos gus la/ rang bas lhag pa'i rin po che/ sems can don la chags thogs med/

skyon med yon tan ldan pa 'byung*/ bral 'bras/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang 'phrin las la log lta'i blo dang bral ba 'byung*/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu la/ mos gus yang yod/ nyams len yang byed pa 'byung*/ rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu la/ mos gus gcig pos chog zer ba 'byung*/ rtog pa bzang rtog des 'gres so// 'bring po thad ka'i snang ba la/ dbang gi 'bras bu la/ rang bas lhag pa'i rin po che/ skyon med yon tan ldan par 'byung*/ rje btsun gling ras lta bu zhal mthong bas sgom skyes pa 'byung*/ bral 'bras de'i mi mthun bral/ ces pa/ 'jig rten nam snang ba la zhen pa dang bral ba 'byung*/ rnam smin nyon mongs skyes nas/ dbang du mi 'chor nyams len mkhas/ zhes pa/ snang ba zhen pa skyes yang dbang du mi 'chor bar nyams len mkhas pa 'byung*/ rgyu mthun las ngan yod na yang las ngan mi spang de la spyod/ ces pa/ lnga ldan gyi nyams len shes kyang nyams su mi len pa'i/ snang ba la zhen pa che ba/ 'jig rten blos gtong mi nus pa 'ga' zhig 'byung*/ yang lan cig gi dus su/ snang ba thad ka'i nyams len la yon tan la yon bdag 'grub gsung*/ dbang gi 'bras bu la/ yon bdag pa'i gseb nas kyang skyon med la yon tan rdzogs pa 'ga' zhig 'byung gsung*/ bral ba'i 'bras bu la/ yon tan bdag pa yin kyang 'jig rten la zhen pa dang bral ba 'ga' zhig 'byung gsung*/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu la/ bla ma de'i chos nyams len gang yin pa shes pa/ zhen pa'i dbang du mi 'chor ba 'ga' zhig 'byung gsung*/ rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu la/ nga slob dpon tha se mo'i yon bdag yin zer nas/ khe grags rke 'then pa/ zhen pa che ba 'ga' zhig 'byung gsung ngo*// de tsho 'bras bu bzhi la brjed tho tsam yin/ de ltar chos lnga ldan gyi nyams len 'di la/ bka' sde snod gsum tshang*/ rgyud sde bzhi dang*/ bden pa bzhi dang*/ bdag med gnyis dang*/

pha rol tu phyin pa drug lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum/ rgyud dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum/ tshad med pa bzhi/ thabs mkhas pa dang*/ shes rab zab mo gnyis/ rnam par thar pa'i de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos thams cad tshang bar brtsi ba ste/ sgo gsum chos kyi sgo thams cad tshang gsung ngo*/ dge ba 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus rnams// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par shog// // / 1$0000240829) ༄// rje'i tshig gsum gnad kyi gdams pa/1$0000310 lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// spros pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' zhing*// dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku// rin chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// de yi zhal nas legs gsungs pa// bdud rtsi gnad kyi man ngag 'di// gus bsten slob mas skul phyir ni// brtse bas man ngag gsung bzhin bri// bu gcig gus pas tshur nyon dang*// rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa 'di// mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra// de phyir tshe 'di'i 'dun pa spongs// rigs drug 'khor ba'i du khaḥl// me dong lta bur bsams lags na// de las thar byed dam pa'i chos// gnas lugs don la goms par mdzod// 'khor ba'i rgyud las thar lags kyang*// brtse ba'i ma rnams bor lags na// nyan rang dman pa'i byang chub yin// sems gsum 'bral med bsgom zhig gsungs// tshe 'di don chen sgrub lags na// tshad ldan bla ma rin chen gyi// ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub pa yin// dngos grub 'byung gis mos gus gyis// rang gzhan don 'byung rdzogs sangs rgyas// sgrub byed gnad kyi man ngag ni// zung 'jug lam gyi mchog gyur pa// tshig gsum gnad kyi man ngag 'di ltar bya gsung*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzhung lam 'di// tshe 'di'i ltos thag bcad nas kyang*// nyams len 'bral med brtson 'grus kyis// snying la zhog cig skyes bu rnams// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/

'o skol gyi ston pa thub pa chen po mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ sems can gyi nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yin/ chos de rnams nyams su len pa la tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig gsungs na yang mdor bsdus nas/ paṇḍi ta sgro 'dogs phyi nas gcod pa dang*/ ku sā li sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa gnyis yin te/ de yang paṇḍi ta sgro 'dogs phyi nas gcod pa bya ba ste/ bshad pa'i bla ma mang po bsten/ bka' bstan bcos sam mdo sde dang*/ rgyud sde rnams la thos bsam gyis shes bya bskyangs pas nam zhig na/ chos rnams nam mkha' phyis brtas chos su 'gro bar gsungs pa mi 'dug pas/ bsgoms pa med kyang ci zhig ltar la shes pa kha nang du log ste sems lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs nas rtog pa 'char ba yang yod par 'dug gsung*/ gnyis pa ku sā li sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa'i lugs ni/ chos mang po gcig thos bsam ma byas kyang*/ bla ma dam pa gcig dang mjal/ mos gus byas te gsung rdog po gcig tsam la gtsigs su byas nas bsgoms pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs dang rang gi mos gus kyi shugs kyis rang gi sems lhan gcig skyes pa skye 'chi med pa'i don rtogs de/ rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa shar ba'i dus su/ bka' sde snod kyi don ma lus pa khong du chud bcing snang ba dpe char 'char ba yin/ de tsa na paṇḍi ta mang pos mtha' bskor yang*/ chos kyi lan 'debs pa la thogs pa med cing nyam nga med pa 'byung*/ de la sgom 'byung gi shes rab zer ba yin la/ rnal 'byor pa seng ge lta bu bya ba yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ 'o na de lta bu rang e yod dam snyam na yod de slob dpon birwa pa lta bu'am/ tog tse lta bu yin/ bla ma nā ro pas tilli pa mnyes par byas pa la brten nas/ nā ro pa'i thugs la tshig don ma lus pa dus gcig la 'khrungs pa yin gsung*/

de ltar lugs gnyis las 'o skol gyi bka' brgyud rin po che 'di ku sā li sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa'i lugs yin gsung*/ de yang nged ku sā li pa yin zer nas/ gdams chung 'ga' re yi ger bris nas/ de dar gyis dkris/ mchan khung bse dri kha shos gcig tu bcug nas/ 'di na su la yang med pa'i gdams pa yod pa yin zer ba de la ku sā li pa mi zer/ 'o na gang yin na rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos gcig nyams su blangs pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la go rtogs skye ba gcig byung na de ku sā li pa bya ba yin gsung*/ chos gcig nyams su blangs na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go nus pa'i chos de gang yin snyam na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ de tshig nyung la don 'dril ba nyams su blang bde ba/ tshig rdog po gsum las med kyis khyed kyis 'di blo la zung la nyams su longs gsung*/ de gang yin na/ lus 'di tsug sdod la sems 'di tsug zhog dang*/ yon tan 'di 'dra zhig skye yis bya ba gsum po 'di las med pa yin gsung*/ 'di la yang sangs rgyas kyi chos re re lus sems kyi bzhag thabs mi 'dra ba re re/ de rnams la yon tan gyi skye tshul tha dad pa re re ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig gsungs pa yin te/ da res phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan lta bu gcig la mtshon na/ gsum yin te/ dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/ lam nyams su len pa'i thabs dang*/ 'bras bu skye ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dngos po'i gnas lugs ni lus 'di gdod ma nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'am da la'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas gcig yin te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sa chu spyan dang ma mā kī// dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ba// me dang rlung du rab tu grags// rdo rje skye mched nyid dag kyang*// byang chub sems pa'i da la'i mchog /ces gsungs pas shes la/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi sku sangs rgyas yin te/

'da' ka ye shes nas/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// gsungs pa yin/ lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs 'di rtogs na sangs rgyas yin la/ ma rtogs na 'khor ba'i sems can yin te/ dbu ma nas/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// gsungs pas/ gnas lugs des ma phan par de mngon du gyur par byed pa la/ lam thabs nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa gsungs pa yin pas/ lus 'di tsug sdod la/ sems 'di tsug zhog dang*/ zhes pa 'di gsungs pa yin/ 'o na lus ci tsug 'jog pa yin snyam na/ bla mas bstan pa 'di tsug 'jog pa yin/ bla mas bstan pa gang yin na/ bsam gtan gyi 'khrul 'khor gnad brgyad dang ldan par 'jog pa yin te/ rkang pa dkyil krung bca' ba dang*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag bya ba dang*/ sgal tshigs srang ba dang*/ yang mgrin pa dgu bar bya/ mig sna rtser dbab/ lce rkan la sbyar/ dbang po thur du 'chang ba/ dpung pa rgod gshog bzhin yangs par bya ste/ lus gnad brgyad po de las ma g.yos par sdod pa de la lus 'di tsug sdod bya ba zer ba yin gsung*/ sems 'di tsug zhog dang bya ba sems ci tsug 'jog pa yin snyam na/ sems bla mas bstan pa de tsug 'jog pa yin te/ gang yin na phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan du 'jog pa la zer ba yin pas lus de tsug gtad nas/ dang po byams pa dang snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems kyi steng du ma yengs par sing nge 'jog pa yin/ gnyis pa de'i rjes la rang gi lus yi dam gyi lha'i steng du brgyan la sogs pa gsal bar 'jog pa yin/ gsum pa de'i rjes la lus khong stong snying pad ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte ba la rtsa ba'i bla ma gsal bar bsgom/ bzhi pa blo snga phyi'i bar der bla mas bstan pa bzhin du sems de bzhin nyid ma bcos pa'i ngang du 'jog pa yin te/

de ltar bzhag pas sems rnam par mi rtog pa de'i ngang du gnas kyin 'dug na/ de skye ba med pa'i sgo bya ba yin pas/ de la dga' ba mi bya ba bar gnas tshad du bzhag de la mi gnas par rnam rtog sna tshogs su skye na 'gag pa med pa'i sgo bya ba yin pas/ de la mi dga' ba mi bya bar byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yi dam dang bla ma bsgom mo// sems mi rtog pa la mi gnas par rtog pa skye/ rtog pa la yang mi gnas par 'phro na/ gnas pa med pa'i sgo bya ba yin pas/ chags sdang mi bya bar gang byung yon tan du shes par byas la/ sems ma bcos pa la bzhag lnga pa bsngo ba zhe thag pa nas bya/ de sems 'di tsug bya bya ba yin/ de ltar lam lnga ldan nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu'i 'byung tshul ni/ yon tan 'di 'dra gcig skye yis bya ba yin gsung*/ yon tan ci 'dra gcig skye na bla mas bstan pa'i lus sems gnyis kyi dge sbyor skye ba de/ de yang dang po lus de ltar bzhag pas lus kyi yon tan gcig skye/ rkang pa dkyil krung bcas pas zas mi 'ju ba mi 'ong*/ kha smras kyi bar du mi tshugs/ gnad des sa rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ sa rlung dbang du 'du ba'i yon tan 'byung ba dang*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag byas pas/ me rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ me rlung dbang du 'du ba'i yon tan 'byung ba dang*/ gnad des bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'byung ba yin/ tshigs srang pa dang*/ dpung pa yangs par byas pas/ khyab byed kyi rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing dbang du 'dus rlung rang gnas su tshud pas/ rtsa zug rlung zug snying zug yong ba'i skyon mi 'byung ba/ mgrin pa dgu bar byas pas rtse mgo mnan pas/ rlung gi rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ dbang du 'dus pa'i yon tan 'byung*/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o// rlung gi rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ dbang du 'dus pa'i yon tan 'byung*/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o// lce rkan la sbyar ba dang*/

dbang po thur du 'phyang pas/ chu rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing dbang du 'dus pa yin/ kha chu sne chu mi 'byung ngo*// mig sna rtser phab pas nam mkha'i rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ dbang du 'dus pa yin/ des gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o// yang 'khrul 'khor de la gnas pas lus ngag mi dge ba bdun spongs pas/ spong ba bdun gyi tshul khrims 'ong ste/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab par 'ong*/ lus gnad des rtog pa gzhan du ma spangs pas lhag pa sems kyi bslab par 'ong*/ lus sems gnyis stong par shes pa'i lus gnad re la/ yon tan dang skyon skyed par shes pa'i dus su lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong gsung*/ yang 'khrul 'khor la gnad du bsnun pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad du byang chub snying po la byon nas sangs rgyas pa'i 'khrul 'khor nas bzung nas/ tha ma gnyid log pa'i lus gnad kyi bar du lus gnad tha dad pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don 'byung ba ni sprul pa'i sku yin/ lus gnad des lus la thig le gnas pas/ rang bzhin bde ba chen por longs spyod pa'i lhar shar ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don 'byung ba ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin la/ 'khrul 'khor de la gnad du bsnun pas/ sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba chos kyi skur rtogs pa ni/ chos kyi sku'i sangs rgyas yin te/ 'jam dpal nas/ rdo rje dkyil dkrung rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa de lta bu yin gsung*/ de nas sangs rgyas sangs rgyas pa'i dus su yang lus gnad de nyid kyis don grub par mdzad la yin/ de'i dus su phyag g.yas pa nam mkha' la ma slang ste/ sa mnon mdzad nas sangs rgyas pa yin te/ de la dgos pa khyad par can gcig yod par 'dug gsung*/ des mya ngan las pa'i chos thams cad lus gnad du go ba bya ba de lta bu yin la/ yang lus g.yas su yo na zhe sdang skye zhing pho gdon gyis bar du gcod/

g.yon du yo na chags pa skye zhing mo gdon gyis bar du gcod/ rgyab tu dgye na klu btsan gyis bar du gcod/ mdun du dgu na gti mug skye zhing sa bdag gis bar du gcod/ de ltar dug gsum skyed pas lus ngag yid gsum gyis la sogs pas/ rigs drug tu rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi tshul du 'khor bar 'khyams par shes pa ni 'khor ba'i 'dug lugs go ba yin te/ mtshan brjod las/ lus med lus de lus kyi mchog /lus kyi mtha' ni rtogs pa po// zhes gsungs pa yang*/ de lta bu yin gsung*/ des na lus gnad re res 'khor 'das kyi byung tshul tha dad pa bskyed par shes pa'i dus su/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus gnad shes pa bya bar 'ong*/ yang der 'khrul 'khor gyi yon tan thob pas 'khrul 'khor gyi dngos grub bya ba yong ba yin gsungs/ de tsa na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lus gnad kyi 'khor lo gcig pu go bas chos thams cad go ba yin pas chos chung ba min gsung*/ nang rten 'brel lus kyi 'khrul 'khor du go ba'i dus su/ dge sbyor ci byas pa thams cad lus gnad du go ba dang*/ phyi'i snang ba thams cad lus gnad du go ba ste/ bsam pa des gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis rlabs nas lus de 'khrul 'khor gyi lus sam/ rten 'brel gyi sku bya ba gcig tu gyur pa'i dus su/ lta stangs la sogs lus kyi gnad re res sems can gyi gnad re res sems can gyi don mang po 'grub pa dang*/ rang gi lus mthong ba tsam gyis gzhan gyi yon tan bskyed bcing skyon sel bar nus pa 'byung gsung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis rlabs pa'i dus su/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa yin bya ba'i snyan pa byung nas/ gzhan gyi bsnyen bkur byed pa 'ong*/ 'khrul 'khor gtsigs su byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas rang gi don grub 'ong ba dang*/ gang tu phyin pa thams cad du 'khrul 'khor gyi 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas sems can smin grol byed pa 'byung te/

de chos che ba yin gsung*/ gnyis pa sems lnga ldan gyi steng du bzhag pa'i yon tan ni/ dang po byang chub kyi sems kyi steng du sems bzhag pa'i yon tan ni/ byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dus su/ chags sdang la sogs pa'i rtog pas ma btses par lus sems bde ba ni bde ba/ gzhan don du gsal ba ni gsal ba/ byang chub kyi sems de gsal kyang de las gzhan pa'i rtog pa med pa ni/ mi rtog par 'ong gsungs/ yang bsam pa byang chub kyi sems des zhe sdang la sogs pa'i rtog pa spangs pa ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ gzhan don de'i steng na sems gnas pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi slab pa yin/ bsam pa bzang po re res 'phrin las/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'grub par shes pa'am/ sems stong pa nyid don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin du rtog pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong gsung*/ nang rten 'brel byang chub kyi sems kyi bsam pa des/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs pa/ rdo rje'i lus de nyid kun rdzob byang sems thig les gang bas lus bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig pa dang*/ phyi'i snang ba thams cad sgyu mar 'char ba dang*/ lus mthong ba tsam gyi pha rol gyi zhe sdang la sogs pa zhi bar nus pa dang*/ gzhan blo gtod cing bag phebs pa dang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems skye bar nus pa 'byung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel byang chub sems kyi lus des/ phyi rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis brlabs te/ byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs pa yin bya ba'i snyan pa'i sgo nas gzhan bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog byed pa dang*/ sems gsum la gtsor byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas rang gi 'phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ gang du phyin pa thams cad du byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sems can smin grol byed pa dang*/ sems bskyed zhu ba mang po 'byung ba dang*/

rin po che'i bye brag mang po 'bul ba 'byung gsung*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skur byon nas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du mchog dang skye dman sprul pa'i sgo nas sems smin grol byed pa 'byung*/ yang don byed mkhan dang bya rgyu dang byas pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu gsum rang gi sems la sems stong nyid du rtogs pa ni chos sku yin la/ snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med par bde ba chen por longs spyod pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin ste/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la 'dud// ces gsungs pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*/ ma sems can mar ma shes pa'i don dam pa byang chub kyi sems de kho na nyid ma shes pas ma rig pa/ des bdag gzhan du bzung bas las bsags nas srid pa gsum du 'khor bar shes pa'i dus su 'khor ba'i 'dug lugs shes pa yin/ des na/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin/ des na byang chub kyi sems gcig pu go bas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go ba yin gsung*/ sdud pa las/ byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na// 'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung*// gsungs pa yang de lta bu zhig la zer ba yin gsungs/ gnyis pa yi dam gyi lha la sems bzhag pa'i yon tan gang yin ni/ rang gi sems yi dam gyi lha rgyan cha lugs la sogs pa gsal ba'i dus su dge sbyor ci byas pa thams cad kyang lha'i rnam par 'char ba dang*/ phyi snang ba thams cad lhar 'char zhing snod thams cad gzhal yas khang du 'char te/ de ltar rang lhar gsal ba'i dus su/ lus sems gnyis bde chen du shar ba ni bde ba la/ rang lhar gsal ba ni gsal ba/ rang sems lha'i rgyan cha lugs la sogs par gsal kyang de'i rjes su rtog pa mi 'brang pa ni mi rtog par 'ong gsung*/

yang gsal ba'i dus su tha mal dang zhe sdang la sogs pa'i rtog pa spangs pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ lha gsal ba'i steng du sems gnas pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ phyag mtshan la sogs pa'am rgyan la sogs pa re res 'phrin las tha dad pa 'grub par shes pa'i lha sems skye ba med par shes pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong ba yin gsung*/ de ltar na nang rten 'brel sems yi dam lhar gsal ba'i bsam pa des/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su/ rdo rje'i lus la rtsa dang rlung dang*/ thig le dang yi ge dang gnas kyi tshul du lha'i rang bzhin du yod pa dang gnyis su med par gyur ste lus lha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dus su/ rgyud dag pa rnams kyi lhar mthong ba dang*/ spyan gzigs pa tsam gyi gdon skrag pa dngangs nus pa dang*/ mchil ma btab pas nad zhi ba dang*/ lus kyi reg pa tsam gyis gnod pa la sogs zhi ba 'byung gsung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus lhar snang ba des/ phyi rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis brlabs te/ yi dam lha la brtan pa thob pa yin bya ba'i sgo nas snyan bkur dang zhabs tog byed pa 'byung ba dang*/ dpa' bo dang ḍā ki thams cad dbang du 'du/ lha'i ting nge 'dzin la mno bsam byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas 'phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ gang du phyin yang thams cad du dbang zhu ba dang*/ bskyed rdzogs zhu ba mang po byung nas gzhan don rgya chen po 'grub pa dang*/ ye shes kyi chos skyong ba thams cad dbang du 'dus nas 'phrin las bzhi yis sems can smin cing grol bar byed pa 'byung gsung*/ mtshan brjod nas/ rgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshul bstan pa// 'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i lam// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i dus su/ lha sku sna tshogs su snang zhing*/ don dam pa chos kyi skur rtogs pa ni/ chos kyi skur sangs rgyas su'o// lha'i sku bde ba chen po dang stong pa gnyis su med pa bde ba chen por longs spyod pa ni/

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skur gyur nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor snang nas/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa'i snang ba'i sgo nas dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don du 'byung ba ni longs sku'i sangs rgyas yin te/ rdo rje 'phreng ba nas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// zhes gsungs pa de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ yang rang lhar ma shes shing tha mal du zhen pas dug gsum gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyis las bsags pas/ khams gsum skye 'chi'i du khaḥl zo chun gyi khyud mo bzhin 'khor bar go ba ni 'khor ba'i 'dug lugs go ba ste/ sdud pa nas/ ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung*// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ de ltar go bas 'khor 'das thams cad go ba bya ba yin te/ chod de che ba yin gsung*// ༈ //gsum pa snying gi dkyil du bla ma'i steng du sems bzhag pa'i yon tan ni/ bla ma gsal zhing rang gi sems dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbye ba med par gyur te rang sems bla ma song ba'i dus su/ dge sbyor ci byas thams cad bla ma'i 'phrin las su 'char ba dang*/ phyi'i snang ba thams cad bla ma'am slob dpon du 'char la bla ma'i steng du sems gnas shing gsal dus su log rtog gi lus sems ma btses te/ lus sems bde la/ rang sems bla mar gsal ba ni/ gsal ba yin/ bla ma'i 'phrin las sna tshogs gsal kyang de'i rjes su rtog pa mi 'brang ba ni mi rtog pa'o// yang bla ma'i steng du sems gnas pa'i dus su nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa spangs pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bla ma'i steng na sems gnas pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa yin/ bla ma'i 'phrin las sna tshogs shes pa'am/ bla mar 'dzin pa'i sems skye ba med par shes pa ni/

lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong gsung*/ nang rten 'brel rang gi sems bla mar gsal ba'i bsam pa des/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs te/ rang lus bla ma'i skur gyur pa'i dus su/ gzhan gyi lam sna 'dren pa'i bla ma bya bar red nas/ gzhan sangs rgyas la 'god pa'i nus pa 'byung ba dang mtshan thos pa'am gsung tsam gyi gzhan dad gus skye nus pa dang*/ dge sbyor la sogs yon tan bskyed pa dang*/ skyon 'dag nus pa 'byung*/ yang gsang ba rten 'brel lus kyi snang ba byin gyis brlabs te mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma yin bya ba'i snyan pa'i sgo nas gzhan bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog byed pa 'byung ba dang*/ mos gus la gtsigs su byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas/ rang gi 'phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ sangs rgyas su lta ba dang*/ gang du byon pa thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa mdzad pa thams cad kyis/ sems can smin cing grol ba'i 'phrin las gyi don 'grub pa yin gsung*/ mtshan brjod nas/ 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa po// dam tshig chen po de nyid mkhyen// gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i dus su/ rang sems bla ma dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur la/ de'i ngang la gnas pa dang stong pa gnyis su med par bde chen du longs spyod pas longs sku'i sangs rgyas sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bla mar snang ba dang*/ tshogs lam chen po la sprul sku'i bla mar snang ba nas bzung ste lo ka'i srin bu la bung ba'i skad du chos ston pa'i bla ma'am/ ka kha slob pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don 'byung bar go ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'dug tshul lo// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba ni/ chos gsum dang ldan pa'i rin po che// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/

yang dang po bla ma ma gshegs bar du mos gus ma shes/ tha mar log pa'i slob dpon gyis zin te/ slob dpon gyi rten 'brel ma 'grig pas/ sred len dang las kyi du kha'i 'khrul 'khor du gyur ste/ 'khor bar 'khor ba shes pa ni 'khor ba'i 'dug tshul yin te/ sdud pa nas/ rkyen rnams 'tshogs nas sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung*// ma rig 'khrul 'khor 'di ni zad med 'phel ba med// ces gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ bla ma'i mos gus gcig pu go bas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go ba yin te/ de yang chos chung ba min gsung ngo*// ༈ //bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po la sems ma yengs pa'i ngang du sems bzhag pa'i yon tan ni/ bla ma snga phyi'i bar de sems ma bcos pa so ma'i ngang dus der thang lhod thams cad bral bar bzhag pas/ bla mas bstan pa'i dge sbyor gcig skye ste/ de ci 'dra gcig skye na/ sems rnam par mi rtog pa gsal sing nge ba skad gcig ma tsam zhig skye ste/ de ka bla mas bstan pa'i phyag rgya chen po yin/ ngo shes par byas nas skyong dgos te/ de ka rang sems sangs rgyas chos sku yin/ sems rtog med gsal stong skad cig ma de ka sgom yin dge sbyor yin te/ de ka la bla ma tilli pas/ kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min// tilli nga yis ci yang bstan du med// rang rig nyid la mtshon te shes par byos// zhes gsungs pa yang de la zer ba yin/ bla ma nā ro pas/ mi mno/ mi bsam/ mi sems/ mi sgom/ mi dpyad/ sems yang dag pa nyid du grol/ zhes gsungs yang de la zer ba yin gsungs/ seng ge bzang pos mngon rtogs rgyan las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// gzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes gsungs pa yang de ga la zer/ dbu ma nas/ sems ni sems min te/

sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o// zhes gsungs pa yang de la zer/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces gsungs pa yang de ka yin/ rnam snang byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ gang la brtag bya rtog byed yod// de ni byang chub yod ma yin// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid ni// rtog pa thams cad spangs phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa yang de yin/ de dge sbyor yin sgom yin/ de khyad du mi gsad par lto gos la gyong skur nas/ dben pa bsten la skyong ba gal che gsung*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ dge sbyor skad cig ma de skyong ba yang*/ dper na me don du gnyer ba gcig gis spra ba dang me rdo dang me lcags dang skyes bu'i rtsol ba'i rten 'brel sgrig pas/ me rta dmar ba zhig byung ba de khyad du ma bsad par gso ba'i dus su/ me lce la sogs dal bus ma gsos par sa rdo btab na me de 'chi ba yin/ dge sbyor skad cig ma tsam de ma bskyang par gtum mo la sogs pa'i dge sbyor gzhan bsgoms na/ skad cig ma tsam de yal nas 'gro ba yin/ yang me de yang la sogs dal bus gsos te/ sa rdo ma btab na me de shig tsam nas la sogs pa je che je che song nas/ gzod sa rdo btab kyang nags tshal la sogs sreg pa'i grogs su 'gro ba yin/ de dang 'dra ba dge sbyor skad cig ma de rang dben pa bsten cing bskyangs te gtum mo la sogs pa dmigs pa gzhan mang po ma byas na/ dge sbyor skad cig ma gcig dang gnyis la sogs par rgyun je ring je ring song nas goms pa'i dus su/ gtum mo la sogs dge sbyor gang bsgoms kyang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du lhan lhan 'gro ba gcig yong ba yin/ gsung*/ yang me chung ngu re rlung chen po gcig gis bus pas 'chi ba yin/ de dang 'dra bar dge sbyor brtan pa ma thob pa de la nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i rtog pa phra bas kyang gnod pa yin/

yang me chen po 'bar ba'i dus na rlung chen po byung na yang nags tshal sreg pa'i grogs su 'gro ba yin/ de dang 'dra bar dge sbyor la brtan pa thob pa'i dus su nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i rtog pa ci byung yang*/ dge sbyor de'i grogs su 'gro ste/ nags tshal sregs pa'i me la rlung chen po yang grogs su 'gyur/ skyes bu ye shes spyan la nyon mongs grogs su 'gyur bya ba de la zer ba yin gsung*/ 'di rtse gcig gi dge sbyor yin gsung*/ rang bzhin ngo bo mtshan nyid gsum las 'di sems kyi rang bzhin gsal ba/ ston gyi nam mkha' dag pa lta bu de la rnam par rtog pas go ma 'gags pa zhig yong*/ sems can rnam rtog spongs la sems mi rtog pa de me long g.ya' dag pa ltar gsal ba gcig 'ong ste/ de ga la gsal stong nam mkha' mtha' dbus med par gsungs pa yin/ nyams su myong ba mngon pa rtog pa gsum las en cig bla ma nyams su len mdzad pa yin/ nyams bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa gsum las dge sbyor de'i ngang la gnas pa'i dus su lus yang zhing zo mdog bde ba dang*/ sems nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i rtog pas dben zhing bde sing nge 'dug pa ni bde ba yin/ yang sems rtog pas stong pa'i ngang las sing nge gsal ba'am/ de'i ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams la sogs pa gsal ba ni gsal ba yin/ mi rtog pa de'i dus su sems stong pa'am/ dbang po lnga'i yul lnga gsal kyang de dag gi rjes su rtog pa mi 'brang pa ni mi rtog pa yin/ nyams 'di khrid byed pa'i bla ma min pa la bshad na yal 'gro ba yin pas mi bshad pa gal che gsung*/ yang mtshan bcas sam mtshan med kyi dge sbyor gang la yang gnad du bsnun pa'i dus su/ mnyam rjes gang yang rung ste skyon dang yon tan gang byung yang*/ da 'di las byung 'dug snyam pa shes pa de nyams myong bya bar 'ong ba yin zhing dngos po bsam pa gsum las/ rtse gcig gi dus su 'dir snang sems gnyis la dbang ma thob pas/

zhing gis sgyur bas zhing gtso che ba yin gsung*/ de yang rdzas dang lus dang nyams gsum la zhen pa bor nas dben pa bsten cing rtse gcig gi dge sbyor bskyangs pas/ de las bogs thon nas spros bral gyi dge sbyor 'char te/ dge sbyor rtse gcig 'di'i ngang nas bla ma'i byin rlabs gcig dang rang gi mos gus kyi shugs kyi sems skye 'chi med pa spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba rang gi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi skur lhan gyis rtogs te/ sems kyi rtsa ba chod pa zhig 'byung ba de spros bral gyi dge sbyor yin/ 'di la rtogs par mdzad de sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba yin gsung*/ ngo bo de yang skye 'gag gi chos thams cad dang bral ba zhig yin/ rtogs pa des nyon mongs pa mngon du rgyu spangs pas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab par 'ong la/ sems skye 'chi med pa'i ngang du gnas pa dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje skye ba'i ngos nas/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab par 'ong ba yin/ sems skye med rtsa bral du rtogs pa de'i ngang nas chos spyi bye brag thams cad sha mo'i sul che ba'am/ rgyu 'bras ma 'dres par mkhyen pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong gsungs so// de ltar rang gi sems chos skur rtogs pa'i dus su dge sbyor ci byas pa thams cad phyag rgya chen po skye ba med pa 'char zhing*/ snang ba thams cad chos skur 'char ba yin/ nang rten 'brel bsam pas gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su/ rang gi lus 'od dam 'ja' tshon lta bu gcig tu gyur te/ rang gi lus gzhan gyi mthong ba'am mtshan thos pa'am gsung thos pa tsam gyis/ yid chags pa dang gzhan gyi sems kyi mdud pa grol bar nus shing rtogs pa skye bar nus pa dang*/ dge sbyor skye bar nus pa 'byung*/ tshig gis smon lam btab pa dang bden pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*/

rab gnas byas pa'i dus su me tog 'chags pa dang*/ chos mang po 'bul ba 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par du ratna'i glegs bam mang po 'bul ba yong ba yin gsung*/ yang gsang ba rten 'brel lus des phyi rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba yin zhes pa'i sgo nas bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog dpag tu med pa byed pa 'ong*/ snying po'i don gtsigs su byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas rang gi don sgrub pa 'byung ba dang*/ gang du byon pa thams cad du bdag med pa'i seng ge'i sgras sems can smin grol byed pa 'byung gsung*/ 'jam dpal nas/ don zab don ni rgya che zhing*// don chen mtshungs med rab zhi ba// zhes pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ zhing dngos po bsam pa gsum las/ spros bral gyi dus su/ bsam pa gtso che ba yin te/ zhing rang gi sems kyis byed par go bas yin gsung*/ 'o na spros bral rtogs pa yin na/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i khyad par gang yin snyam na/ rtse gcig gi dus na nges shes ma skyes te/ sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum la rloms sems zhen pa yod la/ spros bral gyi dus na rang gi sems skye 'chi med par rtogs te nges shes skyes pas sems kyi rtsa ba chod pa'i stobs kyis nyams la sogs pa la rloms pa'am/ zhen pa'i mkhan po med par rtogs pas rtogs par 'ong ba yin gsung*/ 'o na lta ba dang rtogs pa'i khyad ci yin na/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas bka' brgyud rin po che 'di la lta ba med pa yin gsung*/ 'o na yang lta ba'i mchog bla ma la sangs rgyas su lta ba ma gtogs pa gzhan med/ 'on kyang spyi tsam gyi dbang du byas na thos bsam gyi sgo nas/ chos thams cad skye ba med par 'dug snyam pa'i snyam tsam gyi shes pa dang bral ba de lta ba yin la/ snyam byed kyi shes pa dang bral ba'i shes pa de rang skye 'chi med par skye med dang lhan gyis rtogs pa de la rtogs pa zer ba yin gsung*/

de la dgongs nas chos rjes/ grub mtha' blo yi mdun ma la// sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'khrul pa yin// lar ma go ba la ston par zad// 'di 'dra gcig bya ba'i brjod pa thams cad dang bral ba gcig yin gsung*/ 'o na mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi khyad par gang yin zhe na/ rje rin po che zhal nas/ spyi tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ stan la 'dug rung 'gro yang rung ste mtshan ma can nam mtshan ma med pa'i dge sbyor gyi steng na sems gnas pa de mnyam bzhag yin/ 'gro yang rung stan la 'dug kyang rung ste/ de dag las gzhan pa'i rtog pa skye ba de mnyam langs yin la/ rje rin po che bzhed kyi de dang khyad par gyi chos yin pas/ sems rnam par mi rtog pa de mnyam gzhag yin la/ de'i rjes snang ba thams cad mi bden pa sgyu mar 'char ba ni rjes yin te/ des mis phyin pa la mi'i rjes 'ong ba dang 'dra gsung*/ kha cig mi rtog pa'i rjes chags sdang skye ba de la rjes yin zer te/ de mi 'thad/ de ltar song na mis phyin pa'i rjes la spre'u'i rjes byung ba dang 'dra gsung*/ 'o na gang yin na nyon mongs pa de sa bon ma rig pa bag la nyal mi gsal ba'i tshul du rgyud la yod/ chags sdang de de'i rjes yin gsung*/ mchog gsum las 'chi ba la dbang ma thob pas mchog chung ngu yin/ rgya gsum las spros bral gyi rtog pa des rnam rtog rtsa bral du rtogs pas rtog pa'i rgya las grol ba yin gsung*/ spros bral gyi dge sbyor de yang zhen pa gsum btang nas ri khrod la sogs la goms par byas pas/ de las kyang bogs thon ste ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'char te/ ji lta bu gcig 'ong na/ snang ba dang sems gnyis su med par rtogs/ yul yul can gnyis su med par go snang stong gnyis med du shes te zung 'jug gi rtog pa 'khrungs pa yin gsung*/ 'o na spros bral dang*/ ro gcig gi khyad par gang yin snyam na/ spros bral gyi dus na sems stong par rtogs kyang snang ba stong par ma rtogs la/

rgyu 'bras bag tsam go yang rgyu 'bras mtha' dag ma go/ nyon mongs par rags pa spangs kyang mngon du rgyu bag re skye/ skye ba la dbang thob kyang 'chi ba la dbang ma thob/ ro gcig gi dus su snang sems gnyis su med par rtogs/ nyon mongs pa mngon du rgyu mi skye/ skyes kyang dge sbyor 'char/ 'di sems kyi mtshan nyid yin pas 'khor 'das du mar snang zhing rgyu 'bras mtha' dag go/ skye 'chi gnyis ka la dbang thob/ ro gcig gi dus su mnyam pa nyid rtogs pas dngos po gtso che/ zung 'jug rtogs pas mchog 'bring po 'ong ste/ rtogs pa de'i ngang du lus 'od dam 'ja' lta bur 'byongs te/ lus shul du ma lus te 'chi rgyu med pas skye 'chi gnyis ka la dbang thob ste ra dza ind+ra bhu ti'am/ bram ze chen po lta bu yin gsung*/ de ltar zung 'jug tu song bas lus rgya las grol te/ mchog 'bring po yin gsung*/ rogacig de yang spros med dam shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa brten cing goms par byas pas/ sgom med kyi rtogs pa 'char te/ sems gdod ma nas stong zhing rnam par dag pa dang*/ ro gcig man chad kyis nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog rkyen glo bur gyi dri ma dag par byas pas yin/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral zhing mnyam rjes med pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan dri med chos kyi sku'i sangs rgyas su 'char ba chu la chu bzhag pa'am mar la mar bzhag pa ltar/ chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te rang bzhin gyi don 'grub par byas pa yin gsung*/ mchog gsum las 'di mchog chen po yin/ snang ba rab chod pas snang ba'i rgya las grol ba yin gsung*/ 'o na ro gcig dang sgom med kyi khyad gang yin snyam na/ ro gcig gi dus su myong ba cha phra mo zhig yod/ sgom med kyi myong ba cha phra mo zhig rtsa ba nas spangs te dri ma med/ snang ba thams cad gnyis med kyi ngang du zhi/ mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig yin glang chen bzhugs kyang mnyam bzhag la/

bzhengs kyang mnyam par bzhag pa bya ba yang de ka la zer ba yin gsung*/ 'khor ba'i sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa rtsa ba nas spangs ste/ spong ba phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan mnga' zhing*/ sku gsum ye shes lngar sangs rgyas pa yin te/ me long g.ya' dag pa la gzugs brnyan gsal ba dang 'dra bar/ chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan du sangs rgyas te de ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin/ de ltar chos kyi sku dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa de'i ngang nas/ sems can gyi khams dang bag la nyal dang bsam pa'i tshogs thams cad dang rgyu 'bras thams cad ma 'dres par mkhyen pa ni ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin la/ yang rang don chos kyi sku rtogs pa'i bdag rkyen dang gdul bya gyen du phyogs pa'i gzhan rkyen dang*/ sngon du thabs goms par byas pa'i rten 'brel gsum 'dzoms pa la brten nas/ sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas su byon nas don byed pa dang*/ tshogs lam man chad rnams la mchog dang skye ba dman pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs su byon nas/ dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rtag pa dang khyab pa dang rgya che ba dang*/ rgyun mi 'chad par sems can gyi don 'byung ba ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'dug lugs yin/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas sku gsum ngo mtshar che// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ yang sems can gyi de kho na nyid de rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i ma yin te/ de ma shes pa ni ma rig pa yin/ ma rig pa de las snang ba gsum 'byung ste/ de yang snang ba las ma rig pa las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun 'byung*/ mched pa las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu so gnyis 'byung*/ nyer thob las 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'byung ste/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam par bsten nas bdag gzhan du 'byung*/

der chags sdang gnyis kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi las bsags nas/ srid pa'i rtse mo nas mnar med kyi bar du rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi tshul du 'khor bar 'khyams par shes pa yin te/ mdo las/ bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang*// de gnyis dang ni 'brel ba las// nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba yin// zhes gsungs pa'i tshul yin gsung*/ de 'khor ba'i 'dug lugs yin te/ phyag rgya chen po gcig pu go bas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go ba yin te/ de yang chos chung ba min gsungs/ klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa kho na'i chos rnams la// stong pa kho na skye bar zad// 'gro kun rgyu dang 'bras bu ste// 'di las sems gzhan ci yang med// ces gsungs pa'am/ chos rjes/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// gsungs pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*// ༈ //lnga pa bsngo ba la sems bzhag pa'i yon tan gang yin snyam na/ dmigs pa med pa'i bsngo ba bya ste/ sems sngo ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dus su/ dge sbyor ci byas pa thams cad bsngo ba'i rnam par 'char ba dang*/ bsngo ba'i snang ba thams cad bsngo ba'i byed las su 'char ba 'byung*/ yang bsngo ba 'grub pa'i dus su lus sems bde ba ni bde ba la/ bsngo ba'i rnam pa gsal ba ni gsal ba yin la bsngo ba bsngo'o// rgyu bsngos pa gsum gsal kyang de'i rjes su rtog pa mi 'brang ba ni mi rtog pa yin gsung*/ yang bsngo ba byed pa'i dus su zhe sdang la sogs rtog pa spangs pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab par 'ong*/ bsngo ba'i rnam pa la sems gnas pa ni lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa/ zhing bsam dngos po gsum rang gi sems/ sems stong par rtogs pa ni shes rab kyi bslab pa yin gsung*/ nang rten 'brel bsngo ba'i bsam pa des/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs ste/ lus de bsngo ba byed pa'i dus su gzhan gyi dge ba mi 'dzad pa'i gter du sbed pa'i snang ba 'byung*/

phyi rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su/ bsngo ba la gtsigs su byed pa yin zhes pa'i sgo nas gzhan bsnyen bkur byed pa 'byung ba dang*/ bsngo ba la so nam byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas/ rang gi don sgrub pa dang*/ gang du phyin pa thams cad du bsngo ba'i 'phrin las kyis sems can smin grol byed pa 'byung gsung*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i dus su sprul sku gsum gyi dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba ni sprul pa'i sku yin/ 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i mi dmigs pa stong nyid du rtogs pa ni chos kyi sku yin la/ zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'i bsngo bas snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med par bde chen du longs spyod pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas yin te/ mdo las/ thabs dang shes rab rkang gnyis gshog pa brkyang byas nas// gar 'dod sar phyin bde ba'i gnas thob 'gyur// zhes pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*/ yang bsngo ba ma shes pa'am/ shes kyang mi dmigs pa'i bsngo bas ma zin pas/ 'khor bar 'khyams par shes dus su bsngo ba'i go bas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go nus pa yin te/ de chos zab pa yin gsung*/ sdud pa nas/ ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba// dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ gsungs pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*/ de nas lnga ldan lta bu gcig la gnad du bsnun pa'i dus su 'khor 'das kyi chaus thams cad go nas 'ong ba yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'du byed de// de phyir mkhas pa 'du mi byed// ces pa dang*/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon yin// zhes pa dang*/ bag chags dag las byung bas na// bag chags sa bon dag tu bshad// bag chags rjes mthun 'tshogs pa na// srid pa'i myu gu des skyed de// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*/

de rnams kyis ku sā li sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa'i lugs/ bla ma'i rgya rdog po re re la nan tan du byas byas pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go nus pa/ lus 'di tsug sdod la/ sems 'di tsug zhog dang*/ yon tan 'di 'dra zhig skye yis bya ba'i gsung rin po che la brten pa'i chos gcig snyan du gsol ba lags/ da bsngo ba mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ sngon dbyangs dal 'byor sdong po la// bslab gsum dri med yal ga can// dran shes mos gus lo 'dab rgyas// byang chub me tog 'bras ldan pa'i// gus bsten slob mas zhus pa yin// gsum tshan bcu yi man ngag 'di// bkod pa'i dge ba rgya mtsho'i des// 'gro kun lnga ldan rab brten nas// mi shes sdug bsngal spangs nas kyang*// ye shes lnga ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku lnga dbyer med rdo rje 'chang*// 'gro mgon bla ma rin chen gyis// sku yi bkod pa gar bzhugs su// mtha' yas ye shes spyod nus shog /'gyur med mos gus ting 'dzin gyis// sku gsung thugs gsang mdzod 'dzin shog /'gro mgon rje yi bka' drin gyis// dgos 'dod nor bu sems la rnyed// chags sdang gnyis kyi sdos thag bcad// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi re dogs bral// ro mnyam ngang nas byang sems 'phel// mnyam bzhag nang du gzhan don rdzogs// lha dang rang sems dbyer med pas// gcig pur bsdad kyang 'phrin las rgyas// zhen med chos sku'i mos gus kyis// rang sems rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bde// mad kyang sku re bgyis pa lags// 'gro mgon rje yi gsung bzhin bkod// 'di la 'gal 'khrul mchis srid na// nyams rtog ldan la bzod par gsol// slob dpon pad mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ yon tan rin po che gcal du bkram pa'i gcal ka phyugs skyongs su/ shākya'i dge slong man dzñu shri zhes bya bas/ gsung rin po che bdud rtsi tshigs gsum gnad kyi man ngag ces bya ba/

gus pa dang brtse ba'i bsam pas yi ger bkod pa'o// // 1$0000240830) ༄// sku gshegs kha'i zhal chems dbon shes rab 'byung gnas kyis yi ger btab pa//1$0000310 na mo ratna gu ru/ 'di ltar 'gro ba'i bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'jig rten du byon nas/ gdul bya rigs can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar ni mdzad/ sangs rgyas kyi 'dul bar bya ba thams cad ni yongs su rdzogs/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen pos mya ngan la 'da' bar ni nye/ tshes nyi shu lnga'i dgong mo nub mo la bab pa'i dus su slob dpon gdan sa ba dang*/ sgom pa zhal snga rnam pa dang*/ bdag cag zhabs tog pa dang bcas pa g.yu khang du zhugs kyi 'gram du byon nas bzhugs pa la zhal snga nas khyod bstan pa ji tsam gnas tshul de thon gsungs nas/ bdag gi bstan pa ji tsam gnas ces rtsis pa de dang slob dpon pas zhus pa'i gsung lan gnyis po de snyan du gsol/ de'i rjes la 'od zer grags na re/ bka' chems kyi yi ge bar 'di mdzad pa yin zer slob dpon pas zhu ba zhus na/ 'bus sna drangs pa'i nged cag rnams kyi lus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'bul ba lags zhus pas khyed kyi lus 'bul/ gyen du 'gro ba'am/ thur du 'gro ba'am/ thad sor 'gro ba'am/ lus ngag yid gsum de byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyi dbang du byas pa'i lus nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i lus 'di 'bul zhus pas/ 'o na lus kyi ngum bu'i cha shas phul na ji tsam 'ong gsung*/ de yang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyi dbang du byas pas 'di nas bar khang yan chad tsam du gom pa song ba des kyang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par mchis zhus pas/ 'o de yin lus rang la yang*/ gyen du 'gro ba'i thur du 'gro ba'am/ thad sor 'gro ba'am lus kyi cha shas tsam/ bye brag tha dad pa'i dum bu re re yang 'dra na lus ngag yid gsum gyis ma lus pa phul na lta ci smos te bsam gyis gar khyab brjod kyis gar rdzogs gsung*/

de nas yang zhus pa/ skad cig kyang mi 'bral ba smon lam 'debs pa lags pas thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ smon lam gdab pa'i dgos pa der 'ong ba yin gsung*/ de nas cung zad cig lon pa dang*/ khyed rnams la chos shig bstan pas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon/ des theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i chos gsungs/ chos de dag gang yin/ nyon mongs pa phyag rgya chen por rtogs pa de yin/ nyon mongs pa phyag rgya chen por rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ nyon mongs pa dang ldan par bltas na nyes pa chen po bskyed par 'gyur ba yin/ de'ang ji lta bu yin na/ khyod kyis ko ka li ka'i gtam rgyud de khong rnams la shod gsung*/ bdag gis kyang 'o le tsam du ko ka li ka dge slong sde snod gsum pa rig pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa des ljongs su khyim bdag cig la dad par byas te 'dug pa na 'phags pa shā ri bu dang*/ mo 'gal gyi bu chen po gnyis kyang der byon pa la ko ka li kas bkur sti chen po byas te dad par byas nas 'phags pa rnam gnyis kyang sa phyogs der phug cig nang du mtshan mo bzhugs so// re zhig na ba lang rdzi bo gcig dang ba lang rdzi mo gnyis kyang phug de ru zhugs te de'i mtshan mo logs par spyad nas/ ba lang rdzi bo'i de brel ba'i stabs kyis sngon la langs nas song ngo*// nangs par gyi dus ba lang rdzi mo phug nas byung zhing*/ de'i rjes la 'phags pa gnyis kyang byon pa ko ka li kas mthong ste bu mo des log par spyad pa'i mtshan rtags kyang mthong ba dang ko ka li ka'i rtog pa la ba lang rdzi mo'i mtshan ma ltar na/ dge sbyong 'di gnyis kyi 'di la log par spyad par nges te 'di gnyis ni nyes par gcod pa yin no// zhes bskur ba btab pas/ tshe 'di nyid la lus la yungs dkar kyi 'brum bus gang bar gyur te de la chu ser bab nas/ de shu bar gyur cing de 'bras su gyur nas sems can mnar med par skyes zhes gsung bar gda' zhus pas/

'o de kho na yin/ de yang 'phags pa la nyon mongs pa med pa la nyon mongs pa dang ldan par bltas pas dmyal bar ltung ba yin/ nyon mongs pa phyag rgya chen por rtogs pa 'di yod na/ sngags dang mtshan nyid 'dul ba thams cad du nyes pa gtan med du bzhed de/ de yang 'dul bar ni dge sbyong gi 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi thob nas nyes pa med pa dang*/ sngags mtshan nyid thams cad du/ de kho na nyid rig pa la nyes pa med par gsungs kyang*/ yang sangs rgyas kyi sa man chad du sgrib par 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig gis dogs mtha' then pa 'di nga'i grub mtha' min na/ sngags dang 'dul ba'i khyad par 'di ci yin/ slob dpon gyis cig gsungs dang gsung*/ slob dpon gyis nyon mongs pa 'dul bas 'dul ba/ bsal gzhag med par rtogs pa gsang sngags su mchi'am zhus pas/ de yin yang mi gsung*/ min yang mi gsung*/ de nas cung zad cig lon pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi khyad par yon tan gyis 'byed pa yin te lam du btang bas lam du gtong ba'i lus/ de bzhin du byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yi dam lha dang bla ma dang phyag rgya chen po re re bye brag tha dad pas/ yon tan tha dad du 'ong ba yin gsungs nas/ gsang sngags thams cad bsdus pa'i brjod bya/ nyams len 'di yin bya ba zhig kyang gsung*/ de'i rjes la/ dpon sgom pas da ltar gsung ba de ltar bgyis pas/ 'di kun phyag rgya chen po'i sgom med pa ni med/ nga 'bu kun gyi spyod pa ma yag pa bag tsam la brten nas 'thab pa dang 'bar ba dang*/ log par bltas pa thams cad bshags lags zhus pas/ khyod kyi de la skyon med/ brtse ba chen pos gzhan nyes pa bzlog cing legs pa la sbyor bas bzang na dga' ba yin/ 'on kyang bshags pas mi 'dag pa med pas thams cad ma shes kyang 'dag sems su shes kyang 'dag sgyu mar shes kyang 'dag phyag rgya chen por shes kyang 'dag ste chos lnga po ma gtogs pa med/ de re re skyes na yang sdig pa mi dge ba med pa de khyod kyis go'am gsung*/

de nas sang nangs par khyed kyis khong rnams la gter chen po bstan pa'i mdo de thon gsung*/ de ltar zhu bgyis nas/ de nas gzims mal du byon/ nam de'i srod la dpon rgan dang nga cag gnyis kyis zhabs tog byas pa'i dus su/ zhal snga nas gsang sngags su mchod pa phyi nang gnyis su gsungs pa de rnams kyis da ltar nga'i zhabs tog byed pa 'di las gzhan med/ chabs kyis zhal bsil ba yon chab/ de dang 'dra thams cad 'di nyid kho na yin gsung ba dang skabs der sku khams kyi gseng zhig byung bas/ dge 'dun la zhal ston par zhu ba la ni mi gnang bar 'dug da dge 'dun la bka' stsal cig zhu zhus pas tshigs su bcad pa'i bka' gsum po 'di gsungs/ der sku bsnyel ba'i stobs kyis zhu ba yang mi spobs/ yid mya ngan gyis gdungs kyang phyis kyi kho thag chod par 'dod pas/ da rje rin po che 'di nas gshegs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams ni gang du bzhud/ bdag cag rnams gsol ba gang du gdab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang*/ de ji ltar bzhugs tshul zhig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa mi mnga'/ khyed rang gi sems nyid phyag rgya chen po de dang dbye ba med pa'i bka' stsal rgya cher gsungs te/ de ltar yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams 'di yin gang na yod/ khyod kyi sems nyid phyag rgya chen po dang*// dbyer med gcig tu gyur par nga bzhugs te// rang sems sgom dang 'bral bar ma byed dang*// nga dang 'bral ba med pa de nyid yin// o rgyan dza lan dha ra la sogs pa// gnas cig bzhugs pa nga la ga la yod// gsung de nas nged rang thams cad lus mchod pa'i sprin phung sngon du 'gro bas so so nas phyag tu phul nas/ snga ma sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las la log par bltas pa thams cad ni bshags/ skad cig kyang 'bral ba med par zhus pa la/ zhal snga nas dus rtag tu 'bral ba med pa dang*/ mi mnyes pa ma byas pa'i bka' stsal gsung ste/

de ltar yang*/ khyod kyis nga la mi mnyes ma byas te// zhabs 'breng zhabs tog kun gyis mnyes par byas// res 'ga' bka' bkyon brtse bas phan du re// nga la mya ngan 'das pa mi mnga' ste// khyod dang rtag tu 'bral ba med pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du bzhugs pa min yang*/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro la phan pa bsgrub pa nga la mi che khyod la mi chung*/ chur mnyam zheng du mnyam/ bang mnyam mchongs par mnyam/ mngon par dga' ba la sogs par 'gro ba yang med/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang 'di kho na yin shes par 'byung*/ bar der slob dpon gdan sa bas/ dge 'dun spyi'i zhu ba rje rin po che rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pas cis kyang da res kyi sku khams 'di myur du dwangs par zhu ba phul ba la/ lan cang mi gsung*/ de nas dpon sgom pas yang dang yang du/ rje rin po che'i 'phrin las de sngon ni cung zad tsam yin/ rgyas par ni da gzod 'gyur bas/ da res cis kyang mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par zhu zhes zhus pas/ bu de ma zer/ ngas ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du gyis/ bla mas ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du byas pas/ des na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyang des thob/ nga'i mi dgos gzhan bla ma'i gsung rgyab bskyur re re tsam yang sgrub par byed na/ kha che dgon pa bas/ zangs dkar lo tsa la khyod bod la song la gtsug lag khang rnams gsos bgyi ba'i tshig rkyang pa zhig gsungs pas/ bla ma zangs dkar bas gsung de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs nas bod la byon/ rdzun tshun chad kyi nor btsal nas lha sa dang bsam yas la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang thams cad gsos pa yin/ bla ma dam pas ci gsung ba de bsgrubs na yon tan 'byung ba yin te/ khyod kyis bram ze chen po la bram ze mos chang blud pa'i lo rgyus de shod gsung*/ bdag gis 'ol le ba tsam du slob dpon bram ze de rgyal po'i mchod gnas bram ze spun lnga yod pa'i tha chung yin pa la/

rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyis de 'dul bar dgongs nas/ bram ze mo spun bzhir sprul nas rgyal po'i ldum ra bzhugs te/ pho bo chen po bzhi'i chung mar byas pas nub mo yi mug ste rab tu byung ngo*// re zhig gdan rab tu byung ba de rgyal po'i ldum rar phyin pa'i dus su mna' ma bram ze mo bzhis thod pa'i nang du chang 'thungs pas/ skud po tshur shog chang 'thung zer ro// der rab tu byung ba'i rtog pa la bram ze ni thod pa la reg kyang mi reg na/ chang 'thung ba lta ci smos te/ 'di rnams ni mkha' 'gro ma yin nges pas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du bya'o snyam nas/ chang 'thung ba'i nang du ldum ra'i rtsi shing sna tshogs pa'i gzugs brnyan shar ba mthong nas/ de la brten nas chos thams cad sems nyid phyag rgya chen por ro gcig pa'i rtogs pa shar ba lags par gda' zhus pas/ 'o byung de kho na yin/ bla mas ci gsung min pa gzhan med gsung*/ de'i phyi de nyin par gyi dus su zhabs tog dang mya ngan gyis sems rnam par yengs kyang gter chen po bstan pa'i mdo de/ mdo smad pa 'bum yig chen mo klog pa'i tshul du khong rnam pa'i drung du/ g.yu khang du legs par klog nas/ de'i nub mo nam phyed du nye ba na/ zhal snga nas/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa bya ba dka' dka' bzhin du lan gnyis gsungs/ de'i rjes la de ring gter chen po khyod kyis bton nam gsung*/ nga 'bus gter chen po bstan pa'i mdo khong rnam pa rnams kyi snyan du phul lags zhus pas/ khong rnam pa mnyes sam gsung khong rnam pa shin tu yang mnyes zhus pas/ de yin chos de shin tu zab pa yin gsung*/ de phyin chad gsung gzhan gsung bar ma dran/ des na tha mar gsungs pa de 'di kho na lags/ gzhan sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa ni mtha' mi rtogs pas brir mi lang*/ zhal ta'i rnam pa'i gsung gzhan rnams ni thams cad du yongs su grags/ sku khams kyi mtho dman ni bla ma'i sku la log par bltas par 'gro/

tha mar gsungs pa'i chos kyi bka' stsal/ dus rtag tu bde ba chen po'i sa la bzhugs par nges pa 'di nyid lags/ dran pa nyams shing ma shes pa gda' na bzod par gsol/ ban dhe shes rab 'byung gnas kyi yi ge rdzogs so/// /

1$0000240831) ༄// sku gshegs khar nye gnas rnams kyi dbus gtsang du sgrub pa byed pa'i dam bca' phul ba la gsungs pa/1$0000310 bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ ngas mi tshe phan tal khyed kyi khe grags dang mi chos kyi mdun ma dus thams cad du byed ma myong*/ 'o na lha chos las log mi chos la zhugs pa min/ khyed rnams la zhag gcig gi zhu ba 'di ma phul na/ rjes na mar bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa re re yang mi bsrung*/ mtho dman gyi chos kyi bya ba sna re re yang mi 'grub par 'dug pas slob dpon gdan sa dang*/ mkhan slob rnam pa gnyis dang*/ dpon sgom pa skra 'khor phyogs rigs dang bcas pa rnams kyis chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba mtha' dag bsgrub par zhu/ mi chos kyi bya ba gtan mi sgrub par zhu/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che ni dar zhing rgyas/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams ni mthu dang nus pa rgya che zhing 'bar/ rnal 'byor pa rnams thub pa'i bstan pa rnams kyi chos min pa bya rgyu med pa tsam na bstan pa rin po che 'di'i zhabs tog tu mi 'gro dbang med pa yin pas/ thams cad kyis 'bad pa chen po mdzad par zhu/ de yang 'bri gung pa'i chen po dang bzang po mkhan slob dang nye gnas chen po dang gces pa rnams kyi gtan gyi so nam zhig ngas bsgrubs pa yin/ tug gis thug pa'i dus su sus kyang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa bsrung ba gcig kyang med/ 'bri gung pa la phung chen po 'di dus gcig 'byung ba yin pas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la bsam par zhu/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs la bka' stsal gsungs pa/ zhal ston pa bya ba de skyes bu dam pa/ de sngon zhal ma mthong ba la zhal ston zer ba yin/ ngas dus rgyun chad med par tshogs su phyin/ thams cad kyis ma mthong ba med pas zhal bstan mi dgos/ zhum pas phongs pa las gtan mi thar ba yin te/ de ltar yang*/ zhum pas 'phongs las thar la mi phan gyi// de bas mya ngan gdung ba ma byed par// dgos pa'i don sgrub mkhas la bsten byas na// rab tu dka' ba'ang sla bas thar bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas mya ngan ma byed/

khyed rnams kyi chos ma tshar ba yang med/ phyag rgya chen po'i dge sbyor skyong mi shes pa tsam yang med pas/ thams cad ri khrod du song la sgrub pa gyis gsung ngo*// // 1$0000240832) 'chi ba blu ba//1$0000310 'khrul 'khor tsog pur 'dug ste/ gru mo gnyis pus mo'i steng du bzhag pa'i sor mo ltag par bsnol la mthe bong gnyis kyis longs spyod kyi rlabs mnan/ gho tson btegs pa dang srog dang rtsol ba nas drag tu shad shad bud pa re bya/ nyi zla bskyod nas lhag ma spong ngo*// de nas nam tho rangs kyi nam mkha' mthong sar 'dug ste/ lus phyi yi dam/ nang stong par bsgom/ bla ma ṛgs kyi bdag pos dbu rgyan/ de nas rlung kha nas sgra med 'jam la ring ba rngubs te/ khams gsum gyi nam mkha' kha ru sib sib song bas lus sems thams cad 'chi ba med pa'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin du song bar bsam/ mthe bos longs spyod kyi rlabs bsdam/ rlung kha sbyar thub tshad cig bsgom/ mi thub tsa na sna ras rang gnas su nyal zhi ru bzhag stong sgregs byung nas 'chi ba blus so// stong pa rngubs pas 'gro ba 'tsho ba'o// 1$0000240833) gtum mo'i lo rgyus//1$0000310 'di'i lo rgyus ni rnal 'byor pa zhig gis kun sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa bde ba can gyi zhing na bzhugs pa la/ 'dzam bu gling pa ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams la phan gdags par dgongs nas/ de la sprul pa/ nying sprul gnyis kyi sgo nas/ sems can rnams kyi don bya bar thugs kyis dgongs nas/ dang po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su sprul te byang chub sems dpa' zla ba bzang por skye ba bzhes pa la/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi sems can rnams bud med kyi rten gyis 'dul bar gzigs nas/ rje btsun mar sprul nas gsungs/ de'ang ri bo po ta la'i rtse mo la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ de'i 'og na kun tu bzang po/ de'i 'og na rje btsun ma sgrol ma bzhugs pa las/

gnas de nyid du rje btsun ma 'khor lha las shas che ba stong phrag mang po la/ sgrol ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud chen mo gsungs pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya la mkho ba'i yul du ma gyur nas nam mkha' la dengs/ de nas sgrol ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud chung de'ang de ltar du gsungs/ de nas sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud gsung*/ de nas sgrol ma ku ru kulle'i rgyud gsungs te/ der rje btsun ma nyid kyis rgyud bzhir gsungs skad/ de las 'di sgrol ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud chung ngu las skol ba dum bu'i rgyud yin te/ klu sgrub kyis bton pa'o// des ye shes/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ ratna kirti/ banta ba la/ gnyan la/ kha'u ba la/ sa skya pa/ shel phug pa la/ des bla ma rin po che gser phug pa la'o// rdzogs so/ 1$0000240834) ༄// smon lam bsdus pa//1$0000310 tshe rabs ma lus thams cad du// bla ma dam pa mnyes byed cing*// mos gus ltem rkyang med pa dang*// nor bzang bzhin du bsten par shog /skyabs che byin che dkon mchog gsum// mchod pa'i tshogs ni ma lus pas// tshim pa med par mchod nas kyang*// rtag tu ngu bzhin bkur bar shog /bar chad thams cad sel 'gyur zhing*// ma bzhin sems pa'i yi dam lha// thun bzhi yis ni mnyes gyur pa// yi dam lha dang mi 'bral shog /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra yis// dregs pa can rnams tshar gcod cing*// bstan pa ma lus bsrung ba yi// chos skyong rnams kyis bsrung bar shog /bdag cag lhan cig 'tshogs pa rnams// khro 'khrugs thams cad rab zhi zhing*// zab mo'i gtam ni sna tshogs kyis// sems la phan pa nyid du shog /gang du 'dug pa'i gnas rnams su// 'jigs dang nyam nga bral ba dang*// phyi nang 'tshe ba med pa yi// dgon gnas rnams dang mi 'bral shog /ngo srung brtsol ba mi dgos shing*// ngo bo nyid kyi chos la dkar// phan tshun 'tshe ba med pa yi// skye bo rnams kyis bkur bar shog

/bdag kyang tshe rabs thams cad du// byams pa rgyun chad med pa dang*// rtogs pa gser gri chen po ltar// gnyis med 'gyur ba med par shog /nyon mongs gsum po skyes pa'i tshe// chu la ral gri btab pa bzhin// sems kyi mdud pa bral nas kyang*// 'od gsal ngang la gnas par shog /don med gleng slong zer ba'i tshe// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di rnams kyang*// chos kyi gtam du 'gyur bar shog /sdang ba'i yul rnams mthong ba'i tshe// rang dbang med par byams pa dang*// dang ba'i sems ni skye ba dang*// snying nas mar ni go bar shog /mdzes shing bkrag ldan mthong ba'i tshe// mi gtsang bum par go ba dang*// zhen pa'i mtshan ma rab log nas// chags pa med par gnas par shog /nga rgyal khengs shing dregs pa yi// skye bo rnams dang 'grogs pa na// smad pa'i mtshan ma rab log nas// bsnyen bkur byed par gnas gyur cig /shes pa'i tshogs ni ma lus pas// ltem rkyang bral ba'i chos sku la// mos gus rgya chen byed pa dang*// gnyen po brtan par gnas par shog /sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu des// rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa grub// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa ru// sems can rnams la smin 'gyur shog// / 1$0000240835)༄// yi ge 'bri tshul tsheg phrad kyi ji bzhin dgos par gdams pa//1$0000310 yi ger bkod pa'i sgros 'di yul skad dang*/ gang gis rjes su 'brangs pa ma yin te/ thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyi bka' lung gtsug lag las ji ltar byung ba dang tshul mthun pa bgyis pas/ tshig gi sgros gzhan gyis mi slad pa dang*/ tshig shad gyis dbang bskal ci dgar mi bya bar/ tshig khrid dang*/ tshig shad dang*/ tshig phrag phyed pa dang*/ gcig shad dang gnyis shad dang*/ bzhi shad 'di ji ltar phye ba bzhin du slob ma rnams kyis kyang*/ 'di kho na ltar 'bri ba bzhugs so// // 1$0000240836) ༄// seng ge'i 'grel chung*//1$0000310

oṃ swa sti// dge legs kyis rab tu rgyal bar gyur cig /rang byung 'od gsal byang chub sems kyi sku// dpal chen bdud 'joms ye shes mkhyen par ldan// chos rgyal bla med rnam grol 'khor los bsgyur// lha mi'i ston pa 'bri gung bzhugs la 'dud// zhing khams mi mjed padmo'i tshal dbus 'dir// 'dul mdzad ston pa thugs rje'i 'od phreng can// shākya'i rgyal po khri gdugs nyi ma shar// gzi brjid bde skyid dpal des phyogs bcur khyab// 'dir ltar nged bcag snyigs ma'i sems can thams cad kyis ston pa dang*/ skyabs dang 'dren pa gcig pur gyur pa/ bde bar gshegs pa dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa rnams la/ thabs mkhas shing thugs rje khyad par du 'phags pa/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas lus can thams cad thar pa'i gzhal yas khang du kha lo bsgyur ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ji snyed par mgon po rin po che rnam pa gsum mi zad pa'i gter chen po la mnga' mdzad pa// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes phyogs bcur grags pa de 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon ste/ de yang sngon thog ma'i tshe/ yun ring po nas thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa yongs su rdzogs par ni gyur/ grangs med pa'i bskal par bya dka' ba'i mdzad pa 'bras bu dang bcas rlabs po che'i khur rnam pa shin tu mthar phyin pas/ sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung ba/ yongs su skyob pa med pa rnams la/ dam pa'i chos bstan pa'i phyag rkyang bas ni rab tu ston/ nyon mongs pa'i mes rab tu brdungs pa rnams la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i chu rgyun gyis shin tu bsil ba ni bgyis/
